Disciplines that borrowed the practice without the precondition rediscovered the consequence separately, under local names: the committor problem, overdispersion, surrogate-endpoint failure, the Lucas critique and Goodhart's law, reification. The mechanisms of failure differ; the error of judgment is one. The essay proposes four delimiters and a protocol for adjudicating scalar claims prospectively, specified formally in the appendices together with the Scalar Conjecture the protocol exists to test. The protocol has not been run against systems of known structure, and until it is, it remains a proposal about method. Its own defeat condition is stated in advance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了各学科中普遍存在的"用一个标量数字（如生物标志物、测试分数、排名）来代表复杂系统"的还原实践。作者指出，标量还原的成功与否不取决于数学（因为任何有限系统总能找到一维编码），而取决于机制。物理和数学科学提供了三种可辩护的还原范式：时间尺度分离、阈值邻近、约束条件。社会科学等领域在未经前提条件的情况下借用该实践，导致了多重失败（如Lucas批判、古德哈特定律、代理终点失败）。文章提出四个界定条件和一套前瞻性裁决标量主张的协议，以及待检验的"标量猜想"。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，用一个标量数字（如序参数、生物标志物、考试成绩）来还原复杂系统是合法的？如何区分有效的标量还原与失败的还原？能否建立一套前瞻性的协议来裁决此类主张？
AI.motivation: 标量还原的实践在众多学科中广泛存在，有些是巨大的成功，有些则造成了致命后果（如代理终点在临床试验中的误用）。现有的区分标准（如"只是找到数字证明不了什么"）不够充分，需要一种机制层面的先验判断标准来指导实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制还原论（mechanistic reductionism）；三种还原范式：时间尺度分离（timescale separation）、阈值邻近（threshold proximity）、约束条件（binding constraint）；跨学科败案例：committor问题、过度离散（overdispersion）、代理终点失败、Lucas批判、古德哈特定律、物化（reification）。
AI.method: 概念分析与跨学科案例比较的思辨性论文（essay）。通过比较物理/数学科学中成功的还原范式与社会科学中失败的还原实践，提炼其差异，并形式化地提出四个界定条件（delimiters）、一套前瞻性裁决协议以及待检验的"标量猜想"（Scalar Conjecture）。
AI.findings: 1）标量还原的合法性与数学无关——任何有限表示系统都存在一维编码，找到编码本身不能证明还原有效。2）合法性取决于机制：只有满足时间尺度分离、阈值邻近或约束条件之一时，一个维度才在事先（a priori）足以描述系统。3）各个学科独立发现的失败现象（committor问题、过度离散、代理终点失败、Lucas批判、古德哈特定律、物化）机制虽各不相同，但都源于同一类判断错误：在没有机制前提的情况下进行了标量还原。4）提出了四个界定条件和一套协议，但该协议尚未在已知结构系统上运行验证，仍属方法提案，且其自身失败条件已在文中预先声明。
AI.theory_contributions: 将物理和数学科学中成功的还原范式系统化为三种机制类型（时间尺度分离、阈值邻近、约束条件），统一解释了跨学科的标量还原失败现象，指出其共同的判断错误根源，并形式化提出"标量猜想"作为可检验的理论主张。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床试验（代理终点选择）、教育测评（考试成绩使用）、组织管理（评分排名分配资源）、政策制定（指标治理）等实践领域提供一套前瞻性的标量主张裁决协议，帮助实践者在采纳或拒绝某一标量指标之前进行机制层面的审查。

detail.abstract: This article examines the rise of India’s Generation Z movement through the case of the Cockroach Janata Party and argues that its rapid expansion cannot be understood without considering the political power of social-media algorithms. It explains how changes to Instagram’s recommendation system after 2024 enabled a new and previously unknown account to reach millions of users without an established follower base, media network, or political organisation. At the same time, it argues that the same algorithmic system that amplifies a movement can also make it nearly invisible by reducing its reach without deleting posts or formally suspending accounts. Drawing on examples from the United States, Vietnam, Turkey, China, and India, the article examines how governments and technology companies use content moderation, throttling, recommendation policies, regulatory pressure, and commercial incentives to shape political visibility. It also analyses the unequal enforcement of platform policies in India and the limited transparency surrounding political recommendation systems. The article concludes that movements built primarily on privately controlled digital platforms remain structurally vulnerable because their access to supporters depends on corporate algorithms. It therefore calls for independent communication networks, including websites, email lists, consent-based phone databases, and decentralised organisational structures.

AI.tldr: 本文以印度蟑螂党（Cockroach Janata Party）的崛起为案例，考察印度Z世代运动的兴起，论证社交媒体算法在政治运动扩张中具有核心权力。文章指出2024年后Instagram推荐系统的变革使无粉丝基础的账号能触达数百万用户，但同一算法系统也能通过降低触达（而非删除或封禁）使运动近乎隐形。文章结合美国、越南、土耳其、中国和印度的例证，分析政府和科技公司如何通过内容审核、限流、推荐政策、监管压力与商业激励塑造政治可见性，并揭示印度平台政策执行的不平等与政治推荐系统透明度不足的问题。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体算法如何影响政治运动的兴衰？具体而言，Instagram的推荐系统如何既放大了印度Z世代运动（蟑螂党）的扩张，又可能导致其迅速失去可见性？
AI.motivation: 印度蟑螂党的迅速扩张无法仅从传统政治组织、媒体网络或既有粉丝基础角度解释，必须考虑社交媒体算法的政治权力。作者试图揭示算法既放大又压制政治运动的双重机制，以及依赖私有数字平台的政治运动所面临的结构性脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法政治权力理论；平台治理与内容审核理论；政治可见性理论；数字平台的结构脆弱性理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以印度蟑螂党为核心案例，辅以美国、越南、土耳其、中国和印度的跨国家比较案例，分析内容审核、限流、推荐政策、监管压力与商业激励对政治可见性的塑造作用。
AI.findings: 1）2024年后Instagram推荐系统的变化使无既有粉丝基础的新账号能触达数百万用户，为新兴政治运动提供了前所未有的扩张途径；2）同一算法系统可通过降低推荐触达使运动近乎隐形，而无需删除帖子或正式封禁账号；3）政府和科技公司通过内容审核、限流、推荐政策、监管压力和商业激励等多重手段塑造政治可见性；4）印度平台政策执行存在不平等，政治推荐系统透明度不足；5）依赖私有数字平台的政治运动在结构上具有脆弱性，因为其支持者触达取决于企业算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将算法系统视为政治兴衰的关键变量，超越了传统政治传播理论中对组织资源、媒体网络和粉丝基础的关注；提出算法"放大-隐形"的双重机制框架，丰富了平台政治与数字运动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁建设独立的通信网络（包括网站、邮件列表、基于同意的电话数据库和去中心化的组织结构），以降低政治运动对私有企业算法的结构性依赖，为政治运动和组织提供实践策略建议。

title: Cognitive Offloading and the Human-Feedback Channel: Why RLHF Preference Judgments Are the Untested Link Between Human Cognitive Decline and AI Training Quality
affiliations: and Injibara University

detail.title: Cognitive Offloading and the Human-Feedback Channel: Why RLHF Preference Judgments Are the Untested Link Between Human Cognitive Decline and AI Training Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract: Two research directions are converging. One shows heavy AI use is linked to weaker critical thinking. The other builds formal models coupling human cognition and AI training as one system. Both assume degraded human input lowers AI training quality in general. Neither tests a specific, high-leverage channel: reinforcement learning from human feedback, where people directly judge which AI output is better. This is a distinct cognitive task from writing or search, closer to comparison and discrimination than generation. We argue cognitive offloading may degrade this judgment specifically, which would lower training signal quality at scale. We review the Data Wall and model collapse literature, the cognitive offloading literature, and recent coupled-system models, and show precisely where this literature stops short of testing the RLHF channel. We propose a concrete, feasible study design to test it. This is a narrow, testable hypothesis and a runnable protocol, not a new general theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个窄而可检验的假说：认知卸载（cognitive offloading）可能专门损害人类在RLHF中对AI输出进行优劣判断的能力，从而在大规模训练中降低训练信号的质量。作者整合了三条文献脉络（数据墙与模型坍缩、认知卸载、人机耦合系统模型），指出它们均未直接检验RLHF这一高杠杆渠道，并提出了一套可行的实验设计方案来验证该假说。
AI.research_question: 认知卸载是否会专门损害人类在强化学习从人类反馈（RLHF）中对AI输出进行质量判断的能力，从而降低训练信号的质量？
AI.motivation: 两个研究方向的汇聚（重度AI使用与批判性思维下降的关联；人机耦合系统模型）均假定人类输入质量下降会降低AI训练质量，但都未检验一个具体且高杠杆的渠道——RLHF，即人类直接判断AI输出孰优孰劣。这一认知任务与写作或搜索不同，更接近比较与辨别而非生成，可能被认知卸载独特地损害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知卸载理论（cognitive offloading）、数据墙（Data Wall）与模型坍缩（model collapse）文献、人机耦合系统建模
AI.method: 文献综述与理论整合，并提出一个具体的、可运行的实验设计方案来检验RLHF渠道的假说。
AI.findings: 现有文献在三个方向上均未直接检验RLHF渠道：数据墙与模型坍缩文献关注生成内容退化的后果，认知卸载文献关注写作与搜索等生成性任务，耦合系统模型缺乏对具体认知任务的检验。作者据此提出一个窄而可检验的假说及对应实验协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知卸载的视角从生成性任务（写作、搜索）扩展到判断性任务（比较与辨别），为理解人类认知退化如何影响AI训练质量提供了一条新的、具体的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI训练实践中人类反馈质量监控提供了可操作的研究路径，提出可用于检验RLHF信号质量的实验设计，有助于识别和缓解大规模训练中因认知卸载导致的数据质量下降问题。

title: Access And Control: Artificial Intelligence, Dual Secrecy, And The Freedom To Tinker
affiliations: Elon University School of Law

detail.title: Access And Control: Artificial Intelligence, Dual Secrecy, And The Freedom To Tinker

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial or other relationship with any named entities.
declarations.funderStatement: Supported by a research grant from Elon University School of Law.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming, Elgar Research Handbook on Trade Secrecy in Data and Data Infrastructure, 2026.

detail.abstract:
The era of artificial intelligence and its cataclysmic subgenre, generative artificial intelligence (“GenAI,” collectively “AI”), began suddenly on November 30, 2022, when OpenAI unilaterally released ChatGPT for public consumption and use. Its immediate impact has created new opportunities for expression and innovation while provoking fundamental questions about what it means to be human—and about what brings joy and meaning to life while paying the bills. Thoughtful, balanced, and humane answers to these questions require access to information and an understanding of AI by those who do not profit directly from maximizing its sales and use. Trade secrecy stands as a barrier to that access and understanding.

This chapter identifies and analyzes AI’s “dual secrecy” problem. It begins with dual challenges. On one side, AI customers risk losing legal protection for their trade secrets through GenAI inputs and outputs. On the other hand, AI providers invoke trade secrecy to prevent customers, governments, and the public from accessing the information necessary to understand how AI systems work and hold them accountable. AI thus creates new methods for generating, losing, disseminating, and leaking trade secrets while maintaining its own secrets behind a legal and technological wall.

The result is a proverbial house of mirrors. AI is a siren that offers quick, easy, and inexpensive content and analysis, but when used carelessly, it can reveal or misuse a company’s trade secret crown jewels. At the same time, AI remains a black box whose code, training data, and decision-making processes often cannot be meaningfully examined, replicated, or explained—even by those with internal access. The combination of trade secrecy and technological complexity therefore creates information bottlenecks across AI’s entire use spectrum.

These bottlenecks are particularly pernicious when governments procure and deploy privately developed AI systems. Secrecy between private providers and government combines with secrecy between government and the public, producing “dual secrecy” throughout the government information ecosystem. The resulting blind spots invite error, manipulation, weak or no accountability, unintended consequences, real and imagined concerns, and suboptimal use of expensive systems acquired with taxpayer dollars.

This chapter is the first to examine this dual secrecy problem in detail. It proposes a tailored “freedom to tinker” that would permit appropriate examination, testing, and optimization of AI systems, particularly when they are procured for public use. Such freedom is necessary to protect proprietary information while enabling accountable AI, meaningful oversight, and informed public understanding. The result might render AI a true tool for public good, rather than a murky black box that creates concerns and risks that can eclipse its benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析人工智能的"双重保密"问题：一方面，AI客户在使用生成式AI时面临商业秘密泄露风险；另一方面，AI供应商利用商业秘密保护阻止公众、政府和客户了解AI系统如何运作。当政府采购和部署私营AI系统时，这种双重保密问题尤为严重，造成信息瓶颈、问责缺失和公共资源浪费。作者提出了一种量身定制的"自由修补"（freedom to tinker）方案，允许对AI系统进行适当的检查、测试和优化，特别是在公共用途的AI采购中，以在保护专有信息的同时实现可问责的AI和知情公众理解。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何造成"双重保密"问题？当政府采购和部署私营AI系统时，这种双重保密如何影响问责机制和公共利益，以及应如何设计解决方案？
AI.motivation: ChatGPT于2022年11月30日发布后，AI对表达、创新和人类生活产生了深远影响。但商业秘密法成为公众理解AI的重要障碍。一方面AI客户的商业秘密可能通过GenAI泄露，另一方面AI供应商利用商业秘密阻止外部了解其系统。这种双重保密问题在政府采购场景中尤为严重，可能导致错误、操纵、问责缺失和公共资金浪费，亟需系统研究和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业秘密法理论、信息问责理论、透明度理论、知识产权与公共利益的平衡理论、政府信息公开理论
AI.method: 概念分析与规范性法律分析：识别AI"双重保密"问题的两个维度（客户商业秘密风险与供应商商业秘密壁垒），分析政府采购场景中的信息瓶颈，并提出"自由修补"（freedom to tinker）的规范性法律解决方案。
AI.findings: 1. AI存在"双重保密"问题：客户通过GenAI输入输出面临商业秘密泄露风险，同时供应商利用商业秘密阻止公众和政府知情。2. 政府采购私营AI系统时，供应商与政府之间的保密加上政府与公众之间的保密形成"双重保密"，在整个政府信息生态系统中造成信息瓶颈。3. 这种保密结合技术复杂性导致AI成为无法检查、复制或解释的"黑箱"，引发错误、操纵、问责缺失、意外后果和公共资金低效使用等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地提出并详细分析AI的"双重保密"问题这一概念框架。2. 将商业秘密法与AI治理理论交叉融合，揭示了技术保密与法律保密相互强化导致的信息瓶颈。3. 提出了"自由修补"（freedom to tinker）作为平衡商业秘密保护与AI问责的理论方案，为后续研究和政策设计提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府采购AI系统提供了政策建议，特别是关于如何配置"自由修补"权以进行AI测试和优化。2. 帮助政策制定者理解AI透明度和商业秘密保护之间的张力，并为制定AI问责机制提供具体方向。3. 提醒各类组织在使用生成式AI时注意商业秘密泄露风险，并为平衡创新激励与公共监督提供实践指引。

title: Internal Auditors as Architects of AI-Ready Enterprise Data Governance: Enabling Structure through ISO 21378 and ISO/TS 21377
affiliations: , The College of New Jersey and Rutgers Business School

detail.title: Internal Auditors as Architects of AI-Ready Enterprise Data Governance: Enabling Structure through ISO 21378 and ISO/TS 21377
detail.abstract: Despite massive investment in Generative AI (GenAI), 80% to 95% of enterprise projects fail (MIT NANDA, 2025), stalling in the "pilot graveyard" due to data infrastructure deficiencies (Deloitte, 2026). Legacy ERP environments suffer from Semantic Entropy: the fragmentation of data definitions, localized customizations, and human entry discrepancies that confuse probabilistic algorithms and fuel financial hallucinations. To bridge this gap, organizations must move away from a blind reliance on data volume and establish a deterministic, pre-validated ingestion layer. This paper introduces a data governance framework that transforms the internal auditor from a retrospective reviewer into a proactive Data Steward. Leveraging ISO 21378 as a universal semantic dictionary and ISO/TS 21377 for interoperable technical packaging, internal auditors can construct an unalterable "Buffer of Truth." The proposed AIready data ecosystem insulates generative models from semantic drift, ensuring hallucination-free enterprise AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数据治理框架，通过将内部审计师转变为主动的数据管家，利用ISO 21378和ISO/TS 21377标准构建"真相缓冲区"，解决企业在生成式AI部署中因语义熵导致的高失败率（80%-95%）和财务幻觉问题，实现无幻觉的企业级AI应用。
AI.research_question: 如何在传统ERP环境中构建确定性的、经过预验证的数据摄取层，以降低生成式AI在企业的财务幻觉和项目失败率？
AI.motivation: 企业生成式AI项目失败率高达80%-95%，主要原因是遗留ERP环境中存在"语义熵"——数据定义碎片化、本地化定制和人工录入差异干扰概率算法，导致财务幻觉。企业需要从依赖数据量转向建立确定性的数据治理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义熵理论（Semantic Entropy）、数据治理框架、ISO 21378（通用语义字典）与ISO/TS 21377（互操作技术封装）标准框架、AI-ready数据生态系统概念。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于ISO标准的规范性数据治理框架，将内部审计师角色从追溯式审查者重塑为主动数据管家，构建不可篡改的"真相缓冲区"（Buffer of Truth），作为生成式AI模型的预验证数据摄取层。
AI.findings: 通过ISO 21378作为通用语义字典和ISO/TS 21377作为互操作技术封装，内部审计师可以构建"真相缓冲区"来隔离生成模型与语义漂移，从而实现无幻觉的企业AI部署。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"语义熵"概念来诊断企业AI失败根因，引入"Buffer of Truth"作为连接数据治理与生成式AI的理论桥接概念，并重新定义了内部审计在AI时代的功能角色（从回顾式到前瞻式数据管家）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于ISO标准的可操作数据治理实施方案，帮助企业走出"试点墓地"困境；为内部审计职能转型提供了角色定位与实施路径；为企业AI项目提供了降低幻觉、提高成功率的工程化框架。

title: Factual Grounding and Response Calibration as Distinct Reliability - Challenges in Agentic AI Systems: An Enterprise Case Study

detail.title: Factual Grounding and Response Calibration as Distinct Reliability - Challenges in Agentic AI Systems: An Enterprise Case Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial relationships with external organizations that could influence the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study documents the iterative development of a system originally built for an applied hackathon initiative, using contract documents uploaded by the author to a private knowledge base for testing purposes. No human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Enterprise deployments of AI systems face two reliability challenges that are frequently studied in isolation: ensuring generated responses are grounded in verified source material, and ensuring response format and depth match what a user actually asked. This paper reports a longitudinal case study of an agentic AI system developed for enterprise contract risk analysis, tracing its development across four iterative versions over approximately three weeks. We investigate whether factual grounding and response calibration, the appropriateness of response scope and depth relative to user intent, function as separable reliability dimensions requiring distinct engineering interventions. Holding a retrievalgrounded knowledge architecture constant across all four versions, we document how response calibration evolved only after the explicit introduction of intent classification at the prompt level. Early versions without intent classification returned either uniformly comprehensive responses regardless of query specificity, or uniformly minimal responses lacking necessary context. The final version, incorporating explicit intent classification, produced responses appropriately scoped to distinct query types. This paper offers empirical evidence from a single longitudinal case suggesting that grounding and response calibration may represent separable reliability dimensions, presented as a hypothesis for future controlled, multi-system research rather than a generalized claim.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项为期约三周、涵盖四个迭代版本的企业合同风险分析智能体系统的纵向案例研究，探讨了AI系统的"事实接地"（grounding）与"响应校准"（response calibration）是否为两个可分离的可靠性维度。研究发现，在保持检索接地知识架构不变的情况下，只有当显式引入意图分类后，响应校准才得以改善，表明这两个维度可能需要不同的工程干预。
AI.research_question: 事实接地（确保生成内容基于验证过的来源）与响应校准（确保响应格式和深度匹配用户实际需求）是否构成可分离的可靠性维度，需要不同的工程干预？
AI.motivation: 企业AI系统部署面临两个可靠性挑战——事实接地与响应校准，但这两个问题通常被孤立研究。本文希望通过纵向案例研究，考察它们是否为需要不同工程策略的独立维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事实接地（grounding）与响应校准（response calibration）作为AI系统可靠性的两个理论维度；意图分类（intent classification）在提示层面的作用。
AI.method: 纵向案例研究法：对一个用于企业合同风险分析的智能体AI系统进行为期约三周的跟踪，分析其四个迭代版本，在保持检索接地知识架构恒定的前提下观察响应校准的变化。
AI.findings: 早期版本（无意图分类）要么对所有查询返回统一全面但过度的响应，要么返回统一最小化但缺乏必要上下文的响应。最终版本引入显式意图分类后，能够针对不同查询类型生成适当范围的响应。事实接地在架构恒定时保持稳定，而响应校准仅在引入意图分类后才得到改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供来自单一纵向案例的经验证据，初步表明接地与响应校准可能是可分离的可靠性维度，为未来受控、多系统研究提出假设，而非提出普适性结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI系统开发提供工程启示：改进事实接地与改进响应校准可能需要不同的设计干预，响应校准的改进可能需要显式的意图分类机制；同时提示需要在检索接地架构之外考虑提示级别的意图设计。

title: Do People Actually Listen? A Survey on Email Security Awareness and Communication Strategies
affiliations: Hacks/Hackers

detail.title: Do People Actually Listen? A Survey on Email Security Awareness and Communication Strategies
detail.abstract: This research paper aims to identify and evaluate the best practices for email security, assess the effectiveness of communication and awareness strategies used to promote email security among end-users, and explore the factors that influence end- user behavior towards email security best practices. The research design included a comprehensive literature review of the latest trends, strategies, and technologies used to mitigate email security risks, as well as a survey-based empirical study of end-users. The findings suggest that while many end-users are aware of email security risks, there is still a significant lack of understanding and adoption of best practices for mitigating these risks. Effective communication and awareness strategies, such as email security training and education, software and tools, and company-wide policies, can promote email security awareness and adoption among end-users. The study highlights the importance of effective communication and awareness strategies to promote email security awareness and adoption among end-users, and provides insights into the factors that influence end-user behavior towards email security best practices. The recommendations for improving email security awareness and adoption among end-users include investing in email security training and education programs, software and tools, and company-wide policies to mitigate email security risks.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过文献综述和基于调查的实证研究，识别和评估了电子邮件安全的最佳实践，探讨了沟通和意识策略在促进终端用户采用电子邮件安全实践方面的有效性，并分析了影响终端用户安全行为的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 1. 电子邮件安全的最佳实践有哪些？2. 促进终端用户电子邮件安全的沟通和意识策略效果如何？3. 哪些因素影响终端用户对电子邮件安全最佳实践的行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管终端用户普遍意识到电子邮件安全风险，但仍存在对缓解这些风险的最佳实践理解不足和采纳率低的问题，因此需要系统识别和评估有效的安全实践及促进策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为科学与安全意识传播理论相关框架（涉及用户行为影响因素、沟通与意识策略理论）。
AI.method: 综合文献综述（对最新电子邮件安全趋势、策略和技术进行回顾）结合基于问卷的终端用户实证调查研究。
AI.findings: 1. 许多终端用户虽意识到电子邮件安全风险，但对风险缓解最佳实践的理解和采纳仍显著不足；2. 有效的沟通和意识策略（如安全培训与教育、软件工具、公司政策）能够促进终端用户的安全意识和采纳行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电子邮件安全领域提供了关于有效沟通和意识策略如何影响终端用户安全行为采纳的实证洞察，丰富了用户安全行为影响因素的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了改善终端用户电子邮件安全意识和采纳的具体建议，包括投资安全培训教育项目、采用安全软件工具以及制定公司范围内的安全政策以降低电子邮件安全风险。

title: Dynamic Recommendation Source Framing: How AI, Expert, and Peer Recommendation Labels Shape Consumer Trust and Purchase Intention in E-Commerce

detail.title: Dynamic Recommendation Source Framing: How AI, Expert, and Peer Recommendation Labels Shape Consumer Trust and Purchase Intention in E-Commerce

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organizational relationships that could have influenced, or reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the design, conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study. The study was conducted for academic research purposes. Artificial intelligence tools were not used to write the manuscript; they were used only to assist with statistical data analysis, calculation checks, and organization of quantitative outputs. All interpretations, conclusions, and final manuscript content were reviewed by the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved anonymous online survey participants and presented minimal risk. Participants voluntarily completed the survey after being informed that they would view a sample product page and answer questions about their impressions. No personally identifying information was collected or reported, and responses were analyzed only in aggregate. The study was conducted as an academic research project and was not reviewed by a formal institutional review board.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently for academic research purposes.

detail.abstract: Online retailers increasingly use recommendation cues to guide consumer attention and reduce search effort, yet less is known about whether the stated source of a recommendation changes consumer response. This study tested dynamic recommendation source framing: the idea that firms may improve recommendation effectiveness by matching the stated source of a recommendation to the product context. In a 2 × 4 betweensubjects experiment, 185 participants viewed one fictional Shoply product page featuring either a portable charger or a hoodie and one of four recommendation-source conditions: AI shopping assistant, product expert, customers with similar preferences, or no label. After excluding five participants who failed product recall, the final analytic sample included 180 participants. The product-type manipulation worked strongly: the charger was perceived as more objective/performance-based, and the hoodie was perceived as more taste/style-based. Product type significantly affected purchase intention and perceived personalization, but recommendation source did not significantly affect purchase intention, trust, or perceived personalization. The expected Product Type × Recommendation Source interaction was also not supported. Source recall was low, with half of participants selecting "I don't remember" when asked which recommendation source appeared. These findings suggest that subtle recommendation-source labels may be less influential than product context unless the source cue is salient, diagnostic, and clearly connected to product relevance. The study contributes a boundary condition for dynamic recommendation source framing and offers practical implications for e-commerce explanation design.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2×4被试间实验（185名参与者）检验了动态推荐来源框架的有效性，即企业是否可通过将推荐来源标签与产品情境匹配来提升推荐效果。结果显示产品类型显著影响购买意愿和感知个性化，但推荐来源及其与产品类型的交互效应均不显著，且近半数参与者无法回忆推荐来源标签。研究表明，微妙的产品推荐来源标签对消费者响应的影响可能不如产品情境本身重要。
AI.research_question: 推荐来源的陈述（如AI购物助手、产品专家、相似偏好顾客）是否会影响消费者对在线推荐的响应？企业能否通过将推荐来源与产品情境（客观/性能型产品 vs. 品味/风格型产品）相匹配来提升推荐效果？
AI.motivation: 在线零售商越来越多地使用推荐线索来引导消费者注意力并减少搜索成本，但关于推荐来源的陈述是否会改变消费者响应，目前知之甚少。本研究旨在填补这一空白，检验动态推荐来源框架的边界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态推荐来源框架理论（dynamic recommendation source framing），即推荐来源标签应与产品情境相匹配以提升推荐有效性。
AI.method: 2×4被试间实验设计。产品类型（便携充电器 vs. 连帽衫）× 推荐来源条件（AI购物助手、产品专家、相似偏好顾客、无标签）。185名参与者，剔除5名未通过产品回忆检查者，最终分析样本180人。
AI.findings: （1）产品类型操控成功：充电器被视为更客观/基于性能，连帽衫被视为更基于品味/风格；（2）产品类型显著影响购买意愿和感知个性化；（3）推荐来源对购买意愿、信任或感知个性化均无显著影响；（4）产品类型×推荐来源的交互效应不显著；（5）来源回忆率低，半数参与者选择"不记得"。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为动态推荐来源框架提供了一个边界条件：只有当来源线索显著、具有诊断性且与产品相关性明确连接时，推荐来源标签才可能发挥作用；微妙来源标签的影响可能不如产品情境本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子商务推荐解释设计提供了实践启示：单纯的推荐来源标签可能不足以改变消费者响应，零售商应重视推荐来源线索的显著性、诊断性和与产品的相关性，而非仅添加标签。

reference: VIRGINIA JOURNAL OF LAW & TECHNOLOGY, VOLUME 29, SYMPOSIUM 2026, NUMBER 2 pp. 87-105.
title: Freedom to Tinker With Trade Secrets
affiliations: Elon University School of Law

detail.title: Freedom to Tinker With Trade Secrets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial or personal interests with any subject entities.
declarations.funderStatement: Supported by an Elon University School of Law research stipend.

publicationDetails.detailsText: VIRGINIA JOURNAL OF LAW & TECHNOLOGY, VOLUME 29, SYMPOSIUM 2026, NUMBER 2 pp. 87-105.

detail.abstract: This Essay builds on the author’s prior article, The People's Trade Secrets?, which examines the problem of governments creating information that it deems a trade secret — and therefore inaccessible to the public.6 From the health effects of “pink slime” in beef products to the operation of voting machines, that article explains how the demands of commercial secrecy have prevented the public from receiving critical information about health risks and machine efficacy. Remarkably, trade secret information held by the private sector and governments — even information created by the government itself — was not required to be disclosed, even to ensure that private behavior is not damaging the public’s interest.  Because trade secrecy is modeled around private sector innovation incentives, its application to government is problematic. Absent challenging whether the trade secret exists at all — a dubious proposition if one is not even aware of its existence — the public is left in the dark. Private sector procured AI brings this black box problem to a new level of complexity and concern, as it is being used to analyze and create governmental information and render decisions without appropriate safeguards for accountability and understanding. Thus, a governmental “freedom to tinker” with AI trade secrets that it acquires from the private sector should be considered.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者此前关于"人民的商业秘密"的文章，探讨政府将信息定为商业秘密而导致公众无法获取的问题，并提出政府应拥有对其从私营部门获取的AI商业秘密进行"自由修补"（freedom to tinker）的权利。
AI.research_question: 当政府从私营部门采购AI系统时，如何解决商业秘密保护与公众知情权、政府问责之间的冲突？政府是否应拥有对AI商业秘密的"自由修补"权利？
AI.motivation: 现有商业秘密法围绕私营部门创新激励设计，当其应用于政府领域时产生问题：政府创造的"商业秘密"信息（如粉红肉渣对健康的影响、投票机运作机制）不对公众披露，使公众无法获得关键健康风险与机器效能信息。当私营部门采购的AI用于分析和生成政府信息并做出决策时，这种"黑箱"问题变得更加复杂和严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业秘密法理论；创新激励理论；政府问责与透明治理理论；"自由修补"（freedom to tinker）理论
AI.method: 基于先前研究的延伸性法学论述（Essay），结合案例与概念分析进行论证
AI.findings: 商业秘密法以私营部门创新激励为模型，天然不适用于政府场景；私营AI系统运用于政府决策时加剧了"黑箱"问题，缺乏适当的问责与理解保障；因此应赋予政府对其获取的AI商业秘密的"自由修补"权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"自由修补"概念延伸至政府与AI商业秘密领域，挑战了商业秘密法在政府场景中的适用性假设，为商业秘密法、信息透明与AI治理的交叉研究提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和立法者提供建议，即政府应有权审查和修改其从私营部门获取的AI系统，以确保公共问责、透明度和决策理解。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Critical Inquiry and Historical Thinking in Social Science Education: Preparing Smart Teachers for Culturally Responsive Classrooms
affiliations: Regional Institute of Education (NCERT), RIE (NCERT), Bhubaneswar, Utkal University Bhubaneswar, Odisha and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Critical Inquiry and Historical Thinking in Social Science Education: Preparing Smart Teachers for Culturally Responsive Classrooms
detail.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) progresses at a rapid speed, it offers a transformative opportunity to reinvent social science teaching and learning from passive content delivery to building critical inquiry and advanced historical thinking skills. This concept paper looks at how AI can play a powerful role in supporting students' capacities to locate evidence, explain events in their context, verify several views, and draw inferences or conclusions and how AI might support teachers in building culturally responsive classrooms that value and respect different learner identities. In the context of historical thinking and culturally responsive pedagogy, the paper explores how AI tools can offer pedagogical affordances for document-based inquiry, virtual and augmented realities to create living historical experiences, intelligent tutoring systems that support Socratic dialogue, and learning analytics tools as real-time sources of feedback on argumentation and source evaluation. The technologies have notable potential in tackling some of the longstanding problems in secondary social studies classrooms: the limited access to primary sources, the challenge to see processes of socioeconomic and political development, and the difficulty of engaging students, particularly when teaching in large or resource-limited groups. Simultaneously, the paper critically reviews the risks that lie in the uncritical adoption of AI, such as 'algorithmic bias', 'cultural misrepresentation in training data', 'loss of teacher professional judgment', and 'closing the digital divide'. It calls for purposeful teacher professional learning programmes that weave together what is known as Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge (TPACK) with critical awareness of AI, ethical considerations, and culturally sustaining practices. This can help a teacher to assess the output of AI tools, collaboratively develop learning activities that are relevant for the context and ensure their facilitation is human-centred, enabling student voice and community knowledge to be heard. The discussion points towards the implications of the discussion for Indian teacher education and secondary curricula, focusing on the alignment with national goals of holistic, multidisciplinary and equitable learning. The paper concludes that AI is only a true facilitator of "historical thinking" and "critical inquiry" when teachers are viewed and strengthened as "culturally responsive learning designers" instead of "technological consumers of learning". This approach is a direct contribution towards the vision of the conference 'Smart Teachers for a Smart and Inclusive Future'.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇概念性论文，探讨人工智能如何赋能中学社会科学教学，从被动的内容传递转向培养批判性探究和历史思维能力。文章基于历史思维框架与文化回应性教学法，分析了AI工具（基于文档探究、VR/AR沉浸式历史体验、智能辅导系统、学习分析）的教学潜力，同时批判性地审视了算法偏见、文化误表征、教师专业判断丧失及数字鸿沟等风险，并呼吁将TPACK与AI批判意识、伦理考量及文化持续性实践相结合的教师专业发展路径。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何支持中学社会科学教学中学生历史思维与批判性探究能力的培养？AI在文化回应性教学情境下能为教师提供哪些教学支持？其风险与挑战何在？
AI.motivation: 中学社会科学课堂长期面临原始资料获取受限、社会经济与政治发展过程难以直观呈现、大规模或资源有限班级中难以有效吸引学生参与等难题；同时AI技术快速发展为重塑教学方式提供了契机，但需要系统性的概念框架来指导其批判性应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史思维框架（证据定位、情境化解释、多视角验证、推论与结论）、文化回应性教学法（culturally responsive pedagogy）、技术教学内容知识（TPACK）框架
AI.method: 概念性论文（概念分析与理论构建），通过文献整合与批判性论证，系统探讨AI技术在中学社会科学教学中的教学可供性（pedagogical affordances）与风险。
AI.findings: AI工具在文档探究、VR/AR创设身临其境的历史体验、支持苏格拉底式对话的智能辅导系统、以及提供论证与来源评估实时反馈的学习分析工具等方面具有重要教学潜力；但必须警惕算法偏见、训练数据中的文化误表征、教师专业判断弱化及数字鸿沟扩大等风险。AI要真正促进历史思维和批判性探究，关键在于将教师定位为"文化回应性的学习设计者"而非"技术的被动消费者"，并通过融合TPACK与AI批判意识的教师专业学习项目加以支撑。
AI.theory_contributions: 将历史思维框架、文化回应性教学法与TPACK框架进行整合，提出AI时代的教师角色重塑——从"技术消费者"转向"文化回应性学习设计者"，为AI教育应用提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度教师教育和中学课程提供政策与课程层面的启示，帮助教师评估AI工具输出、协作开发情境相关的学习活动，并确保以人为中心的促进方式；回应了"为智能和包容性未来培养智慧教师"的会议愿景。

title: Institutional Collective Action and Local Governance: Case of Alyansa ng Baybaying Bayan ng Bulacan at Pampanga
affiliations: De La Salle University and

detail.title: Institutional Collective Action and Local Governance: Case of Alyansa ng Baybaying Bayan ng Bulacan at Pampanga
detail.abstract:
One way to address collective action problems is through interlocal government cooperation. Interlocal collaboration allows local governments to voluntarily coalesce and address shared policy issues without sacrificing their political and administrative authority to national agencies. Through inter-city or inter-municipality arrangements, local government units (LGUs) can jointly plan, implement, and monitor local services while achieving economies of scale and resource efficiency by sharing knowledge and assets.

Despite these advantages, limited scholarship exists on why and how LGUs in the Philippines form coalitions and alliances—specifically regarding the costs, benefits, motivations, and exogenous factors shaping their decisions. Analyzing the case of the Alyansa ng mga Baybaying Bayan ng Bulacan at Pampanga (ABB-BP) through the institutional collective action (ICA) framework, this research examines the context, costs, incentives, and political dynamics that influence LGU decisions to enter and sustain inter-local collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过制度性集体行动（ICA）框架，分析了菲律宾地方政府单位（LGU）之间形成跨地方合作的动机、成本、收益与外部因素。以Bulacan和Pampanga沿海城镇联盟（ABB-BP）为案例，探讨了地方政府为何及如何进入并维持跨地方协作。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾地方政府单位为何以及如何形成联盟和合作安排？具体而言，影响其进入和维持跨地方合作的成本、收益、动机及外部因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管跨地方合作具有诸多优势（如实现规模经济、资源共享、解决集体行动问题），但现有文献对菲律宾地方政府形成联盟的原因和机制研究十分有限，尤其是关于成本、收益、动机和外部塑造因素的探讨存在空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度性集体行动（Institutional Collective Action, ICA）框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，以Alyansa ng mga Baybaying Bayan ng Bulacan at Pampanga（ABB-BP）为分析案例，运用ICA框架分析其合作背景、成本、激励因素及政治动态。
AI.findings: 通过ABB-BP案例揭示影响菲律宾地方政府进入和维持跨地方合作的背景条件、成本结构、激励机制以及政治动态因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ICA框架应用于菲律宾发展中国家的地方政府合作情境，拓展了该理论在非西方/发展中国家背景下的适用性；填补了菲律宾地方政府跨地方合作研究的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾及其他发展中国家地方政府设计有效的跨地方合作机制提供实践洞察，帮助理解合作中的成本与激励机制，从而促进更可持续的地方治理协作。

title: Due Process in Competition Cases: Reflections as of 2026
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Católica Argentina and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Due Process in Competition Cases: Reflections as of 2026
detail.abstract:
This article examines the evolving concept of due process in global competition law enforcement, contrasting inquisitorial and adversarial traditions. While the European integrated administrative model is judicially accepted, the common law adversarial system offers a superior mechanism for factual verification and ensures that defending parties genuinely feel heard by a neutral interlocutor. 

The authors explore distinct enforcement challenges across various jurisdictions. In India, early excessive judicial review paralysed enforcement, whereas in Argentina, political capture through deliberate institutional vacancy constituted a wholesale denial of due process. The analysis also highlights the procedural pressures introduced by prospective, ex-ante digital regulations like the DMA and DSA, which obviously give great weight to the perspective of enforcers. 

To reconcile vigorous market regulation with fundamental constitutional rights, the authors propose several possible  reforms. These  include integrating independent administrative law judges to enhance the neutrality of factual adjudication, considering personal criminal liability as a means of encouraging respectful compliance, establishing clear internal procedural rules for agencies, and recognizing that due process must equally protect the victims of anti-competitive conduct seeking effective remedies.

AI.tldr: 本文考察全球竞争法执法中正当程序（due process）概念的演变，对比大陆法系纠问式与普通法系对抗式传统。作者认为欧盟一体化行政模式虽获司法接受，但普通法对抗制在事实核查和保障被诉方被中立倾听方面更具优势。文章还分析了印度、阿根廷等司法辖区的执法挑战，以及DMA和DSA等前瞻性数字法规带来的程序压力，并提出若干改革建议。
AI.research_question: 全球竞争法执法中的正当程序概念如何演变？不同法系传统（纠问式与对抗式）在竞争执法中各有哪些优劣？如何在规制市场竞争与保障宪法基本权利之间实现平衡？
AI.motivation: 竞争法执法日益全球化和数字化，正当程序在不同司法辖区面临截然不同的挑战，包括过度司法审查导致执法瘫痪、政治俘获导致正当程序被完全剥夺，以及新兴数字监管法规带来的程序压力。作者旨在提出系统性改革方案以调和市场规制与宪法权利的冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 正当程序理论；纠问式（大陆法系）与对抗式（普通法系）程序传统比较；竞争法行政执法的合法性理论；宪法权利保障与行政规制平衡理论
AI.method: 比较法学分析（跨司法辖区比较研究），结合具体案例（印度、阿根廷）与制度分析（欧盟模式、DMA/DSA法规），并基于制度设计提出规范性改革建议。
AI.findings: 1）欧盟一体化行政模式虽被司法接受，但普通法对抗制在事实核查和确保被诉方被中立倾听方面更优；2）印度过度司法审查导致执法瘫痪，阿根廷政治俘获导致正当程序被彻底否定；3）DMA和DSA等前瞻性数字法规赋予执法者过重视角，加剧程序失衡；4）改革路径包括引入独立行政法法官、考虑个人刑事责任、建立机构内部程序规则，以及保障受害者同样享有正当程序保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了正当程序概念在竞争法领域的理论内涵，将正当程序从仅保护被调查企业扩展到同样保护反竞争行为受害者；系统比较了不同法系传统在竞争执法中的程序正当性理论；提出了对抗制要素与行政规制融合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国竞争执法机构提供具体改革建议：引入独立行政法法官以增强事实裁决的中立性；探索个人刑事责任的威慑机制；建立清晰的内部门流程规则；在数字监管时代重新审视执法程序平衡，确保受害者的有效救济权。

title: AI Adoption and National Economic Competitiveness: A Comparative Study of Industrial and Economic Leadership in Pakistan and the UK
affiliations: Sukkur IBA University, University of Karachi,  Govt. Graduate College for Women, Shalimar Town Lahore,  and National Institute of Immunology

detail.title: AI Adoption and National Economic Competitiveness: A Comparative Study of Industrial and Economic Leadership in Pakistan and the UK
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a strategic driver of industrial competitiveness and national economic competitiveness. This study comparatively examines AI adoption and its influence on industrial and economic leadership in Pakistan and the United Kingdom. Guided by the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework, the study employed an interpretivist qualitative research design. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with 18 industry leaders, policymakers, AI specialists, and academics, and the data were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. Five themes emerged: AI integration for industrial competitiveness, workforce readiness and AI capability, policy and regulatory support, innovation and national economic leadership, and structural barriers to AI adoption. The findings reveal that the United Kingdom benefits from mature AI ecosystems, coordinated governance, advanced digital infrastructure, and strong workforce development, enabling greater industrial competitiveness. Conversely, Pakistan demonstrates significant AI potential but faces challenges related to infrastructure, investment, workforce capability, and institutional coordination. The study concludes that sustainable AI-driven competitiveness depends on aligning technological capability, organizational readiness, human capital, and supportive policy environments. These findings provide theoretical and practical insights for governments, industries, universities, and policymakers seeking to strengthen AI-enabled industrial transformation and long-term national economic competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于TOE框架，通过18位行业领袖、政策制定者、AI专家和学者的半结构化访谈，比较分析巴基斯坦与英国在AI采纳及其对工业和经济领导力影响方面的差异。研究发现英国受益于成熟的AI生态系统、协调治理和先进数字基础设施；而巴基斯坦虽具AI潜力，但面临基础设施、投资、人力资本和制度协调等挑战。可持续的AI驱动竞争力取决于技术能力、组织准备、人力资本和支持性政策环境的协同。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦与英国在AI采纳及其对工业和经济增长领导力影响方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: AI已成为工业竞争力和国家经济竞争力的战略驱动因素，但不同发展水平的国家在AI采纳方面存在显著差异，亟需比较研究以理解这些差异及其对国家和工业领导力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架
AI.method: 采用解释主义定性研究设计，对18名行业领袖、政策制定者、AI专家和学者进行半结构化访谈，使用反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis）对数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 研究涌现出五个主题：AI整合与工业竞争力、劳动力准备与AI能力、政策与监管支持、创新与国家经济领导力、以及AI采纳的结构性障碍。英国受益于成熟AI生态系统、协调治理、先进数字基础设施和强大的劳动力发展，从而实现更高的工业竞争力；巴基斯坦虽展示显著AI潜力，但面临基础设施、投资、劳动力能力和制度协调方面的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TOE框架应用于跨国比较情境，揭示AI驱动竞争力取决于技术能力、组织准备、人力资本和政策环境的协同作用，丰富了AI采纳与治理在发展中国家与发达国家比较视角下的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、产业界、大学和政策制定者提供关于AI赋能的产业转型和国家长期经济竞争力的理论性与实践性见解，特别是为发展中经济体如何弥合与发达经济体之间的AI差距提供了政策启示。

title: Standard Essential Patent Disputes in Japan: From Apple v. Samsung to Pantech and the Future of SEP Dispute Resolution
affiliations: Waseda University

detail.title: Standard Essential Patent Disputes in Japan: From Apple v. Samsung to Pantech and the Future of SEP Dispute Resolution
detail.abstract: After more than a decade of silence following the 2014 IP High Court Grand Panel decisions, Japanese courts issued three SEP judgments in 2025, all arising from suits by Pantech. This paper analyzes the Tokyo District Court's Pantech v. Google I — Japan's first case where an injunction was granted on an SEP — arguing its abuse-of-rights reasoning is unpersuasive: it offers no normative standard for good-faith FRAND negotiation, and barely evaluates the patentee's own conduct, unlike the more balanced Osaka judgment in Pantech v. Google II. It also covers Pantech v. ASUS JAPAN's FRAND royalty calculation. The paper then examines the Tokyo District Court's 2026 "Procedures" that push early settlement on global FRAND terms in litigation and initiate a judicial mediation system. It concludes that while this pragmatic turn suits SEPs' inherently global nature, more predictability about Japanese courts' position on FRAND negotiation is needed for Japan to become an attractive forum for SEP disputes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年日本法院在Pantech系列案件中作出的三项SEP（标准必要专利）判决，重点批评东京地方法院在Pantech v. Google I案中授予禁令的滥用权利推理缺乏说服力，并讨论了2026年东京地方法院推动全球FRAND条款早期和解及司法调解程序的"程序"规则，认为日本需要更可预测的FRAND谈判立场以成为有吸引力的SEP争议解决地。
AI.research_question: 日本法院2025年SEP判决中关于FRAND谈判和禁令的推理是否具有说服力，以及日本司法体系对SEP争议的处理方式是否有利于日本成为有吸引力的SEP争议解决论坛？
AI.motivation: 自2014年日本知识产权高等法院大合议庭判决后，日本法院在SEP领域沉默了十余年。2025年Pantech系列案件打破了这一沉默，但相关判决的推理质量参差不齐，且日本法院新推出的2026年程序规则可能深刻影响SEP争议的解决路径，亟需系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: FRAND（公平、合理、非歧视）许可义务理论、滥用权利（abuse of rights）原则、禁令救济理论、司法调解理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，对东京地方法院和/or大阪地方法院的Pantech系列判决（Pantech v. Google I、Pantech v. Google II、Pantech v. ASUS JAPAN）进行文本比较分析，并结合2026年东京地方法院的诉讼程序规则进行规范性评估。
AI.findings: 1) 东京地方法院在Pantech v. Google I案中对SEP授予禁令，但其滥用权利推理缺乏说服力：未提供诚信FRAND谈判的规范性标准，且几乎没有评估专利权人自身行为；2) 大阪地方法院在Pantech v. Google II案中采取了更为平衡的推理方式；3) Pantech v. ASUS JAPAN案涉及FRAND合理许可费的计算；4) 2026年东京地方法院新程序规则推动全球FRAND条款的早期和解并引入司法调解制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对日本法院滥用权利推理在SEP禁令语境下的适用提出了批判性分析，指出其缺乏规范性标准和专利权人行为评估，并对比了东京与大阪法院在FRAND谈判判断上的方法论差异，为完善SEP禁令救济的司法推理框架提供了理论参照。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SEP权利人及实施者在日本进行FRAND谈判和诉讼提供了司法态度的最新指引；指出了日本法院在FRAND谈判立场上的可预测性不足问题，为日本司法改革和诉讼策略制定提供了参考。

title: The AI-Gig Paradox: An Economic Review of Algorithmic Management, Information Asymmetry, and Labor Market Segmentation in India's Digital Economy

detail.title: The AI-Gig Paradox: An Economic Review of Algorithmic Management, Information Asymmetry, and Labor Market Segmentation in India's Digital Economy
detail.abstract: This literature review examines the economic implications of algorithmic management in India's growing gig economy, asking why financial literacy, while necessary, may be insufficient to address worker precarity. It synthesizes research through four economic perspectives: information asymmetry and principal-agent theory, technological change and skill-based labor-market sorting, labor-market segmentation, and consumption smoothing under income volatility. The review argues that algorithmic management can relocate managerial control into opaque systems while concentrating information and bargaining power on platforms. Technological change may further divide workers according to their capacity to be complemented rather than displaced, while labor-market segmentation can limit mobility between more and less secure forms of work. Evidence from financial diaries suggests that volatile platform earnings can constrain workers' ability to save and smooth consumption, limiting what financial knowledge alone can accomplish. The review situates India within broader Global South and OECD literature while emphasizing the scarcity of India-specific longitudinal evidence. It concludes that financial literacy can improve individual responses to income volatility but cannot, by itself, resolve structural sources of insecurity such as information asymmetry, algorithmic control, and limited labor-market mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文献综述探讨了印度零工经济中算法管理的经济影响，论证了金融素养虽然是必要的，但不足以解决工人不稳定性问题。文章通过四个经济学视角（信息不对称与委托代理理论、技术变革与技能型劳动力市场分类、劳动力市场分割、收入波动下的消费平滑）综合分析了算法管理如何将管理控制转移到不透明系统中，并集中在平台上的信息和议价能力，最终认为金融素养只能改善个人对收入波动的应对，无法解决结构性不安全的根源。
AI.research_question: 为什么金融素养虽然是必要的，但可能不足以解决印度零工经济中工人不稳定性（precarity）的问题？
AI.motivation: 印度零工经济快速增长，算法管理日益普及，但现有研究多关注金融素养作为个人应对策略，缺乏对其局限性的系统性检视。通过经济学理论框架来分析算法管理如何从结构层面削弱金融素养的有效性，并指出印度本土纵向证据的稀缺性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四个经济学视角：（1）信息不对称与委托代理理论；（2）技术变革与技能型劳动力市场分类；（3）劳动力市场分割理论；（4）收入波动下的消费平滑理论。
AI.method: 文献综述（systematic literature review），综合全球南方和OECD国家的相关研究，并辅以金融日记（financial diaries）的证据。
AI.findings: （1）算法管理将管理控制转移到不透明系统中，信息和议价能力集中于平台；（2）技术变革按工人被补充而非被替代的能力分化劳动力；（3）劳动力市场分割限制了工人向更安全就业形式的流动性；（4）平台收入的高度波动限制了工人储蓄和消费平滑能力，从而限制了金融知识本身能实现的效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将四种经济学理论整合到一个分析框架中，系统性地解释了为什么结构性力量（信息不对称、算法控制、劳动力市场流动性受限）会削弱金融素养的有效性，填补了金融素养个体化叙事与结构性不公正之间的理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：仅靠金融教育项目不足以解决零工工人的不稳定性，需要关注算法透明度监管、劳动力流动性促进和收入保障机制等结构性干预措施；同时指出印度需要更多本土纵向实证研究。

title: Governing AI Applications in India – a Regulatory Architecture for Generative, Recommender, Agentic and High-Impact Systems: From Fragmented Legal Coverage to Enforceable, Sector-Specific Accountability Across India’s Public and Private Sectors

detail.title: Governing AI Applications in India – a Regulatory Architecture for Generative, Recommender, Agentic and High-Impact Systems: From Fragmented Legal Coverage to Enforceable, Sector-Specific Accountability Across India’s Public and Private Sectors
detail.abstract:
India is not an artificial-intelligence law vacuum. It has an emerging national governance framework, data- protection legislation, intermediary and synthetic-media rules, cybersecurity directions, consumer and competition law, financial-sector initiatives, medical-device controls, professional standards and a growing body of judicial decisions. Yet those instruments regulate particular inputs, outputs, actors or harms without supplying a coherent application layer for consequential deployment. This paper calls that condition India’s AI application- layer governance deficit: incomplete legal coverage, uneven implementation of existing rules, and inadequate governance of the algorithmic systems through which institutions and platforms make, shape and enforce con- sequential decisions.

The paper makes four principal contributions. First, it distinguishes data legality, content authenticity and model governance from decision and deployment governance. Second, it proposes Generative Recommender and Decision-Shaping Systems (GRDSS) as a regulated category for systems that combine ranking, generation, persuasion, personalisation and action when at least one consequential-domain, agentic-authority, systemic- reach, vulnerable-user or material-conflict trigger is present. Third, it develops a five-layer Indian AI Appli- cations Code comprising a universal baseline, upstream model duties, high-impact application duties, sector schedules and rights of affected persons. Fourth, it introduces the India AI Applications and Legal Cover- age Atlas, 2026–2050, mapping the Union Government’s 55 ministries across eighteen durable AI capability classes, three implementation horizons and six legal-coverage statuses.

The framework allocates responsibility among model providers, developers, integrators, deployers, platforms, professional users and decision-making institutions while preserving non-delegable responsibility for the institution exercising consequential power. The framework is stress-tested against a 32-entry Indian incident seed register spanning judicial hallucination, financial impersonation, synthetic identity, medical-software regulation, public-benefit administration, platform moderation and other application-layer failures. The Meta–India sequence provides one particularly concen- trated stress test rather than the evidentiary basis for the framework itself: Meta admitted erroneous restriction of an authentic Prime Ministerial communication, senior global leadership apologised, and Union and parliamen- tary scrutiny followed; the connected Hyderabad allegations and the personal culpability of Meta India’s manag- ing director remain unresolved. The episode illustrates an accountability inversion in which an accessible Indian officer may face immediate process while the offshore operator controlling models, policies and evidence is not subject to a direct, technically grounded and proportionate enterprise-enforcement pathway. The proposed Code therefore adds evidence preservation, interoperable incident referral, risk-tiered critical-account assurance, dual- failure auditing, an India operator of record, controlling-parent responsibility and calibrated enterprise remedies. The recommended institutional model does not begin with a single AI super-regulator. AIGEG should set strategic direction; TPEC should maintain common definitions and templates; the IndiaAI Safety Institute should develop evaluation capacity; and existing sector regulators should issue and enforce domain schedules within verified statutory authority. CERT-In should remain the cyber-incident node rather than a general AI-harm authority. Federal implementation should use national minimum rules, cooperative coordination, model State schedules and constitutionally available legislative pathways. Low-risk innovation should remain presumptively permitted, while high-impact, systemically significant and safety-critical applications should face proportionate, verifiable duties and accessible remedies. For durability in a multilingual and multicultural federation, the paper separates a stable constitutional core from revisable sector schedules, technical profiles and designation thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印度虽已有多部人工智能相关法律，但缺乏统一的"应用层治理"框架，并提出一个五层《印度AI应用法典》及相应治理架构，以弥合法律覆盖缺口、实施不均和算法系统治理不足的问题。
AI.research_question: 印度如何构建一个连贯、分层、可执行的AI应用层治理框架，以应对现行零散法律无法有效监管"因果性部署"的缺陷？
AI.motivation: 印度已有诸多AI相关法律（数据保护、中介规则、网络安全、消费者法、医疗设备控制等），但这些工具仅规制特定输入、输出、行为者或伤害，缺乏统一的"应用层"治理框架，导致后果性部署缺乏连贯监管。Meta-印度事件进一步暴露了问责倒置问题（当地可接触的官员面临程序，而境外运营商却缺乏直接执法路径）。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI应用层治理赤字框架；GRDSS（生成式推荐与决策塑造系统）监管类别理论；五层AI应用法典结构；责任分配与非可委托责任原则；问责倒置概念。
AI.method: 本文采用概念构建与制度设计方法：提出GRDSS监管类别和五层法典框架；利用32条印度事件种子登记册（涵盖司法幻觉、金融冒充、合成身份、医疗软件监管、公共福利管理、平台审核等）进行压力测试；以Meta-印度事件作为集中压力测试案例；绘制覆盖55个联邦部委的2026-2050年法律覆盖地图。
AI.findings: 现行印度AI治理呈碎片化，存在"应用层治理赤字"；GRDSS类别可有效识别需强监管的系统；五层法典和机构分工方案（AIGEG设定战略方向、TPEC维护共同定义、IndiaAI安全研究所发展评估能力、现有行业监管者执行领域细则）可实现分层治理；Meta-India事件揭示了问责倒置问题，需增加证据保全、互操作事件转介、风险分级关键账户保证、双重故障审计、印度运营记录人、控制母公司责任等机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"AI应用层治理赤字"概念，区分数据合法性、内容真实性、模型治理与决策/部署治理的不同层次；提出GRDSS作为新的受监管类别；构建五层AI应用法典作为治理制度架构；引入"问责倒置"概念描述跨国AI平台治理中的责任错配。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度联邦政府提供可操作的治理蓝图：明确各机构（AIGEG、TPEC、IndiaAI安全研究所、CERT-In）职能分工；制定国家最低规则与邦级合作协调的联邦实施方案；提出低风险创新默认许可、高风险应用比例化审查的规制原则；发布2026-2050年法律覆盖地图，指导未来立法资源配置。

title: Adaptive Portfolio Positioning under Market Volatility: A Forward-Looking Regime-Switching Approach Using the VIX Term Structure

detail.title: Adaptive Portfolio Positioning under Market Volatility: A Forward-Looking Regime-Switching Approach Using the VIX Term Structure
detail.abstract: Large maximum drawdowns permanently impair the terminal wealth of long-horizon investors, even when subsequent average returns recover. We present a transparent, implementable dynamic risk-overlay framework that combines daily regime detection with weekly-scale execution constraints. A two-state Markov-switching GJR-GARCH model with time-varying transition probabilities driven by lagged log(VIX) and the VIX term-structure inversion generates forward-looking stress probabilities. These probabilities are mapped into continuous equity weights through a soft threshold rule, subject to a five-trading-day minimum holding period and stylized tax considerations. Under strict expanding-window out-of-sample evaluation on SPY (2010-2026), the overlay reduces annualized volatility by approximately 25 percent and maximum drawdown by roughly six percentage points relative to buy-and-hold, while keeping turnover modest and preserving a comparable Sharpe ratio. A three-factor extension that adds the lagged change in log(VIX) does not improve risk metrics or coverage of major stress episodes. The binding constraint on out-of-sample risk reduction is frequently the mapping from probability to position size rather than the precise specification of the transition equation. The contribution is a practical downside-protection rule that limits large drawdowns without claiming superior risk-adjusted returns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个透明、可实施的动态风险叠加框架，结合日度体制检测与周度执行约束，利用马尔可夫转换GJR-GARCH模型（由滞后VIX和VIX期限结构倒挂驱动的时变转移概率）生成前瞻性压力概率，并通过软阈值规则映射为连续权益权重。在SPY 2010-2026的严格扩张窗口样本外评估中，该框架将年化波动率降低约25%，最大回撤减少约6个百分点，同时保持适度换手率和相当的夏普比率。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个透明、可实施的动态风险叠加框架，以限制长期投资者面临的大幅最大回撤，同时不牺牲风险调整后的收益？
AI.motivation: 大幅最大回撤会永久损害长期投资者的终期财富，即使后续平均收益恢复也无法弥补。因此需要一种实用的下行保护规则来限制大幅回撤，但不声称提供优于市场的风险调整收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫转换GJR-GARCH模型（两状态、时变转移概率）、风险叠加框架、软阈值规则、期权隐含波动率信息（VIX及其期限结构）
AI.method: 两状态马尔可夫转换GJR-GARCH模型，时变转移概率由滞后log(VIX)和VIX期限结构倒挂驱动；生成前瞻性压力概率后通过软阈值规则映射为连续权益权重；叠加五日最低持有期和税收考量；采用严格扩张窗口样本外评估（SPY 2010-2026），并设置三因子扩展（加入滞后log(VIX)变动）作为稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）该框架在样本外将年化波动率降低约25%，最大回撤减少约6个百分点，同时保持适度换手率和可比的夏普比率；（2）三因子扩展（加入滞后log(VIX)变动）并未改善风险指标或主要压力事件覆盖率；（3）样本外风险降低的约束主要来自概率到仓位规模的映射，而非转移方程的具体设定。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了样本外风险降低的瓶颈环节——即概率到仓位规模的映射比转移方程的具体设定更为关键，为动态风险管理文献提供了关于约束来源的重要洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个透明、可实施的下行保护规则，能够有效限制大幅回撤（波动率降低25%，最大回撤减少6个百分点），且换手率适度，适合长期投资者在实际投资中部署。

title: Conformal Kelly: Conformal Prediction Intervals as the Scale in Fractional Kelly Position Sizing
affiliations: Synthica Research Group

detail.title: Conformal Kelly: Conformal Prediction Intervals as the Scale in Fractional Kelly Position Sizing
detail.abstract:
Conformal prediction has traditionally been used to quantify the uncertainty of a prediction. We put that uncertainty to a second use, combining it with fractional Kelly to size portfolio positions: we use a 75% interval, shrinking the position as the range widens and growing it as the range narrows. On a fixed six-year development window (2016–2021), with trading costs, a one-day execution lag, and strict leverage caps, this compounds at 28.5% annualised net log growth at a Sharpe ratio of 1.34, compared with 15.9% for simply holding the S&P 500 and 21–22% for passive portfolios run at the same leverage.

 Our main finding contradicts the existing literature's advice for conformal prediction on time series data. Every tweak that makes the interval adapt faster to current market conditions — adaptive conformal inference, volatility scaling, recency weighting — costs us 0.7 to 5.3 percentage points of annual growth, and the simplest method wins: slow, unweighted, per-asset rolling conformal quantiles. When an interval sizes a position rather than describing a single forecast, the stability of its width matters more than its local sharpness.

 Because these numbers came from an autonomous LLM-agent search over roughly 200 configurations, we sealed all data from 2022 onward before starting and pre-registered our final configurations, benchmarks, and interpretation rules. Calibration held out of sample: 0.745 coverage against a 0.750 target, straight through the 2022 bear market (about 65–260 effective observations after overlap and cross-asset correlation). Growth did not: the two configurations earned 8.5% and 7.0% per year, below the passive benchmarks, and a pre-registered hindsight benchmark beat them on raw growth while taking a 46% drawdown. Every outcome is reported as pre-registered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将共形预测（conformal prediction）的不确定性区间与分数Kelly准则结合用于投资组合仓位管理，在2016-2021年开发窗口上实现了28.5%的年化净对数增长和1.34的夏普比率。但作者发现主要发现与现有文献关于时间序列共形预测的建议相悖：更快的自适应区间调整反而损害收益，最简单的慢速、非加权滚动共形分位数方法最优。通过预注册和LLM智能体搜索进行严格验证后，样本外校准良好但增长表现未达标，两种配置均低于被动基准。
AI.research_question: 共形预测的不确定性区间如何与分数Kelly准则结合用于投资组合仓位管理？何种共形预测变体在仓位管理场景下表现最佳？
AI.motivation: 传统上共形预测仅用于量化预测的不确定性，本文探索将这种不确定性二次利用——用区间宽度来动态调整投资仓位，将不确定性转化为实际的资金配置决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共形预测理论（含自适应共形推断、波动率缩放等变体）、分数Kelly准则（fractional Kelly criterion）
AI.method: 利用自主LLM智能体搜索约200种配置，采用75%共形预测区间结合分数Kelly进行仓位调整；设置固定六年开发窗口（2016-2021），涵盖交易成本、一天执行滞后和严格杠杆上限；从2022年起封存数据，预注册了最终配置、基准和解释规则。
AI.findings: （1）在开发窗口内，该方法实现28.5%年化净对数增长，夏普比率1.34，优于S&P 500（15.9%）和同杠杆被动组合（21-22%）；（2）与现有文献建议相反，使区间更快适应当前市场条件的调整（自适应共形推断、波动率缩放、近期加权）反而损失0.7-5.3个百分点的年增长，最简单的慢速无加权每资产滚动共形分位数方法最优——当区间用于尺寸化仓位而非描述单一预测时，区间宽度的稳定性比局部锐度更重要；（3）样本外校准良好（0.745覆盖率 vs 0.750目标），穿越2022年熊市，但增长未达预期：两种配置年化收益8.5%和7.0%，低于被动基准，预注册的后见基准在原始增长上胜过但伴随46%回撤。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了现有文献中关于时间序列共形预测应更快适应市场条件的建议，提出在仓位管理场景下区间宽度的稳定性（而非局部锐度）更为关键的新观点；将共形预测从单纯的不确定性量化拓展到投资决策领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种结合共形预测和分数Kelly的投资策略框架，并建立了严格的预注册+LLM智能体搜索+样本外验证的方法论流程，对量化投资组合管理实践有直接参考价值；同时警示了样本内表现优异但样本外增长可能不达标的现实风险。

title: Deepfaking Markets
affiliations: UBS Investment Bank

detail.title: Deepfaking Markets
detail.abstract: A deepfake is AI-generated content that appears authentic while violating the structure reality imposes. We ask the same question of the neural networks now used to construct financial markets: can a market be deepfaked? We show that under soft penalties the fake persists; under hard constraints it migrates; and in generative architectures it becomes structural. A deepfaked market is therefore not an approximation error but an optimum of the wrong hypothesis space. The remedy is architectural rather than algorithmic: build no-arbitrage into the network itself, leaving no coordinate in which the fake can hide.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了金融市场是否可以被"深度伪造"（deepfake）的问题。研究表明，在软惩罚下虚假信息持续存在，在硬约束下虚假信息会迁移，在生成式架构中虚假信息会变为结构性特征。深度伪造的市场不是近似误差，而是错误假设空间中的最优点。解决方案应是架构层面的而非算法层面的：将无套利约束内置于神经网络本身，不留任何可供虚假信息隐藏的坐标。
AI.research_question: 用于构建金融市场的神经网络是否可以被"深度伪造"？即AI生成的内容是否可能在金融架构中制造看似真实但违反现实结构约束的虚假市场？
AI.motivation: 深度伪造技术在内容生成领域已被广泛认知，但同样的问题在金融市场的神经网络建模中尚未被系统研究。随着神经网络越来越多地被用于构建金融市场，需要审视这些模型是否会生成违背市场现实结构约束的"伪市场"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度伪造理论（deepfake theory）、无套利原则（no-arbitrage principle）、假设空间理论（hypothesis space theory）、结构现实主义（structural realism）
AI.method: 通过比较三种约束机制下虚假信息的演化：软惩罚（soft penalties）、硬约束（hard constraints）和生成式架构（generative architectures），分析虚假市场信息在不同约束条件下的表现形式。
AI.findings: （1）在软惩罚下，虚假市场信息持续存在；（2）在硬约束下，虚假信息会迁移到其他维度；（3）在生成式架构中，虚假信息会嵌入为结构性问题。深度伪造的市场本质上是在错误的假设空间中的最优解，而非简单的近似误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 将深度伪造概念引入金融市场建模领域，提出"深度伪造市场"这一新概念；揭示了虚假市场信息在不同约束机制下的演化规律；提出解决方案应从根本上改变网络架构而非依赖算法层面的修正。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融AI系统设计提供架构性指导：应将无套利约束（no-arbitrage）直接内置于神经网络架构中，而非作为外部惩罚或约束条件，从而从根源上消除虚假市场信息的产生空间。

title: Measuring Epistemic Debt in the Age of AI: A Stock-Flow Framework for Claim Production and Verification Capacity

detail.title: Measuring Epistemic Debt in the Age of AI: A Stock-Flow Framework for Claim Production and Verification Capacity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, institutional affiliations, or other competing interests that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research presented in this paper. The research was conducted independently and received no external funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is a conceptual and methodological working paper and did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, clinical interventions, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Instruments built to track artificial intelligence measure one side of a two-sided ledger: how fast machines can produce claims, but not how fast humans and institutions can check them. This paper develops a stock-flow measurement framework for that neglected side. It separates three quantities that earlier discussions of the generation-verification gap conflate: an Epistemic Pressure Ratio, defined as the flow of risk-weighted claim production over quality-adjusted verification capacity; an unresolved verification backlog, which accumulates whenever pressure exceeds one and decays as claims expire or are withdrawn; and an Epistemic Debt Index, defined as the backlog divided by current verification capacity and interpretable as the time required to clear the backlog at present throughput. Claims are counted in risk-weighted units that reflect exposure, potential harm, and novelty, and verification is graded on a five-level hierarchy from screening to adjudication, so that a shallow automated check is not counted as the equivalent of an independent replication. The framework generalizes prior artifact-level and claim-level uses of the term epistemic debt to the level of sectors, organizations, and knowledge systems, and it is offered as a measurementdevelopment protocol: five falsifiable hypotheses are stated with identification strategies, a numerical illustration in scientific publishing is presented under three labelled scenarios rather than as an estimate, and a single-sector empirical pilot is specified as the necessary next step. The central claim is deliberately conditional: in knowledge-intensive domains where AI scales claim production faster than independent checking, the socially realized value of AI may become constrained less by generation capability than by verification capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个"存量-流量"测量框架，用于衡量人类和机构验证AI生成声明能力的不足。该框架区分了三个概念：认识论压力比率（风险加权声明生产流/质量调整验证能力）、未解决验证积压（压力>1时累积）、以及认识论债务指数（积压/当前验证能力，可解释为清除积压所需时间）。论文提出了五个可证伪假设、一个科学出版领域的数值说明（三个标注情景），并指定单部门实证试点作为下一步。
AI.research_question: 如何测量知识密集型领域中AI声明生成速度与人类/机构验证能力之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 现有追踪AI的仪器只衡量了"两方账本"的一侧——机器能以多快速度产生声明，却没有衡量人类和机构能以多快速度核验这些声明。此前关于"生成-验证差距"的讨论混淆了多个不同的量，缺乏一个统一的测量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存量-流量测量框架（stock-flow measurement framework），将认识论债务概念从人工制品层和声明层推广到部门、组织和知识系统层面。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发与测量协议设计：提出三个核心定量指标（Epistemic Pressure Ratio、验证积压、Epistemic Debt Index）；声明采用风险加权单位计数；验证按五级层次（从筛查到裁决）分级；提出五个可证伪假设并附带识别策略；在科学出版领域给出三个标注情景下的数值说明（而非估计）；指定单部门实证试点。
AI.findings: 核心主张是有条件的：在知识密集型领域，当AI扩展声明生产的速度快于独立核验时，AI的社会实现价值受验证能力而非生成能力的约束更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了此前关于"生成-验证差距"的讨论中混淆的多个量；将"认识论债务"概念从更早期的人工制品/声明层面推广到部门、组织和知识系统层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个测量发展协议：含五个可证伪假设和识别策略，数值说明采用带标签情景而非估计值形式，并明确了单部门实证试点作为必要下一步，为后续实证研究提供了可操作的起点。

title: Quantifying Life-Cycle Carbon Intensity in Extra-Heavy Oil Infrastructure: A Coupled Multi-Scale Remote Sensing and Process Thermodynamics Framework

detail.title: Quantifying Life-Cycle Carbon Intensity in Extra-Heavy Oil Infrastructure: A Coupled Multi-Scale Remote Sensing and Process Thermodynamics Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Quantifying the lifecycle carbon intensity (CI) of extra-heavy oil production in data-limited, institutionally opaque environments represents a major challenge for global decarbonization policy. Existing lifecycle assessment (LCA) tools rely either on uncalibrated bottom-up engineering assumptions or on isolated top-down satellite observations. Here, we introduce a coupled multi-scale analytical framework that integrates satellite-derived flare combustion efficiency (ηcomb) with first-principles process thermodynamics, reservoir hydraulics, and probabilistic Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation. Applying this framework to Venezuela's Petrozuata project in the Orinoco Heavy Oil Belt, we reconstruct the carbon intensity profile from wellhead to upgrader gate across design (1998), operational baseline (2014), and preliminary current (2024) states. Results demonstrate that operational deterioration and compressor failures increased carbon intensity from a design baseline of 65.0–72.0 gCO2eq/MJ (centered at 69.0 gCO2eq/MJ) to a Monte Carlo mean of 121.7 gCO2eq/MJ (95% CI: 114.2–129.6), rising to 128.7 gCO2eq/MJ when adjusted for omitted maritime diluent transport and satellite-detected fugitive emissions. Gas flaring (+21.5 gCO2eq/MJ increment) and diluent import logistics (+12.2 gCO2eq/MJ increment) account for 64% of the total +52.7 gCO2eq/MJ emission escalation. Thermodynamic exergy analysis confirms that a 6–10 percentage-point decline in delayed coker exergy efficiency directly accounts for an additional 7.0 gCO2eq/MJ in upgrader emissions. Systematic comparison reveals that the coupled framework resolves structural reporting discrepancies (Φprod) that uncoupled bottom-up models (e.g., OPGEE) and pure remote sensing platforms (e.g., Kayrros) omit. Targeted technical interventions—flare gas recovery, diluent circuit optimization, and upgrader catalyst restoration—could reduce carbon intensity by 30–38% (75–85 gCO2eq/MJ), eliminating $3.50–$5.00/bbl in Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) tax exposure ($98.5M/yr savings at 60,000 bpd throughput) with an investment payback period of 3–5 years. This study provides a defensible, transparent, and replicable methodology for lifecycle emissions accounting in high-carbon, data-constrained hydrocarbon provinces.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种耦合多尺度分析框架，整合卫星观测的燃烧效率与第一性原理过程热力学、储层水力学及蒙特卡洛不确定性传播，用于量化数据稀缺、制度不透明环境下超重油生产的全生命周期碳强度。以委内瑞拉Orinoco重油带的Petrozuata项目为案例，发现其碳强度从1998年设计基准的69 gCO2eq/MJ升至2024年的121.7 gCO2eq/MJ（调整后达128.7），并提出针对性干预措施可降低碳强度30-38%。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据有限且制度不透明的环境中量化超重油生产的全生命周期碳强度（CI）并识别其排放驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 现有生命周期评估工具要么依赖未校准的自下而上工程假设（如OPGEE），要么依赖孤立的自上而下卫星观测（如Kayrros），两者均存在结构性报告偏差，无法准确反映高碳、数据受限油气产区的真实碳强度，从而制约全球脱碳政策的制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一性原理过程热力学、储层水力学、热力学火用（exergy）分析、蒙特卡洛不确定性传播、生命周期评估（LCA）理论
AI.method: 构建耦合多尺度分析框架，整合卫星反演燃烧效率（ηcomb）与第一性原理过程模型、储层水力学模型及概率性蒙特卡洛模拟，对委内瑞拉Petrozuata项目从井口到改质厂门进行全生命周期碳强度重构（1998年设计、2014年运营基线、2024年初步现状三个时期），并与OPGEE和Kayrros等非耦合方法进行系统对比。
AI.findings: 运营恶化和压缩机故障使碳强度从设计基线69.0 gCO2eq/MJ升至蒙特卡洛均值121.7 gCO2eq/MJ（95%CI: 114.2-129.6），调整海运稀释剂运输和卫星检测逃逸排放后达128.7 gCO2eq/MJ。天然气火炬（+21.5）和稀释剂进口物流（+12.2）占总增量的64%。延迟焦化火用效率下降6-10个百分点额外贡献7.0 gCO2eq/MJ。针对性的火炬气回收、稀释剂回路优化和催化剂修复可将碳强度降低30-38%，消除每桶3.50-5.00美元的CBAM税收风险（年节省9850万美元）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将卫星遥感与第一性原理热力学模型进行耦合集成，构建了可解决结构性报告偏差（Φprod）的多尺度碳排放核算框架，弥补了纯自下而上模型和纯遥感平台各自的方法论缺陷，为数据受限环境下的生命周期碳排放核算提供了可辩护、透明、可复制的方法论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高碳、数据受限油气产区的碳排放核算提供了实操性方法论；量化了CBAM合规风险及减排经济收益（年省9850万美元，投资回收期3-5年）；为政策制定者和投资者提供了具体的技术干预优先级（火炬气回收、稀释剂优化、催化剂修复）及其减排潜力和经济可行性评估。
