AI.motivation: 大语言模型已开始部署在生产级道路车辆中，但现行监管框架是为确定性软件设计的——验证结果被视为工件的属性而非从中抽取的一个样本。应用文献提出了各种保证框架，假设现有路线只需适配，但本文质疑这一假设是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Butler和Finelli以及Littlewood和Strigini的经典软件可靠性不可行性论证；汽车型式认证（type approval）的保证方法论框架；生成式组件的概率性行为模型。
AI.method: 三种方法对应三类主张：(1)分层语料库的定向内容分析——考察标准假设什么；(2)闭式推导——考察测试能确立什么；(3)解析建模——考察架构性替代方案需要什么。
AI.findings: 识别出生成式组件与汽车型式认证预设的保证方法之间存在六种结构性不匹配。零失效声明在最高完整度级别需要约3×10⁸次试验。经典论证假设明确定义的失败谓词，而生成式组件移除了这一假设。架构性遏制是唯一可行路线，但其可行性条件β<r*/p被共享训练基底的监控器以三到四个数量级失败。该结果适用于可枚举危害划分的执行危害，不适用于危险语句。49项控制目录证明衍生要求可联合满足，但不证明目录本身正确。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典软件可靠性不可行性结果（Butler-Finelli、Littlewood-Strigini）扩展到生成式组件语境，通过移除"明确定义的失败谓词"假设来收紧该结果，识别出第二重障碍；为架构性遏制路线提供了量化可行性条件的闭式表达。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、汽车制造商和AI安全工程师提供实证证据：现有型式认证保证路线对LLM不可行，架构性遏制是唯一可行路径；给出量化可行性条件（β<r*/p）用于评估监控方案的可行性；提供49项控制目录作为衍生要求可满足性的验证示例。

title: Mobility Fees and Housing Markets: Fee Design, Statutory Liability, and Capitalization

detail.title: Mobility Fees and Housing Markets: Fee Design, Statutory Liability, and Capitalization
detail.abstract: Impact fee debates turn on the rate. This paper shows the rate is the least consequential feature of the charge, and that the features doing the real work are invisible in the parcel and GIS data such evaluations rely on. Because Hillsborough County, Florida publishes its schedule, the effect of its 2016 mobility fee can be bounded before it is estimated: $6,368 against a mean affected price of $349,000, or 1.8% of value. Using 148,000 repeat single-family transactions from 2010 to 2024, I estimate the fee’s incidence at the boundary between charged and exempt jurisdictions, where a differentiated charge should bite hardest. The design rules out relative price declines larger than 1.5–2.5%, excluding the large boundary gradients such fees are assumed to generate, and no supply response is detectable at any bandwidth. The full-sample estimate of −6.9% is four times the statutory maximum and lies on a pre-trend beginning in 2010; it measures jurisdictional divergence, not the fee. Reading the ordinance explains what does move: rates are set on an assessment geography distinct from the districts the county publishes, so cross-district variation prices infrastructure spending rather than development, and grandfathering deferred liability to April 2021, so construction responds at announcement rather than at the effective date. Three implications follow for jurisdictions setting these charges. Fee levels are a weak affordability lever in either direction. Grandfathering length, not the effective date, determines when incidence arrives, and long transition windows generate a permitting rush while deferring revenue. And a flat per-unit schedule is regressive in value terms—3.2% of a $200,000 home against 1.1% of a $600,000 one—which follows from the rate schedule alone and is the fee’s clearest distributional consequence.

AI.tldr: 本文利用佛罗里达州希尔斯堡县2016年交通影响费的准自然实验，通过148,000笔重复单户住宅交易数据，在收费与豁免司法辖区的边界处估计该项费用的归宿（incidence）。研究发现费用的比率（rate）其实是最不重要的特征，真正起作用的是评估地理划分、祖父条款（grandfathering）等隐形制度特征。全样本-6.9%的估计实则衡量的是司法辖区之间的分歧趋势而非费用效应，真实效应被界定在-1.5%至-2.5%以内。文章还揭示固定费率制在价值维度上是累退的（regency），并提出三项政策启示。
AI.research_question: 影响费（impact fee）的费率是否是决定其经济归宿的关键特征？真正起作用的制度因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 影响费辩论的核心聚焦于费率高低，但作者认为费率或许是最不重要的特征，而评估所依赖的地块与GIS数据中无法观测的制度细节（如评估地理划分、祖父条款）才是真正起作用的力量。通过对Hillsborough县公布的费率表进行事前推断，可在估计前界定效应上限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 影响费归宿理论（incidence theory）；边界断点设计（boundary discontinuity design）；事前费率上限界定（ex-ante bounding based on published fee schedule）
AI.method: 利用2010-2024年148,000笔重复单户住宅交易数据，在收费与豁免辖区边界处使用断点/边界回归设计（boundary design），对比不同带宽下的价格效应与供给反应；结合法规文本阅读（ordinance reading）识别真正起作用的制度机制。
AI.findings: (1) 费率上限为平均受影响价格的1.8%（$6,368/$349,000），设计排除了大于1.5-2.5%的相对价格下降，否定了影响费通常被认为能产生的较大边界梯度；(2) 任何带宽下均无可检测的供给反应；(3) 全样本-6.9%的估计是法定最大值的四倍，但这一效应源于2010年开始的先定趋势，衡量的是司法辖区分歧而非费用效应；(4) 真正起作用的是评估地理（assessment geography）与公布的地区不同，导致跨区变化定价的是基础设施支出而非开发；祖父条款将负债推迟至2021年4月，因此建设在公告时而非生效日作出反应；(5) 固定每单位费率在价值维度上是累退的——对$200,000住宅为3.2%，对$600,000住宅仅1.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 证明影响费研究中常见的全样本估计可能将辖区分歧趋势误认为费用效应，须结合事前界定与边界设计进行归因；(2) 揭示费率并非影响费归宿的决定性维度，评估地理与祖父条款等制度细节才是关键机制；(3) 系统性地展示固定费率制的累退性源自费率表本身，为影响费分配效应的理论分析提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为设定影响费的司法辖区提供启示：费率水平在任一方向都是薄弱的可负担性杠杆；(2) 祖父条款的长度而非生效日期决定归宿何时到来，较长的过渡窗口会引发许可潮并推迟收入； (3) 固定每单位费率表在价值意义上是累退的，这是费率表本身最清晰的分配后果，政策制定者应予以关注。

title: The Geography of Research: The Trade-Off Between Knowledge Production and Access
affiliations: Queen's University - Department of Economics and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Geography of Research: The Trade-Off Between Knowledge Production and Access
detail.abstract: Research activity generates highly localized positive spillovers, yet in the U.S. it has become increasingly spatially misaligned with population and economic activity as people moved away from legacy cities where major research institutions remain anchored. Reallocating researchers toward population centers could broaden local access to knowledge but may reduce knowledge production if legacy institutions or large research clusters raise researcher output. The spatial reallocation of researchers therefore entails a trade-off between gains in knowledge access and losses in knowledge production. To quantify the knowledge production loss from reallocation, we use bibliographic data to separate individual effects from location effects and show that location effects account for substantial differences in research output across locations. Our instrumental-variables estimates provide robust evidence of own-institution agglomeration effects but weaker evidence of external-cluster effects. We then incorporate these estimates into counterfactual reallocations and show that marginally reallocating researchers toward large metropolitan areas with relatively little research activity can plausibly raise aggregate output because the associated knowledge production losses are modest and can be offset by small access gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国研究活动的空间错配问题。研究发现，研究活动产生高度本地化的正溢出效应，但研究人员分布与人口、经济活动日益错位。通过文献计量数据分离个人效应与区位效应，本文量化了研究人员空间重新配置带来的知识生产损失，发现机构内集聚效应显著但外部集群效应较弱，边际上向大都市区重新配置研究人员可提高总产出。
AI.research_question: 研究人员向人口中心重新配置会带来知识生产损失吗？这种损失有多大？在知识获取增益与知识生产损失之间存在怎样的权衡？
AI.motivation: 美国研究活动产生高度本地化的正溢出效应，但研究人员的地理分布与人口和经济活动日益错位——人口从传统老城迁出，而主要研究机构仍锚定在这些老城。重新配置研究人员可能拓宽知识获取渠道，但也可能因失去传统机构的集聚效应而降低知识产出，因此需要量化这一权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚经济理论（agglomeration economies），包括自有机构集聚效应（own-institution agglomeration effects）与外部集群效应（external-cluster effects）；知识溢出理论（知识生产的地方化正溢出）。
AI.method: 使用文献计量数据（bibliographic data）分离个体效应与区位效应；采用工具变量（IV）方法估计集聚效应；构建反事实（counterfactual）模拟评估研究人员重新配置的知识生产影响。
AI.findings: （1）区位效应解释了不同地点研究产出的显著差异；（2）自有机构集聚效应显著，但外部集群效应较弱；（3）向研究活动较少的大型都市区边际重新配置研究人员，由于知识生产损失适中且可被小幅知识获取增益抵消，总体上可提高总产出。
AI.theory_contributions: 将集聚经济理论引入科研生产力研究，区分了自有机构集聚效应与外部集群效应，为理解研究活动的空间组织与集聚经济的来源提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究资源配置政策提供依据，表明研究者向人口中心适度重新配置不会造成严重的知识生产损失，反而可能通过扩大知识获取提升总体福利，对研究投资和区域科技政策具有参考价值。

title: Earth Beneath the Grid: An Integrated Geospatial–Environmental Framework for Sustainable Petroleum Resource Assessment in Hydrologically and Ecologically Sensitive Terrains

detail.title: Earth Beneath the Grid: An Integrated Geospatial–Environmental Framework for Sustainable Petroleum Resource Assessment in Hydrologically and Ecologically Sensitive Terrains

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Md. Nimur Rahman Durjoy, is affiliated with Dr. Afiluddin College, Baganchra, Jashore. This research was conducted as an independent academic study and received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author declares that there are no financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the findings or interpretations presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is a conceptual and literature-based study that does not involve any primary data collection from human subjects, animals, or patients. No ethics approval was required, and the study was conducted in accordance with established academic research standards.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares that no funding was received for the conduct of this research. The study was carried out as an independent academic endeavor without financial support from any external organization, government agency, or commercial entity.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve any clinical trial, medical intervention, or patient-related research.

detail.abstract: A petroleum reservoir does not exist in isolation. It is a geological record shaped by deep time, a piece of a hydrological system, a habitat (or a threat to one), and an engineering problem, all at once. Yet these four ways of looking at a basin are rarely brought together in a single study. This paper builds and tests an Integrated Geospatial-Environmental Framework (IGEF) that pulls six recognized specialties into one working architecture: geology, geography, cartography and geoinformatics, hydrometeorology, ecology and nature management, and petroleum engineering. The goal is to assess petroleum-bearing basins that also happen to sit in ecologically and hydrologically sensitive terrain. Using a structured literature synthesis, a conceptual systems model, and a semi-quantitative multi-criteria illustration, we show how reservoir characterization data, remote-sensing land-cover and lineament maps, precipitationrunoff regimes, groundwater vulnerability indices, and biodiversity sensitivity layers can sit inside one shared spatial data infrastructure. That infrastructure can then support exploration siting, environmental impact assessment, and long-term land stewardship. What the review turns up is a fairly persistent gap: geological and engineering models of hydrocarbon potential get built without much reference to hydrometeorological and ecological risk layers. The result is a set of spatial decision products that are each individually solid but don't fit together. Our results suggest an interdisciplinary, GIS-anchored workflow narrows this gap in a way you can actually measure, by exposing conflicts between high-prospectivity zones and groundwaterrecharge or ecologically sensitive areas before drilling decisions get locked in. From there we draw out policy implications for basin-scale licensing, environmental governance, and the kind of institutional design that turns resource wealth into lasting development instead of the welldocumented "resource curse." The larger point is simple: petroleum geoscience works better as a spatial, multi-hazard, multi-stakeholder problem than as a narrowly technical one.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并验证了一个综合地理空间-环境框架（IGEF），将地质学、地理学、制图与地理信息学、水文气象学、生态学与自然管理、石油工程六个专业整合到一个统一的空间数据基础设施中，用于评估位于生态和水文敏感区域的含油气盆地，以弥合油气潜力评估与环境风险分析之间的长期脱节。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够整合地质、水文气象、生态和石油工程等多学科视角的空间决策框架，以更全面地评估位于生态和水文敏感区域的含油气盆地？
AI.motivation: 石油储层同时是地质记录、水文系统的一部分、生态栖息地（或威胁）和工程问题，但这四种视角很少在一项研究中被整合。现有的地质和工程模型在构建油气潜力时很少参考水文气象和生态风险图层，导致各个空间决策产品单独看很扎实但彼此不兼容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合地理空间-环境框架（IGEF）；跨学科系统集成理论；多准则决策分析；空间数据基础设施（SDI）理论
AI.method: 结构化文献综述、概念系统模型、半定量多准则示例分析
AI.findings: 发现了一个持续存在的差距：地质和工程模型在构建油气潜力时缺乏对水文气象和生态风险层的参考。跨学科、以GIS为核心的工作流程可以通过在高前景区域与地下水补给区或生态敏感区域的冲突在钻探决策锁定之前被暴露出来，以可量化的方式弥合这一差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了IGEF框架，将六个专业领域整合到一个共享空间数据基础设施中，论证了石油地质科学应作为空间性、多灾害、多利益相关者问题来对待而非狭隘的技术问题，为跨学科盆地评估提供了理论整合路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为盆地尺度许可、环境治理和制度设计提供政策启示，帮助将资源财富转化为可持续的发展而非"资源诅咒"；支持勘探选址、环境影响评估和长期土地管理决策。

title: Beyond Individual Utility: A Constructivist Grounded Theory of Culturally Embedded Preferences
affiliations: , Forman Christian College and Forman Christian College

detail.title: Beyond Individual Utility: A Constructivist Grounded Theory of Culturally Embedded Preferences

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for this study was obtained from the Institutional Review Board of Forman Christian College University (Approval Number: IRB-858/10-2025) prior to data collection. All participants were informed of the study's purpose and provided written informed consent before participating in the interviews, which included explicit permission for audio recording.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by Forman Christian College University. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial organization, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Traditional behavioral models generally explain decision-making given preferences, paying less attention to how informal institutions shape the preferences individuals bring to economic decisions. Using constructivist grounded theory, this study draws on 32 semi-structured interviews with university students in Pakistan to explore how culturally embedded obligations influence economic trade-offs. The research develops an "economy of sacrifice" framework. This study demonstrates that preferences are not formed in a vacuum; rather, they are socially produced and continually regulated by informal institutions such as family and religious frameworks. First, the Subsistence Mechanism establishes immediate household stability as a primary threshold for economic choice. Through the Economics of Sacrifice, participants frequently prioritized anticipated relational losses over irrecoverable material costs. Individuals exercise Pragmatic Calibration to actively regulate the personal costs of fulfilling social obligations and employ Spiritual Hedging to navigate systemic uncertainty. These findings suggest that behavioral interventions in collectivist contexts may be more effective when they account for institutionally produced preferences rather than assuming stable individual utility.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过建构主义扎根理论，基于对巴基斯坦32名大学生的半结构化访谈，提出"牺牲经济学"框架，揭示非正式制度（家庭和宗教）如何塑造个体经济决策中的偏好，而非假设偏好是先验给定的。
AI.research_question: 非正式制度（如家庭和宗教框架）如何塑造个体带入经济决策的偏好？
AI.motivation: 传统行为模型通常给定偏好来解释决策，忽视了非正式制度如何塑造个体带入经济决策的偏好，存在理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建构主义扎根理论；偏好形成的社会建构视角；非正式制度理论
AI.method: 建构主义扎根理论；32个针对巴基斯坦大学生的半结构化访谈
AI.findings: 提出"牺牲经济学"框架，包含四个机制：(1)生存机制——将家庭即时稳定作为经济选择的首要阈值；(2)牺牲经济学——参与者优先考虑可预期的关系损失而非不可挽回的物质成本；(3)务实校准——个体主动调节履行社会义务的个人成本；(4)精神对冲——个体应对系统性不确定性。偏好并非在真空中形成，而是由非正式制度社会性地生产并持续调节。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统行为模型将偏好视为稳定的先验假设，提出偏好是社会性生产并由非正式制度持续调节的理论框架（"牺牲经济学"），为集体主义情境下的经济决策提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示在集体主义情境中，行为干预若考虑制度性产生的偏好（而非假设稳定的个体效用），可能更有效。

title: The Institutional Cyber Judgement Doctrine: A Theory of Cyber Decision Quality in Complex Organisations

detail.title: The Institutional Cyber Judgement Doctrine: A Theory of Cyber Decision Quality in Complex Organisations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author founded and owns Real Cyber Nation and therefore has a professional and potential commercial interest in the doctrine and assessment instruments discussed. The conceptual argument is intended to stand independently, and the institute’s methods, scoring, reliability and validity remain subject to transparent specification and external challenge.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required. This is a conceptual and documentary paper involving no human participants. It draws solely upon published scholarship, legislation, regulatory materials and publicly available incident documentation. No confidential employer, client or third-party information was used.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern cybersecurity governance is defined not by a shortage of controls, but by an excess of competing standards, frameworks, risk registers, and reporting tools. That proliferation has improved the visibility and administrative tractability of cyber risk, yet it has not removed a recurrent institutional difficulty: organisations remain capable of expressing considerable confidence in propositions that their own operational evidence does not adequately sustain. This paper develops Institutional Cyber Judgement (ICJ) as a second-order organisational capability concerned with the formation, testing, authorisation, preservation and revision of consequential cyber decisions. Whereas controls act upon technical or organisational conditions, ICJ acts upon the claims through which those conditions acquire meaning for decision-makers. The theory treats cyber governance as simultaneously sociotechnical, epistemic and normative. It is sociotechnical because security outcomes emerge from the interaction of engineered systems, human behaviour, institutional incentives and external dependencies. It is epistemic because governance depends upon what the organisation claims to know, how that knowledge was produced, and how uncertainty is represented. It is normative because leaders must decide whether the evidenced condition is acceptable in light of consequence, accountability and residual exposure. The paper distinguishes control, capability, assurance and judgement; develops a claim-relative account of cyber evidence; defines the confidence gap between represented assurance and demonstrated capability; and specifies a multi-level model comprising individual judgement capability, decision-process quality and the wider institutional judgement system. Publicly documented incidents involving Maersk, Equifax, Change Healthcare and UniSuper are used as interpretive case applications rather than causal validation. The analysis is then extended to board governance, artificial intelligence, third-party dependency and post-incident learning. To avoid reducing the theory to retrospective criticism, the paper identifies ex-ante properties of decision quality, addresses the risks of hindsight bias and ritualised measurement, advances six falsifiable propositions, and sets out a research programme covering construct validity, calibration, continuity, belief revision, predictive validity and adoption economics. The paper does not suggest that judgement substitutes for engineering, regulation, control frameworks or audit. Its narrower claim is that these instruments cannot reliably produce resilience where the institution lacks a disciplined mechanism for converting heterogeneous cyber information into evidence-calibrated, consequence-aware, accountable and revisable decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"机构网络判断力"（Institutional Cyber Judgement, ICJ）作为二阶组织能力，聚焦于网络风险决策中"声称"（claims）的形成、检验、授权、维护与修订。该理论将网络治理视为社会技术、认识论与规范性三维度的统一体，区分了控制、能力、保证与判断四个概念，定义了"信心差距"（confidence gap），并构建了包含个体判断能力、决策过程质量与整体机构判断系统的多层次模型。
AI.research_question: 在组织拥有过多网络控制手段、标准与框架的情况下，为何组织仍能对其自身运营证据无法充分支撑的命题表达高度信心？如何构建一种二阶组织能力来弥合"代表的保证"与"展示的能力"之间的信心差距？
AI.motivation: 网络治理的困境不在于控制手段的缺乏，而在于标准、框架与报告工具的过剩。尽管这些工具提升了网络风险的可见性与可管理性，但组织仍经常无法将自身运营证据与所表达的信心对齐，这一顽疾未被现有文献充分理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: ICJ理论将网络治理概念化为三个维度：社会技术维度（安全结果源于工程系统、人类行为、制度激励与外部依赖的互动）、认识论维度（治理取决于组织声称知道什么、知识如何产生及不确定性如何表征）、规范性维度（领导者须依据后果、问责与残余暴露判断证据状况是否可接受）。理论还区分了控制、能力、保证与判断四个概念层次。
AI.method: 理论构建论文。使用Maersk、Equifax、Change Healthcare和UniSuper等公开记录的安全事件作为解释性案例应用（而非因果验证），并进一步将分析扩展到董事会治理、人工智能、第三方依赖与事后学习等场景，提出六个可证伪命题及涵盖构念效度、校准、连续性、信念修订、预测效度与采纳经济学的研究纲领。
AI.findings: 网络治理中的信心差距源于缺乏将异质网络信息转化为"证据校准、后果感知、可问责、可修订"决策的系统性机制。该理论通过前摄性决策质量属性避免沦为回溯性批评，处理了事后偏差与仪式化测量的风险，并提出了六个可证伪的命题以供未来实证检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"判断"（judgement）作为二阶组织能力纳入网络治理理论框架，超越了一阶控制手段的局限；建立了"信心差距"概念，将治理的关注点从条件本身转向赋予条件意义的"声称"；提出了判断的多层次模型，弥合了微观个体认知与宏观制度设计之间的理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会治理、AI治理、第三方依赖管理和事后学习提供了操作性分析框架；通过前摄性决策质量属性和可证伪命题，为从业者提供了超越"事后批评"的评估工具；明确ICJ不替代工程、监管、控制框架或审计，而是为这些工具的有效运作提供必要的制度前提。

title: The One-Minute Edge: Do Nasdaq Futures Lead QQQ? Evidence from a Single-Use Final Holdout

detail.title: The One-Minute Edge: Do Nasdaq Futures Lead QQQ? Evidence from a Single-Use Final Holdout

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses historical financial market data and does not involve human participants, personal data, animals, or clinical research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper documents a small but statistically detectable one-minute forecasting relationship from Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures (MNQ) to QQQ. In a single-use final holdout of 137,472 synchronized observations across 358 trading sessions, adding five prespecified MNQ lags produces an incremental out-of-sample R-squared of 0.1888% beyond QQQ’s own return history. The unadjusted paired squared-loss differential is positive under Newey-West HAC inference at both the minute level (p = 0.0182) and the session-aggregated level (p = 0.0432). Nasdaq futures contain statistically detectable information about the next minute of QQQ returns in a single-use final holdout. In the registered development-sample latency sensitivity, however, the measured advantage disappears when the most recent one-minute MNQ lag is removed, and the relationship has not been shown to survive execution costs. The result is consistent with a rapidly decaying futures-leading forecasting relationship, while remaining compatible with differential responses to common information and other microstructure explanations. The broader contribution is an evidence-governance framework that separates information availability, development, single-use confirmation, and economic implementability. The completed study establishes statistical predictability under a frozen design; it does not establish causal price discovery, executable alpha, or a deployable trading strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了一个微小但统计上可检测的一分钟预测关系：Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100期货（MNQ）对QQQ的预测作用。在137,472个同步观测的单次最终保留样本中，加入五个预设的MNQ滞后项，相较于QQQ自身收益历史，产生了0.1888%的增量样本外R²。然而，这种预测优势在移除最近一分钟MNQ滞后项后消失，且未证明能覆盖执行成本。
AI.research_question: Nasdaq-100期货（MNQ）是否包含关于QQQ下一分钟收益的统计可检测的预测信息？这种预测关系是否具有经济可实施性？
AI.motivation: 期货与现货市场之间的领先-滞后关系是市场微观结构研究的经典问题，但以往研究往往缺乏严格的证据治理框架。本文旨在通过冻结设计（frozen design）和单次最终保留（single-use holdout）来严格检验期货对现货的预测关系是否真实存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论中的信息发现（price discovery）与领先-滞后关系理论；共同信息反应差异假说；证据治理框架（区分信息可得性、开发、单次确认和经济可实施性）
AI.method: 使用358个交易时段、137,472个同步观测数据，在冻结设计下进行预设的预测回归，加入五个MNQ滞后项与QQQ自身历史比较增量样本外R²；采用Newey-West HAC推断在分钟层面和会话聚合层面检验配对平方损失差异。
AI.findings: （1）MNQ对QQQ存在统计上可检测的一分钟预测关系，增量样本外R²为0.1888%；（2）分钟层面p=0.0182、会话聚合层面p=0.0432均显著；（3）但移除最近一分钟MNQ滞后项后预测优势消失；（4）该关系未证明能覆盖执行成本，与快速衰减的期货领先预测关系一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个证据治理框架，严格区分信息可得性、开发阶段、单次确认和经济可实施性四个层面，为金融领域的预测研究提供了方法论标杆；厘清了统计可预测性与因果价格发现、可执行alpha之间的区别。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了关于期货-现货预测关系的现实认知：虽然统计上检测到预测信息，但由于衰减速度快且无法覆盖交易成本，不能直接转化为可部署的交易策略或可执行alpha。

title: The Microstructure of Wealth Transfer in Prediction Markets

detail.title: The Microstructure of Wealth Transfer in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: We analyze 72.1 million transactions executed on Kalshi, a CFTC-regulated prediction market, from June 2021 through November 2025. Aggregate prices are well calibrated, but calibration conceals a persistent internal transfer. Because YES and NO positions at the same cost basis risk identical capital for identical payoffs, neither risk preferences nor misperception of the probability level can price them differently; in the data, YES contracts underperform NO contracts of equivalent cost basis by up to 64 percentage points, concentrated at longshot prices. Demand responds to the affirmative framing of the event itself; we term the premium this flow pays the optimism tax. Decomposing returns by order-book role identifies who collects it: liquidity takers earn mean excess returns of -1.12% per trade while makers earn +1.12%, and maker returns are statistically and economically indistinguishable across position directions, indicating accommodation of biased flow rather than superior forecasting. An exact decomposition of taker losses attributes roughly three-quarters of the transfer to execution within price-direction cells and the balance to the accommodation of directionally tilted flow; selection across price levels, the longshot bias proper, contributes essentially nothing. The transfer ranges from 0.17 percentage points in financial contracts to more than 7 in media and geopolitical categories, and it emerged only after post-election volume growth attracted professional liquidity providers: the maker-taker gap reversed by 5.3 percentage points. The forecasting accuracy of prediction markets derives not from the rationality of individual participants but from a microstructure in which liquidity provision monetizes behaviorally biased order flow.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Kalshi预测市场上7210万笔交易，发现市场整体价格校准良好，但其中隐藏着持续的财富转移：同等成本基础的YES合约表现比NO合约差多达64个百分点，集中在长赔率价格。作者将其归因于"乐观税"——需求方因事件本身的肯定性框架而支付溢价。流动性提供者（做市商）通过容纳这种有偏订单流获利，而非凭借更优预测能力。
AI.research_question: 预测市场的价格校准背后是否隐藏着系统性的内部财富转移？这种转移的来源、机制和受益者是谁？
AI.motivation: 宏观层面预测市场价格校准良好，但微观层面可能掩盖了参与者之间的系统性转移。由于YES和NO合约在相同成本基础上承担相同风险、对应相同收益，风险偏好或概率误判均无法解释两者定价差异，因此该差异必然源于行为层面的定向偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学中的框架效应与乐观偏差；市场微观结构理论（流动性提供与订单流容纳）；长赔率偏见（longshot bias）理论。
AI.method: 利用Kalshi平台2021年6月至2025年11月间的7210万笔交易数据，进行：1）价格校准检验；2）YES/NO合约收益对比分析；3）按订单簿角色（taker/maker）分解收益；4）对taker损失进行精确分解（价格方向单元格内执行、方向倾斜订单流容纳、价格水平选择三部分）。
AI.findings: 1）市场整体校准良好但存在YES合约系统性跑输NO合约的现象，最大差距达64个百分点，集中于长赔率区间；2）流动性接受者平均每笔超额收益-1.12%，做市商+1.12%，且做市商收益与持仓方向无关（说明是容纳偏差流而非预测更优）；3）taker损失约3/4来自价格方向单元格内执行，其余来自方向倾斜流容纳，价格水平选择（长赔率偏见）贡献几乎为零；4）该转移在不同类别差异大（金融合约0.17个百分点至媒体/地缘超7个百分点）；5）该现象在大选后成交量增长吸引专业流动性提供者后才出现，maker-taker差距反转了5.3个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了预测市场价格校准可能掩盖内部财富转移这一结构性盲区；2）提出"乐观税"概念，将框架效应与预测市场定价联系起来；3）证明预测市场准确性源于微观结构（流动性供给对有偏订单流的货币化），而非参与者理性，挑战了有效市场假设在预测市场中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为预测市场参与者提供交易策略启示：理性投资者应优先充当流动性提供者而非接受者；2）为平台设计者提供参考：流动性供给结构显著影响市场效率和财富分配；3）有助于监管者理解CFTC监管下的预测市场微观运作机制。

title: ASRQuant: From Scientific Literature to Auditable Quantitative Decisions and Algorithmic Trading

detail.title: ASRQuant: From Scientific Literature to Auditable Quantitative Decisions and Algorithmic Trading
detail.abstract: Quantitative-finance research often begins in scientific papers but becomes fragmented when researchers manually translate claims into data requirements, features, signals, portfolios, backtests, robustness checks, and deployment decisions. This fragmentation weakens provenance: the final strategy may no longer retain the exact paper page, hypothesis statement, information lag, transformation, execution contract, or decision rule that produced it. We introduce ASRQuant, an open-source Python framework that unifies scientific-paper ingestion, corpusrelative hypothesis discovery, explicit data planning, leakage-aware features, signal and portfolio construction, robust econometric testing, auditable backtesting, multidimensional visualization, decision governance, and order-level paper trading through a one-import public interface. The current artifact parses text-based PDF papers with page-level citations, classifies extracted claims as established, replicated, underexplored, contradictory, or corpus-novel within the supplied corpus, and explicitly warns that corpus novelty is not proof of global novelty. A stateful ResearchProject preserves the complete transformation chain from source excerpts to a machine-readable manifest. The quantitative layer retains local and remote data adapters, stochastic simulation, Monte Carlo, martingale diagnostics, derivative pricing, econometrics, leakage-aware machine learning, portfolio and risk analytics, fixed income, more than 100 visualization entry points, implementation audits, and multidimensional parameter animations. The new paper-trading layer converts target weights into orders and fills while enforcing leverage, position, turnover, cash, short-selling, and drawdown controls; live routing remains disabled unless an explicit external broker adapter is supplied. The artifact is verified by 136 automated tests. ASRQuant remains research software: automated extraction does not establish causality or global novelty, backtests do not guarantee future profitability, and a research-governance decision is not personalized investment advice.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍ASRQuant，一个开源Python框架，旨在解决量化金融研究中从科学论文到最终交易策略的流程碎片化问题。它通过统一接口整合了论文解析、假设发现、数据规划、特征工程、信号构建、组合优化、稳健计量测试、可审计回测、可视化、决策治理和订单级纸面交易等全链条功能，并以状态化的ResearchProject保留完整转换链以确保可追溯性（provenance）。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一框架，将量化金融研究从科学论文解析到最终交易决策的全流程整合起来，并确保整个转换链条的可追溯性（provenance）？
AI.motivation: 量化金融研究通常始于科学论文，但研究者手动将论文中的声明转化为数据需求、特征、信号、投资组合、回测、稳健性检验和部署决策时，过程变得碎片化。这种碎片化削弱了可追溯性——最终策略可能不再保留产生它的确切论文页码、假设陈述、信息滞后、数据变换、执行合约或决策规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文的核心理论框架涉及研究治理（research governance）、可追溯性/溯源（provenance）、语料库相对新颖性（corpus-relative novelty）分类、以及计量经济学检验标准的落地化，属于计算社会科学与金融工程交叉领域的方法论框架。
AI.method: ASRQuant采用系统架构工程方法，构建了一个多层次的Python框架，涵盖：论文解析（文本PDF加页码引用）、声明分类（既有/复现/未充分探索/矛盾/语料库新颖）、状态化ResearchProject保留转换链、量化层（数据适配器、随机模拟、蒙特卡洛、鞅诊断、衍生品定价、计量经济学、防泄漏机器学习、组合与风险分析、固收、100+可视化入口、实现审计、多维参数动画）、以及纸面交易层（目标权重转订单与成交、杠杆/仓位/换手/现金/卖空/回撤控制）。通过136个自动化测试验证。
AI.findings: ASRQuant成功实现了一个一体化的研究到部署框架，能够解析论文并以页码级引用提取声明，将声明分类为五种语料库相对状态，通过ResearchProject维护完整转换链，提供丰富量化分析功能和多维可视化，并支持带完整风险控制的纸面交易。系统通过136项自动化测试验证，且明确声明语料库新颖性不等于全球新颖性，回测不保证未来盈利。
AI.theory_contributions: 该论文的方法论贡献在于：（1）提出了一种解决量化研究碎片化问题的统一框架范式；（2）引入了语料库相对新颖性分类体系，区分既有、复现、未充分探索、矛盾和语料库新颖五种声明状态；（3）通过ResearchProject状态化对象实现了从论文摘录到机器可读清单的完整转换链追溯，为量化研究的可复现性和可审计性提供了新的方法论标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 实际贡献包括：（1）提供了一个开源Python框架，通过单一导入接口即可访问完整研究管道；（2）支持本地和远程数据适配器、超过100个可视化入口、实施审计和多维参数动画；（3）实现了带完整风险控制（杠杆、仓位、换手、现金、卖空、回撤）的纸面交易层，但确保实时路由需外部经纪商适配器；（4）清晰的免责声明——自动化提取不能证明因果性或全球新颖性，研究治理决策不等同于个性化投资建议。

title: The Handoff: Operational Control and Accountability When the Pilot Leaves the Cockpit

detail.title: The Handoff: Operational Control and Accountability When the Pilot Leaves the Cockpit

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Lumis, Inc., an aviation-technology company whose products include PIC, a data-driven flight risk-assessment system. Some categories discussed in this Article — flight-risk assessment, the validation of automated compliance, and diligence on third-party flight-data and deconfliction services — are adjacent to that commercial interest, and the reader should weigh the Article's procurement recommendations against it. The standard proposed here is the standard to which the author holds his own products and is meant to disqualify any tool, including the author's own, that fails it. The analysis is offered in the author's scholarly and professional capacity and is independent of any customer, prospective customer, or commercial relationship of Lumis.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Aviation's fundamental bargain — that safety is purchased through accountable human judgment exercised above the regulatory floor — does not disappear when the pilot leaves the cockpit. It relocates. Beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) and increasingly autonomous operation do not remove the human from aviation; they move the human from the stick to the system: to the remote operator, the fleet supervisor, the software designer who bakes rules into the aircraft, and the person who answers the alert. The 2025 drone executive orders — Unleashing American Drone Dominance and Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty — together with the Federal Aviation Administration's proposed Part 108, are accelerating that handoff faster than the law has decided where accountability lands. Most consequentially, Part 108 would replace individual airman certification for these operations with duties placed on the operating entity, converting a doctrine built around a certificated human in a seat into a corporate-responsibility model. This Article argues that the handoff is manageable, but only if accountability is made to follow control rather than evaporate with the line of sight. It confronts the strongest objection — that mandated human oversight can itself degrade safety — and answers it by redefining oversight as answerability for launching, continuing, and stopping an operation rather than real-time control of each aircraft. Drawing on aviation's existing doctrine of operational control, the human-in-the-loop gradient, and the parallel reckonings of law, medicine, and finance with automated judgment, it defends a rule of meaningful, graded human oversight tied to autonomy level and risk, and offers a procurement due-diligence framework for operators. The line of sight was never the point. An accountable human, present in the system and answerable for the outcome, always was.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了无人机超视距（BVLOS）与自主化运营并未消除航空安全中"人为问责"这一核心机制，而是将问责主体从驾驶员转移至系统层面的多方角色（远程操作员、车队监管者、软件设计师等）。2025年无人机行政令及FAA拟议的Part 108规则加速了这一转移，但法律尚未明确问责归属。文章主张问责应跟随控制权而非视线范围，并提出以"对有意义的、分级的人为监督"取代实时控制的方案，借鉴航空运营控制、人在回路梯度及法律/医学/金融领域对自动化判断的应对经验。
AI.research_question: 在无人机超视距运营和日益自主化的背景下，航空安全问责机制应如何重新定位？Part 108从个人飞行员认证转向企业责任模式后，人为问责应如何设计以保障安全？
AI.motivation: 2025年无人机行政令（Unleashing American Drone Dominance与Restoring American Airspace Sovereignty）及FAA拟议的Part 108正在加速将飞行员从驾驶舱转移到系统层面，但法律尚未决定问责落点。Part 108拟以运营实体责任取代个人航空人员认证，打破了以"持证人在座舱"为核心的传统航空安全教义，亟需理论回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 航空运营控制（operational control）理论、人在回路梯度（human-in-the-loop gradient）、航空"基本契约"概念，并借鉴法律、医学、金融领域对自动化判断问责的平行经验。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：通过对2025行政令与Part 108规则进行文本分析，结合航空既有运营控制教义及跨领域（法律/医学/金融）自动化问责经验的比较论证，提出新的问责框架。
AI.findings: 1）视线消失不等于问责消失，问责应跟随控制权转移；2）针对"人为监督反会降低安全"的最强反对意见，提出将监督重新定义为对"启动、继续、终止运营"的负责（answerability），而非对每架飞机的实时控制；3）提出"有意义的、分级的人为监督"规则，与自主水平和风险挂钩；4）为运营者提供采购尽职调查框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将航空安全问责从"持证人-座舱"传统范式重构为"问责跟随控制"的系统化框架；以"为启动/继续/终止负责"重新定义人为监督，回应了自主系统背景下"人在回路"理论的局限性；将运营控制教义延伸至自主航空领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FAA制定Part 108规则提供问责设计建议；为无人机运营实体提供采购尽职调查框架和分级人为监督的操作指南；为政策制定者理解无人机行政令下的监管转型提供分析依据。

title: From Ocean Dynamics to Plural Normative Orders: Stratification, Localised Mixing, and the Governance of Interfaces: A Preliminary Discussion with Multilingual Democracy and International Organisations as Cases

detail.title: From Ocean Dynamics to Plural Normative Orders: Stratification, Localised Mixing, and the Governance of Interfaces: A Preliminary Discussion with Multilingual Democracy and International Organisations as Cases
detail.abstract: A polity holding several orders of value contains parties whose claims are checkable on different time scales and by different observers, and arrangements of that kind are commonly assessed by measures computed on the whole. This paper takes the ocean as a worked case of a system whose state depends on two constituents transported at rates separated by two orders of magnitude, and carries five mechanisms from it into the analysis of plural normative orders. Each constituent carries an evolution equation and the governing quantity carries none, so the aggregate description possesses no dynamics of its own, and the many processes acting upon the system enter it through four channels only, of which one alters the rule of evolution in place of the state. Advancing the subsystems separately introduces three quantities belonging to neither of them, the order of application, the interval between exchanges, and the operator carrying a flux across the interface, and two computed cases give a separation of 62 per cent of the peak anomaly from sequence alone and a transfer reproducing the shape of a field while removing part of its integral. A combination of two admissible constituents may occupy a state below both, since the map from constituents to the governing quantity is nonlinear. A configuration stable by that quantity may be unstable in its constituents, so an aggregate measure returns a verdict on a condition it has not examined. Plurality may be a maintained condition, with passage across it paid from a separate budget whose conversion into transport is concentrated at a small part of the area. And a system may lack a controller while remaining strongly localised. Carried across under a stated discipline, these yield a description of an international organisation as a site converting a flow already present into passage across an interface, a function distinct from allocation and from the occupation of a centre, and they hold apart the decentring of an arrangement and its dissolution. The mechanisms are entered as constraints upon the assessment of such arrangements, with the standing of a site conditioned on the capacity of those whose orders it converts to reopen its terms.

AI.tldr: 本文以海洋系统为工作案例，将两个数量级差异的传输速率机制迁移到多元规范秩序分析中。作者论证了多元秩序（polity）的聚合描述缺乏自身动力学，主张通过"守恒方程"框架理解子系统间的界面传输，并将五个机制作为评估多元规范秩序的约束条件，最终将国际组织重新概念化为"转换界面的场所"而非分配中心。
AI.research_question: 如何理解多元规范秩序（plural normative orders）中，当子系统以不同时间尺度被不同观察者检验时，整体层面的评估指标是否有效？具体而言，海洋系统中各组分传输速率相差两个数量级的动力学机制，能为多元规范秩序的分析提供什么洞见？
AI.motivation: 现行对多元规范秩序的评估多采用整体性指标（measures computed on the whole），但这种聚合评估可能掩盖子系统层面的动态差异。作者希望通过海洋物理系统的严格类比，揭示聚合指标的根本局限，并提供新的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文借用了物理系统中"演化方程"（evolution equation）概念：每个组分携带各自的演化方程，而整体治理量（governing quantity）不携带演化方程，因而聚合描述没有自身动力学。结合非线性映射、稳定性和局部化等动力学概念，形成分析多元秩序的理论框架。
AI.method: 以海洋为工作案例（worked case），识别出五个可迁移机制：(1)子系统分开推进引入三个第三方量（应用顺序、交换间隔、跨界面算子）；(2)两个计算案例分别展示序列效应占峰值异常的62%及场形状复现；(3)非线性映射导致组合状态可低于两个组分；(4)聚合稳定但组分不稳定；(5)系统无控制器但仍强局部化。然后以明确纪律（stated discipline）将这些机制迁移至国际组织分析。
AI.findings: (1)聚合度量对未检验的条件做出裁决——整体稳定可能掩盖组分不稳定；(2)序列（order of application）本身可解释62%的峰值异常；(3)界面转换可再现场形状但移除部分积分；(4)多元性可能是一种被维持的状态，需要单独预算来支付跨界面通量转换；(5)系统可以无控制器却保持强局部化；(6)国际组织应被视为"转换既有流动为跨界面通道"的场所，这一功能不同于分配，也不同于占据中心；去中心化与解体是不同的过程。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)将物理学中的守恒方程和演化方程框架系统引入多元规范秩序研究；(2)揭示聚合尺度的评估指标在子系统不同时间尺度下存在根本性局限；(3)提出"多元性是被维持的条件"这一新视角，区分去中心化与解体；(4)重新定义国际组织的功能为界面转换而非分配或中心占据。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)为评估多元规范秩序提供约束条件清单（五个机制作为评估的约束）；(2)提出评估场所（国际组织）的正当性应取决于其转换的那些秩序持有者是否有能力重新开启其条款；(3)为理解国际组织的功能定位提供新框架，区别于传统分配功能视角。

title: Beliefs About Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business and University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Beliefs About Government Debt Valuation and Sustainability
detail.abstract: What ultimately supports the market value of U.S. government debt? We measure valuation frameworks: the perceived channels that back debt value. We survey bond investors, registered voters, and economics or finance graduate-degree holders, asking them to allocate debt value across six sources derived from open-ended answers and the literature. Global safe-asset demand and permanent rollover together account for almost half of perceived value in every group, so debt value heavily relies on investor absorption rather than on government resources. Future primary surpluses, the textbook debt backing, receive about 16% even among the graduate-trained; roughly one-third say they provide little or no support. Allocations concentrate within respondents but disperse across them, forming belief archetypes that vary little with fiscal knowledge. A model shows why belief elicitation matters: identical debt quantities and price schedules can conceal differences in saleable public backing and stress-resilient demand, and therefore in debt sustainability. Concern about debt sustainability is widespread, and all three groups put the ten-year crisis odds near 50%. However, among respondents expressing concern, 90% of voters report that it is not decisive in their voting decisions, and 72% of investors report no concrete portfolio change.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查债券投资者、注册选民和经济学/金融学研究生学历持有者，测量他们对美国国债价值来源的认知框架，发现全球安全资产需求和永久性展期占感知价值的近一半，而教科书式的未来主要盈余仅占约16%。尽管对债务可持续性的担忧普遍存在（十年危机概率约50%），但大多数受访者并未将其转化为投票行为或投资组合调整。作者还构建模型说明信念引导的重要性。
AI.research_question: 是什么最终支撑了美国国债的市场价值？不同群体（债券投资者、注册选民、经济学/金融学研究生）如何认知国债价值来源，以及这些认知信念如何影响债务可持续性评估和行为决策？
AI.motivation: 美国国债价值支撑问题是核心宏观金融问题，但此前缺乏对市场参与者实际认知框架的直接测量。现有文献多基于理论假设而非实证测量投资者和公众对债务价值来源的信念，作者希望通过调查揭示真实的信念结构及其对债务可持续性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务价值来源的信念框架（基于开放式回答和文献归纳的六种来源）、信念原型（belief archetypes）分析、债务可持续性的信念模型
AI.method: 调查实验法：对三类群体（债券投资者、注册选民、经济学/金融学研究生）进行问卷调查，要求受访者在六个债务价值来源之间分配权重；结合模型分析信念引导对债务可持续性的影响；对比分析不同群体间的信念分配差异。
AI.findings: 1）全球安全资产需求和永久性展期合计占感知价值的近一半，债务价值主要依赖投资者吸收而非政府资源；2）未来主要盈余仅占约16%，即使在研究生学历群体中，约三分之一认为其提供很少或没有支持；3）受访者内部信念集中但群体间分散，形成不同的信念原型，且与财政知识关系不大；4）债务可持续性担忧普遍（十年危机概率约50%），但90%选民称不影响投票，72%投资者报告无具体投资组合调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统测量不同群体对国债价值来源的感知信念，揭示信念结构的异质性及其与财政知识的弱关联；通过模型证明信念引导的重要性——相同的债务规模和价格表可能掩盖可出售公共支撑和抗压需求的差异，从而影响债务可持续性判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了公众和投资者对债务价值认知的真实图景，表明债务可持续性担忧与实际行动之间存在巨大鸿沟；为财政政策沟通、债务管理和金融稳定评估提供了实证依据，提示需要关注投资者吸收能力而非仅关注财政盈余。

title: The Shape of What One Is: Verification with a Portfolio of Capabilities

detail.title: The Shape of What One Is: Verification with a Portfolio of Capabilities
detail.abstract: An audit firm's capability is not one number but a portfolio of competences that differ in how heavily they are exposed to liability and in how well an inspector can see them. This paper replaces the scalar capability of its companions with a vector and asks what the designer's instruments then do. A collapse lemma marks the boundary: where liability sees only a weighted aggregate, the portfolio model is the scalar model on that aggregate, identically, so the earlier results carry over word for word and new phenomena can enter only through curvature across attributes or through attribute-wise channels. Beyond the boundary, four findings. A convex read is cheap in the middle of an iso-aggregate shell and dear at its ends, so the sender can dissolve specialists into generalists at an unchanged headline-a deviation margin no scalar statistic can detect, and no aggregate quality indicator records. Attribute-wise exposure and attribute-wise legibility act as lights, and capability does not stand in either: it retreats toward the types the light cannot price, and because those types include a specialist in the unlit attribute, squeezing one end of a portfolio inflates the other. The sender's certifying pen points at the light rather than the dark, because a certificate fixes which attribute is priced inside the cell it creates and an illegible residual is priced at the cell's pooled mean-a discount for a genuinely strong type; certified weakness is also an exact cap, written by the sender, on a dial the designer sets. Finally, a rational conjecture is a third light, reaching the refuge only through the cell the sender's own document created, and taxing it until the sender abandons composition altogether and retreats to the diagonal, where a symmetric read collapses to a scalar and there is nothing left to infer. For the designer this replaces a question of intensity with a question of place: uniform legibility is the most destructive configuration in the model, asymmetric legibility preserves more but not monotonically, and the one instrument that reliably destroys the shadow also destroys the capability sheltering there. The designer who lights everything burns everything; the wise designer chooses which shadows to keep.

AI.tldr: 本文用一个能力组合（向量）模型取代传统单一标量能力模型，考察审计事务所能力组合如何受责任暴露和监管可见性的影响。研究发现：当责任仅关注加权总量时，组合模型退化为标量模型（折叠引理）；超出该边界后，能力组合在凸壳上的配置、属性层面的暴露与可见性、认证工具及理性推断共同塑造了事务所的策略性分布行为，且均匀可见性最具破坏性，明智的设计者应选择性保留阴影。
AI.research_question: 当审计事务所的能力从标量扩展为多维能力组合向量时，设计者的监管工具（责任制度、认证、信息可见性）如何影响事务所的能力配置与策略行为？
AI.motivation: 传统模型将事务所能力视为单一标量，无法捕捉能力在不同属性（如审计专业领域）间的差异化配置，也无法解释责任暴露和监管可见性对不同能力类型的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力组合理论；责任与可见性（legibility）理论；认证（certification）机制理论
AI.method: 理论建模：建立能力组合向量模型，通过折叠引理（collapse lemma）界定标量模型有效的边界，并在边界之外进行均衡分析，考察凸壳上的能力配置、属性级暴露与可见性效果、认证均衡及理性推断的动态。
AI.findings: （1）在折叠引理边界内，组合模型与标量模型完全等同；（2）边界之外，凸配置在等总量壳中间廉价、两端昂贵，发送者可无痕地将专家溶解为通才；（3）属性级暴露与可见性促使能力向灯光无法定价的类型退缩，挤压组合一端会膨胀另一端；（4）认证笔指向灯光而非阴影，认证为强类型打折、为弱类型设上限；（5）理性推断作为第三束光，通过认证文件创造的单元格触及避难所，迫使发送者放弃组合退回到对角线（标量）；（6）均匀可见性最具破坏性，非对称可见性保留更多但非单调，能可靠摧毁阴影的工具同时也摧毁其中的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能力从标量拓展为向量组合，建立了折叠引理以精确界定标量模型的适用边界；揭示了能力配置偏差余量（deviation margin）这一标量统计不可检测的现象；论证了可见性与责任暴露作为"灯光"对能力分布的塑造作用；提出"设计者选择保留何种阴影"的规范性洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管设计者提供了能力组合视角下的工具选择指南：均匀可见性配置最具破坏性，明智的监管者应审慎选择哪些能力维度需要照亮、哪些需要保留隐私空间；同时警示了认证工具可能被策略性利用为隐藏弱点的上限和压榨强类型的折扣机制。

title: Does the U.S. Have a Shortage of Affordable Housing? Rethinking Housing Affordability
affiliations: University of Virginia - Department of Economics and Southwestern University - Department of Economics and Business

detail.title: Does the U.S. Have a Shortage of Affordable Housing? Rethinking Housing Affordability
detail.abstract: It is widely argued that the U.S. has a shortage of affordable housing. One fact commonly offered in support of this view is that millions of families are rent burdened by spending more than 30% or 50% of their cash income on housing. These burdens are viewed as being forced on these households due to the lack of lower cost alternatives. This paper provides some simple statistics that challenge this view. It shows that the average lowincome rent burdened household could devote much less of their income to housing by moving to a vacant rental unit located in the same general area with at least as many bedrooms as their current unit. For the average low-income renter, many such vacant units are available. That they have not made this move strongly suggests that they value better housing and neighborhoods more than the consumption of other goods that they sacrificed to get them.

AI.tldr: 本文通过简单统计数据挑战美国可负担住房短缺的观点，发现低收入租金负担家庭可以通过搬到同一区域同卧室数量的空置出租单元来大幅降低住房支出，这表明这些家庭是自愿选择更好的住房和社区，而非被迫承受租金负担。
AI.research_question: 美国低收入家庭的租金负担是否是因缺乏低成本住房选项而被强加的，还是反映了家庭对住房和社区质量的真实偏好？
AI.motivation: 广泛观点认为美国存在可负担住房短缺，支撑证据是数百万家庭将超过30%或50%的现金收入用于住房。本文旨在用简单统计检验这一观点是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者选择理论和住房偏好理论，即家庭在住房消费与其他商品消费之间的权衡取舍。
AI.method: 使用描述性统计分析，比较低收入租金负担家庭当前住房支出与同一地区同卧室数量空置单元的租金水平，并考察可用空置单元数量。
AI.findings: 平均低收入租金负担家庭可通过搬到同一区域、卧室数量相同或更多的空置单元，将住房支出大幅降低；且存在大量此类空置单元可供选择。家庭未搬迁的事实表明他们更看重更好的住房和社区，而非节省下来的其他商品消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"住房短缺导致租金负担"的传统观点，为住房经济学中的消费者选择理论提供了经验证据，表明租金负担可能反映偏好而非供给约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 对公共住房政策的制定具有启示意义，提示政策制定者需重新审视"可负担住房短缺"这一前提假设，并考虑家庭偏好因素在住房政策中的作用。

title: Scalable Machine Learning Architecture for Deploying AI Models in Large-Scale IT Infrastructure

detail.title: Scalable Machine Learning Architecture for Deploying AI Models in Large-Scale IT Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The deployment of machine learning (ML) models within large-scale information technology infrastructure has moved from a bespoke engineering exercise to a discipline governed by well-defined architectural patterns. As organisations scale artificial intelligence (AI) systems from single-model prototypes to fleets of concurrently served models, architectural decisions concerning data pipelines, distributed training, container orchestration, and continuous monitoring determine whether systems remain reliable, costefficient, and maintainable. This review synthesises current research on scalable ML architecture, drawing on peer-reviewed studies published predominantly between 2019 and 2025, supplemented by foundational contributions where conceptually necessary. The review examines layered reference architectures, container-orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, distributed training paradigms, edge-cloud collaborative inference, and operational practices encapsulated in Machine Learning Operations (MLOps). A structured methodology guided the selection and synthesis of sources, and the findings are consolidated into a layered reference architecture, a Kubernetes-based serving topology, and a continuous integration, delivery and training pipeline, each presented as an original figure. Comparative tables summarise servingframework capabilities, parallelism strategies, and mitigation approaches for recurring architectural challenges. The discussion highlights persistent tensions between latency, cost, and scalability, and identifies resource heterogeneity, model drift, and technical debt as the most consequential barriers to sustainable deployment. The review concludes that scalable ML architecture is best understood as a sociotechnical system requiring continuous alignment between infrastructure engineering, data governance, and organisational process, rather than a purely technical optimisation problem.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大规模机器学习架构的综述，系统梳理了2019-2025年间可扩展ML架构的研究，涵盖分层参考架构、Kubernetes容器编排、分布式训练范式、边缘-云协同推理及MLOps实践，并提出可扩展ML架构应被理解为需要基础设施工程、数据治理与组织流程持续对齐的社会技术系统。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和部署可扩展的机器学习架构，以支撑从单模型原型到大规模并发服务模型的AI系统转型？
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在大规模IT基础设施中的部署已从定制化工程实践演变为受明确架构模式支配的学科，组织正将AI系统从单模型原型扩展为大规模并发服务模型，需要系统性地综合当前关于可扩展ML架构的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层参考架构理论、容器编排架构（Kubernetes）、分布式训练范式、边缘-云协同推理架构、Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) 运营实践框架
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，采用结构化方法筛选和综合2019-2025年间同行评审研究及基础性文献贡献，产出包括分层参考架构、Kubernetes服务拓扑、CI/CD/CT流水线等原创图示，以及服务框架能力、并行策略和架构挑战缓解方案的比较表格。
AI.findings: 可扩展ML架构面临延迟、成本与可扩展性之间的持续张力；资源异构性、模型漂移和技术债务是可持续部署的最关键障碍；可扩展ML架构是一个社会技术系统，需要基础设施工程、数据治理与组织流程之间的持续对齐，而非纯粹的技术优化问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可扩展ML架构从单纯的技术优化问题重新概念化为社会技术系统，提出分层参考架构、Kubernetes服务拓扑和CI/CD/CT流水线作为统一分析框架，为理解ML架构中的延迟-成本-可扩展性张力提供了系统化视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的分层参考架构图和Kubernetes服务拓扑图，总结服务框架能力与并行策略的比较表格，识别资源异构性、模型漂移和技术债务等关键障碍及缓解方法，为组织规模化部署ML系统提供实践指导。

title: Medical Conscientious Objection in Latin America 30 Years After Cairo
affiliations: School of Law and

detail.title: Medical Conscientious Objection in Latin America 30 Years After Cairo

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: The author did not receive funding.

keywords: International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD)

detail.abstract: The 2018 and 2020 debates on abortion legislation in Argentina, the decriminalization rulings by the Mexican Supreme Court, the resistance from physicians in Peru, and Chile's unsuccessful attempt at constitutional reform share a common element: the centrality of conscience clauses. These provisions enable healthcare personnel to invoke conscientious objection (CO), allowing them to refuse participation in medical procedures that conflict with their moral or religious beliefs. This phenomenon gained attention following the 1994 International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD), marking a significant global shift from population control towards a rights-based approach to reproductive health and rights. As this framework became more established, the role of CO in healthcare began to change. It became a way out not only for those with religious convictions but also for health professionals concerned about the stigma surrounding sexual and reproductive health services, particularly abortion. In other words, it turned into a means to navigate new professional obligations, and even a strategy to cope with excessive workloads. However, its most problematic use arises when it becomes a political tool, as conservative groups started to invoke CO as a form of resistance to new sexual and reproductive rights laws and as a symbol of ideological cohesion. As a result of its increasingly broad and strategic use, CO has ultimately limited access to timely and quality sexual and reproductive health services for women, trans people, and adolescents. This has led to systemic disruptions in healthcare provision, directly undermining ICPD's commitment to ensuring universal access to reproductive healthcare. This article focuses on abortion, where most CO regulations and legal disputes have surfaced. We examine conscience clauses of Latin America and their impact on healthcare provision, identifying trends and regulatory innovations that go beyond simply transplanting European or North American models. Among these innovations, we highlight the incorporation of institutional safeguards within conscience clauses in some Latin American countries as a novel strategy to mitigate the negative effects of expanded and misused CO. At the same time, however, we also observe that several courts and legislatures in the region have recognized the right to institutional conscientious objection (ICO), a development that has further exacerbated the harmful consequences of CO by allowing entire Special Issue on Critical Perspectives on Post-ICPD Reproductive Health in the Global South. Extended author information available on the last page of the article Studies in Comparative International Development healthcare institutions to refuse services that conflict with their mission or identity. We argue that the expansion of CO clauses, along with the increasing diversity and impact of their applications, not only calls for new regulatory responses, some of which are already emerging in the region, but also demands an empirically informed reconceptualization. Such a reconceptualization must move beyond the classical definitions of CO inherited from the context of compulsory military service in order to fully grasp the current nature of this phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨拉丁美洲医疗领域良心条款（conscience clauses）的演变及其对性与生殖健康服务获取的影响。研究发现，良心拒绝（CO）从宗教驱动的个人权利，演变为应对职业压力、污名化乃至政治抵抗的工具，最终系统性限制了妇女、跨性别者和青少年获得及时优质的生殖健康服务。文章特别关注拉美地区在制度保障方面的监管创新，同时批评机构性良心拒绝（ICO）的承认进一步加剧了负面后果。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲的良心条款如何演变？它们对医疗服务和生殖健康权利的获取产生了怎样的影响？现有的监管框架和制度创新能否有效应对良心拒绝的滥用？
AI.motivation: 1994年国际人口与发展会议（ICPD）后，全球从人口控制转向以权利为基础的生殖健康框架，良心拒绝在医疗领域的角色和用途发生显著变化，从宗教信念的出口演变为政治工具和系统性阻碍生殖健康服务的机制，亟需重新审视和概念化这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 良心拒绝（CO）的概念化框架，基于权利型生殖健康范式（ICPD框架），以及从强制兵役语境中继承的经典良心拒绝定义向当代医疗语境重新概念化的理论需求。
AI.method: 比较分析拉丁美洲各国的良心条款立法与司法判例，聚焦堕胎领域，识别区域趋势和监管创新。
AI.findings: 1) 良心拒绝从宗教动机演变为多元化用途，包括应对职业压力、污名化和政治抵抗；2) 拉美部分国家在良心条款中纳入制度性保障作为缓解滥用的创新策略；3) 但多个法院和立法机构承认了机构性良心拒绝权（ICO），使整个医疗机构可以基于使命或身份拒绝服务，进一步加剧了有害后果；4) 良心条款的扩展和应用多样化要求超越经典定义的重新概念化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出良心拒绝需要进行经验驱动的重新概念化，超越源自强制兵役背景的经典定义，以充分把握其在当代医疗、政治和制度语境中的新特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别拉丁美洲在良心条款中纳入制度保障的监管创新，为政策制定者提供缓解良心拒绝滥用的潜在策略；指出机构性良心拒绝的危险性，呼吁加强监管回应。

title: The Persistent Effects of Adverse Shocks to Investment
affiliations: Ifo Institute, Ifo Institute and

detail.title: The Persistent Effects of Adverse Shocks to Investment
detail.abstract: We use a large panel survey of German manufacturing firms spanning five decades of quantitative investment plans and realizations to study the persistence of investment dynamics. We proxy adverse investment shocks with large downward revisions of firms’ investment plans. Even ten years after a 50% downward revision, annual investment remains about 15% lower. Combining the survey with balance-sheet data and survey-based shock proxies, we show that financial frictions are only part of the explanation. Persistent investment declines are also closely linked to long-lived demand shocks, suggesting that they often reflect firms’ deliberate adjustment to weaker fundamentals.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德国制造业企业长达五十年的面板调查数据（涵盖定量投资计划与实际投资），研究投资动态的持续性。研究发现，即便在企业投资计划被大幅下调50%十年后，年投资额仍比基准水平低约15%。结合资产负债表数据和基于调查的冲击代理变量，作者证明金融摩擦只是部分原因，持续的投资下降还与长期持久的需求冲击密切相关，表明这往往反映了企业对基本面走弱的主动调整。
AI.research_question: 投资冲击对企业投资动态的影响有多持久？大幅不利投资冲击（如投资计划下调50%）后，企业投资能否恢复，持续多长时间？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对投资冲击的持续性关注不足，尤其是缺乏长期（十年以上）追踪的数据来检验投资冲击的持久效应。理解投资冲击的持续性对于宏观经济学中投资行为的建模和财政货币政策评估具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资动态理论、金融摩擦理论（金融约束）、需求冲击理论
AI.method: 利用德国制造业企业超过五十年的面板调查数据，以企业投资计划的大幅向下修订（50%以上）作为不利投资冲击的代理变量，结合资产负债表数据和基于调查的冲击代理变量进行计量分析，区分金融摩擦与需求冲击对投资持续下降的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）在投资计划向下修订50%后，即使十年过去，企业年投资额度仍比基准水平低约15%；（2）金融摩擦只能解释投资持续下降的一部分原因；（3）持续的投资下降与长期持久的需求冲击密切相关，表明投资下降在很大程度上反映了企业对基本面走弱的理性、主动调整。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次利用五十年长期面板数据系统性地量化了投资冲击的持续性，填补了该领域长期数据证据的空白；（2）区分了金融摩擦与需求冲击在投资持续下降中的相对作用，挑战了以金融摩擦为主因的解释，将投资持续性与基本面需求变化联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了关于投资冲击长期影响的重要证据，提示政策干预应考虑投资下降的持久性（可能超过十年）；（2）提示仅仅缓解金融摩擦可能不足以恢复企业投资，需关注需求侧的根本性因素。

title: AI Mirages in Medical Vision-Language Models: A Controlled Perturbation Framework for Detecting Visual Grounding Failures
affiliations: Macquarie University

detail.title: AI Mirages in Medical Vision-Language Models: A Controlled Perturbation Framework for Detecting Visual Grounding Failures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) may generate clinically plausible responses driven by language priors rather than genuine visual reasoning a phenomenon we term the AI mirage. This study introduces a controlled perturbation framework to detect and quantify AI mirage behaviour, addressing whether medical VLMs rely on language priors rather than visual evidence. Methods: Three VLMs BLIP, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, and LLaVA-Med were evaluated on IU X-Ray/OpenI (radiology report generation, n = 300) and SLAKE (medical VQA, n = 300). Each sample was tested under nine visual conditions (original, blank, black, Gaussian noise, blur, low-contrast, crop, mismatched, text-only) with text prompts held constant. Two novel metrics mirage retention (MR) and grounding drop (GD) were introduced alongside standard accuracy measures. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction assessed significance; 50 mirage outputs underwent expert clinical review. Results: All models showed statistically significant performance degradation under corrupted conditions (all p < 0.05). Despite this, mirage retention remained high (73.7%-87.3%), peaking at 87.3% under blank input for Qwen2.5-VL-3B on SLAKE. Expert review rated 34% of sampled outputs as clinically misleading or high-risk (Cohen's κ = 0.71). LLaVA-Med showed only marginal visual grounding improvement over general-purpose models despite medical fine-tuning. Conclusions: Standard accuracy-based benchmarking is insufficient to detect AI mirage failures. The proposed perturbation framework provides a reproducible safety audit protocol for evaluating visual grounding in medical VLMs prior to clinical deployment. AI mirage detection should become a standard component of pre-deployment safety evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种受控扰动框架来检测和量化医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）中的"AI海市蜃楼"现象——即模型依赖语言先验而非真实视觉推理生成看似合理的临床响应。研究在三个VLM（BLIP、Qwen2.5-VL-3B、LLaVA-Med）上，通过九种视觉条件扰动测试，发现所有模型在损坏输入下仍保持73.7%-87.3%的高"海市蜃楼保留率"，且34%的输出被专家评为临床误导或高风险。论文提出了两个新指标（MR和GD），主张将AI海市蜃楼检测纳入部署前安全评估标准。
AI.research_question: 医学视觉语言模型是否依赖语言先验而非视觉证据生成响应（即"AI海市蜃楼"现象）？如何检测和量化这一现象？
AI.motivation: 医学VLM可能产生临床上看似合理但并非基于真实视觉推理的输出，传统基于准确率的基准测试无法捕捉此类故障，存在临床部署安全隐患。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于语言先验vs视觉推理的认知区分框架；AI海市蜃楼现象理论——模型通过语言模式匹配而非真实视觉理解生成响应。
AI.method: 受控扰动实验：三个VLM（BLIP、Qwen2.5-VL-3B、LLaVA-Med）在两个医学数据集（IU X-Ray/OpenI放射报告生成n=300；SLAKE医学VQA n=300）上进行，每个样本在九种视觉条件下测试（原始、空白、黑色、高斯噪声、模糊、低对比度、裁剪、错配、仅文本），文本提示保持不变。引入两个新指标：海市蜃楼保留率（MR）和接地下降（GD），辅以Wilcoxon符号秩检验和Holm-Bonferroni校正，50个海市蜃楼输出经专家临床审查。
AI.findings: 1) 所有模型在损坏视觉条件下均出现统计显著的性能下降（所有p<0.05）；2) 但海市蜃楼保留率仍然很高（73.7%-87.3%），Qwen2.5-VL-3B在SLAKE数据集空白输入下达到87.3%峰值；3) 专家审查发现34%的采样输出在临床上具有误导性或高风险（Cohen's κ=0.71）；4) LLaVA-Med尽管经过医学微调，视觉接地改进仅边际性优于通用模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统性地定义和量化了医学VLM中的"AI海市蜃楼"现象；2) 提出了两个新的评估指标（海市蜃楼保留率MR和接地下降GD），补充了传统准确率指标的不足；3) 建立了受控视觉扰动作为检测视觉接地能力的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一个可复现的安全审计协议，用于临床部署前评估医学VLM的视觉接地能力；2) 揭示了传统准确率基准测试在检测AI海市蜃楼方面的不足，推动将海市蜃楼检测纳入部署前安全评估标准；3) 为临床AI系统的安全监管提供了可操作的方法论。

title: The Economic Logic of Coinage Debasement: Monetary Adjustment, Fiscal Gain, and Long-Term Consequences

detail.title: The Economic Logic of Coinage Debasement: Monetary Adjustment, Fiscal Gain, and Long-Term Consequences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Sven Svensson Foundation for Numismatics. Gunnar Ekström Foundation. Sven and Dagmar Salén Foundation.

detail.abstract:
This chapter explores the phenomenon of coin debasement in premodern commodity-money systems, distinguishing analytically between its monetary and fiscal rationales. Monetary debasements, often gradual and technical, were typically undertaken to maintain the integrity of the currency system—offsetting wear and tear, responding to shifts in bullion markets, or ensuring the supply of small-denomination coinage. Fiscal debasements, by contrast, emerged from acute or structural revenue pressures, especially in wartime or under conditions of weak taxation and limited borrowing, and aimed to generate seigniorage through rapid or sustained reductions in coin quality.

The chapter presents a typology of debasement strategies: from emergency fiscal debasements marked by rapid depreciation and inflationary risks to chronic debasement regimes where coinage policy became a routine source of income in states with intermediate fiscal capacity. It also examines hidden debasement through imitative coinage—where authorities produced deceptive look-alike coins with lower intrinsic value—and the opportunistic debasement by mint officials under conditions of poor oversight.

The analysis emphasizes that the effects of debasement—on prices, trust, seigniorage, and monetary circulation—were shaped not only by the technical manipulation of coins but also by institutional capacity, legal enforcement, and information asymmetries. By focusing on metallic coinage regimes based on bullion and mint standards, the chapter sets the stage for the case studies in Chapters 7 and 8 by providing the economic and institutional logic behind the diverse historical patterns of debasement across Antiquity, the Middle Ages, and the early modern period, while later chapters extend the analysis to representative and fiat monetary systems.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了前现代商品货币体系中货币贬值的现象，从分析上区分其货币性理由和财政性理由，构建了贬值策略的类型学，并强调贬值效果受制度能力、法律执行和信息不对称等因素影响，为后续章节的案例研究奠定基础。
AI.research_question: 前现代商品货币体系中，货币贬值的货币性动机与财政性动机如何区分？不同贬值策略的类型、效果及其影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 货币贬值在前现代货币体系中普遍存在且形式多样，但需要系统地将其区分为货币性（维护货币体系完整性）和财政性（产生铸币税收入）两种不同理性，以理解其多样化的历史模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商品货币理论、铸币税理论、制度经济学（涉及制度能力、法律执行与信息不对称）、财政能力理论
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析，构建货币贬值策略的类型学框架（包括紧急财政贬值、慢性贬值制度、隐性贬值、机会主义贬值），结合历史比较分析。
AI.findings: 贬值可分为货币性（渐进、技术性，旨在维护货币体系）和财政性（因战争或税收弱而快速降低铸币质量以获取铸币税收入）两大类；类型学涵盖紧急财政贬值、慢性贬值制度、模仿性铸币的隐性贬值以及监督不力的机会主义贬值；贬值对价格、信任、铸币税和货币流通的影响取决于制度能力、法律执行和信息不对称等条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了货币贬值中货币性动机与财政性动机的分析性区分框架，构建了贬值策略的类型学，并将制度能力、法律执行和信息不对称纳入贬值效果分析，深化了对前现代货币体系中贬值现象的经济与制度逻辑的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解古代、中世纪和近代早期不同历史时期货币贬值的多样性模式提供分析工具，并为后续章节（第7、8章）的案例研究奠定理论基础，也对理解代行货币和法定货币体系中的相关问题具有参照意义。

title: On the Unintended Consequences of Critical Mineral Bans: The Exploration Channel
affiliations: and University of Oxford

detail.title: On the Unintended Consequences of Critical Mineral Bans: The Exploration Channel
detail.abstract: Critical mineral maps portray known resource endowments as fixed geographic facts, yet the resource base is endogenous to both demand conditions and institutional factors. The prevailing framing of critical mineral scarcity ignores the extent to which resources are discovered only when it is profitable to do so. Using a two-region model of endogenous reserves, we show that exploration investment and discovered reserves respond to global demand shocks, world resource prices, and the institutional environment facing international resource companies, including explicit and implicit taxes on exploration and on exports, including export bans and restrictive trade measures in pursuit of value-chain upgrading. While export bans may be attractive as industrial policy, they risk being self-defeating: by discouraging exploration investment, they reduce the very resource base on which industrial ambitions depend. We document the global proliferation of export restrictions on critical minerals and discuss the policy implications for developing countries navigating the twin pressures of resource nationalism and the green transition.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个两区域内生储量模型证明，关键矿产的已探明资源储量并非固定不变的地理事实，而是对全球需求、资源价格和制度环境（尤其是出口禁令和限制性贸易措施）的内生反应。出口禁令虽然看似是吸引人的产业政策，但实际上会抑制勘探投资，反而削弱工业野心所依赖的资源基础。
AI.research_question: 关键矿产的资源储量在多大程度上是内生的？出口限制等制度因素如何通过影响勘探投资来改变资源基础？
AI.motivation: 现有关于关键矿产稀缺性的主流叙事将已知资源储量视为固定的地理事实，忽视了资源只有在有利可图时才会被发现的本质，需要重新审视这一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生储量理论、两区域模型、资源经济学中的制度分析框架
AI.method: 构建一个两区域内生储量理论模型，结合全球关键矿产出口限制的事实性文献证据进行分析。
AI.findings: 勘探投资和已发现储量会对全球需求冲击、世界资源价格以及国际资源公司面临的制度环境（包括对勘探和出口的显性与隐性税收、出口禁令与限制性贸易措施）做出响应；出口禁令虽作为产业政策具有吸引力，但会因抑制勘探投资而自我挫败，减少工业野心所依赖的资源基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将关键矿产储量视为固定地理事实的传统框架，将资源基础内生化到需求和制度因素之中，揭示了出口禁令作为产业政策的自败机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家在资源民族主义与绿色转型双重压力下的政策选择提供启示，警示出口限制对长期资源供给能力的负面影响。

title: Collaborative Learning and Team Contests in EdTech
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business and

detail.title: Collaborative Learning and Team Contests in EdTech

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We certify that we have no personal or financial relationship with anyone who may have, or could be perceived to have, influence on this study. The goal of the study was to understand the impact of the designed intervention and its underlying drivers.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The field experiment was duly approved by the IRB of the University of Florida and was duly pre-registered on ASPredicted \#97643, available at \url{https://aspredicted.org/see_one.php.
declarations.funderStatement: We have not taken any funds to conduct this study. However, our partnering non-governmental organization (RightWalk Foundation) has deputed its resources to help us with the study.

detail.abstract: Most educational technology (EdTech) platforms personalize practice for individual students and often fail to treat classmates as contributors who could make each other's practice more productive. We study whether team-based design can make such platforms more effective. To do so, we designed, built, and deployed an integrated EdTech platform for this research program and conducted a large-scale randomized field experiment across 63 grade 3-6 math classes in 12 schools across India. The platform enabled team learning with recurring classroom practice assignments and tournaments while recording each stage of student engagement. Classes are randomly assigned to an individual-based design, in which feedback and recognition are student-specific, or to a team-based design that shares knowledge gaps within groups and awards team-based recognition. We find that students under team-based design improved by 2.41 (0.12 σ) more points from baseline to endline on a standardized math assessment, despite nearly identical average effort in practice assignments and tournament attendance, because the tournament-score return to a given amount of practice is about three times larger under team-based design. Our results also show that within-class achievement gaps narrow more under teams. Because learning productivity and effort cost are latent and unobserved in the data, we estimate a structural model that recovers their joint distribution across students and evaluates interventions along that distribution. The estimates show that, under teams, lower-productivity students increase effort in practice assignments, while higher-productivity students decrease it. This redistributive effort response accounts for the narrower classroom achievement gaps under teams. Nonetheless, team-based design raises skill for every type, including high-productivity students because collaborative learning combined with shared team contests act as complements. This complementarity also makes assignment-participation nudges and incentives roughly four times more effective under team-based design. Team-based design thus makes EdTech more effective by turning classmates into amplifiers of each other's practice, with particular gains in effort among students who start farther behind.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于团队的教育科技平台设计是否能提升学习效果。通过设计并部署集成式EdTech平台，在印度12所学校的63个3-6年级数学班级中进行大规模随机田野实验，发现团队制设计使学生在标准化数学测试中比个人制设计多提高2.41分（0.12σ），且班级内成绩差距更小。通过结构模型估计，团队制下低生产率学生增加练习努力，高生产率学生减少努力，但所有类型学生的技能均提升，因为协作学习与团队竞赛形成互补效应。
AI.research_question: 基于团队的设计能否使教育科技平台更有效？团队制设计如何影响学生的学习产出和努力分配？
AI.motivation: 大多数教育科技平台仅针对个人进行个性化练习，未将同学视为能互相提升练习效率的贡献者。作者旨在验证将同学纳入学习过程（团队化设计）能否提升平台效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协作学习理论；团队竞赛与激励理论；学习生产力与努力成本的结构模型（联合分布估计）。
AI.method: 设计并部署集成式教育科技平台（支持团队学习、常规课堂练习任务和锦标赛）；在印度12所学校63个3-6年级数学班级中进行大规模随机田野实验；班级随机分配到个人制设计或团队制设计；运用结构模型估计学习生产力与努力成本的联合分布。
AI.findings: （1）团队制设计下学生在标准化数学评估中从基线到终期多提高2.41分（0.12σ）；（2）尽管平均练习努力和锦标赛出勤几乎相同，但团队制下锦标赛得分对给定练习量的回报约为个人制的3倍；（3）团队制下班内成绩差距缩小更多；（4）结构模型显示团队制下低生产率学生增加练习努力，高生产率学生减少努力，但这种再分配性努力响应导致班级成绩差距缩小；（5）团队制对所有类型学生（包括高生产率学生）均提升技能，因为协作学习与共享团队竞赛形成互补；（6）任务参与激励在团队制下效果约为个人制的4倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过大规模田野实验和结构模型，在EdTech情境下揭示协作学习与团队竞赛之间的互补性机制；识别了团队制下努力再分配效应（低生产率学生增加、高生产率学生减少努力）对班级成绩差距的影响路径；提出了学习生产力与努力成本联合分布的结构估计框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育科技平台设计提供实证依据：将同学转化为彼此练习的"放大器"可显著提升学习效果；团队制设计可缩小班级内成绩差距，对落后学生尤为有利；团队制可放大激励措施的效果（约4倍），为平台运营者优化激励设计提供参考。

title: Credit Risk and Systemic Spillovers from an Unexpected Bank Rescue
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management

detail.title: Credit Risk and Systemic Spillovers from an Unexpected Bank Rescue
detail.abstract: I exploit an unexpected rescue of a private sector bank to examine spillover effects on other banks. The unprecedented protection of shareholder claims in the failed bank increases bailout expectations among other private sector banks, triggering two opposing channels of systemic risk. Affected banks engage in individual risk-shifting by lending more to risky borrowers, increasing credit risk, and expanding overall lending. Yet, they also increase loan specialization due to weaker incentives to correlate assets with peers. On net, their contribution to systemic risk rises by about 23%, highlighting how bailouts can reshape risk-taking and amplify fragility across the banking system.

AI.tldr: 本文利用一家私营银行意外获救的准自然实验，考察了救助对其他银行的风险溢出效应。救助事件提升了其他私营银行的救助预期，通过"风险转移"（增加对高风险借款人的放贷、扩大总贷款）和"贷款专业化"（降低与同业资产相关性）两个相反渠道影响系统性风险。净效应是受救助预期影响的银行对系统性风险的贡献上升约23%，表明救助会重塑银行风险行为并放大整个银行体系的脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 意外救助一家私营银行如何通过改变其他银行的救助预期，影响其风险承担行为以及对系统性风险的贡献？
AI.motivation: 银行救助（bailout）虽然旨在防范系统性风险，但可能通过改变市场对"大而不倒"的预期而产生道德风险，导致其他银行风险承担行为改变。然而，救助对系统性风险的实际影响及其作用机制尚缺乏充分证据，特别是救助预期如何通过不同渠道影响银行个体风险与系统性风险的净效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德风险理论、救助预期（bailout expectations）、系统性风险传染机制、风险转移（risk-shifting）与资产相关性（asset correlation）权衡理论
AI.method: 利用一家私营银行意外救助事件作为准自然实验（quasi-natural experiment），采用差异中的差异（difference-in-differences）方法，对比受救助预期影响的其他私营银行与不受影响的银行，考察救助对银行风险承担、贷款行为及系统性风险贡献的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）意外救助保护了失败银行股东权益，显著提升了其他私营银行的救助预期；（2）受影响的银行通过向风险借款人增加放贷、扩大总贷款规模进行个体风险转移，导致信用风险上升；（3）同时，这些银行因激励减弱而提高贷款专业化程度，降低与同业资产的关联性；（4）两个渠道相互抵消后，受救助预期影响的银行对系统性风险的贡献仍净增加约23%。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次利用意外救助事件识别救助预期对系统性风险的因果效应；（2）揭示了救助预期通过"风险转移"和"贷款专业化"两个对立渠道影响系统性风险的内在机制；（3）区分了银行个体风险与系统性风险，表明道德风险不仅提高个体风险，还可能通过资产重组改变银行间关联结构。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管机构评估银行救助政策的系统性后果提供实证依据；（2）提示政策制定者在救助设计时需考虑保护股东权益所产生的道德风险外溢；（3）为系统性风险监管（如压力测试、宏观审慎政策）提供关于救助预期如何影响银行风险承担与资产相关性的定量参考。

title: Situational Awareness: The Rise and Fall of Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI Hedge Fund A Case Study in Leverage, Conviction, and Collapse

detail.title: Situational Awareness: The Rise and Fall of Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI Hedge Fund A Case Study in Leverage, Conviction, and Collapse
detail.abstract: This case study examines the rise and collapse of Situational Awareness LP, the AI-focused hedge fund founded by Leopold Aschenbrenner in 2024. At its peak the fund held approximately USD 45 billion in assets, with net returns exceeding 1,000 percent, before being forced within weeks to liquidate its public equity book through a distressed block sale to Citadel. The collapse stemmed from simultaneous losses on long AI-infrastructure and short software positions, amplified by leverage of up to 400 percent, triggering cascading margin calls from prime brokers. The paper traces the fund's thesis, capital raising, portfolio construction, and the resulting lessons.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究，分析了由Leopold Aschenbrenner于2024年创立的AI主题对冲基金Situational Awareness LP的兴衰历程。该基金在鼎盛时期管理约450亿美元资产，净回报超过1000%，但因同时遭受AI基础设施多头和软件空头头寸的损失，叠加高达400%的杠杆引发抵押品追缴连锁反应，最终被迫在数周内以困境甩卖方式将公开股票组合出售给Citadel。
AI.research_question: 一个专注于AI领域的对冲基金如何在短时间内从巨额盈利走向崩溃？高杠杆、集中持仓与市场波动如何共同导致其流动性危机和强制清算？
AI.motivation: AI主题投资近年来急剧升温，大量资金涌入高杠杆的集中型投资基金。Situational Awareness LP的案例揭示了极端杠杆与集中持仓在AI快速变化市场中的系统性风险，为投资者和监管者提供警示性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对冲基金风险管理理论、杠杆与保证金机制理论（保证金追缴、强制平仓），以及市场流动性理论（甩卖与价格冲击）。
AI.method: 单一案例研究方法，系统梳理基金的论点形成、募资过程、投资组合构建及崩溃全过程。
AI.findings: 基金崩溃的直接原因是同时押注AI基础设施（多头）和软件板块（空头）的"配对交易"失败，叠加最高达400%的杠杆，导致主经纪商连环追加保证金并触发强制平仓；最终基金仅用数周时间即以困境甩卖方式将股票组合出售给Citadel。
AI.theory_contributions: 为极端杠杆与高集中度AI主题投资组合的风险传导机制提供了实证案例，丰富了关于配对交易策略在系统性冲击下失效的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了关于AI主题投资中杠杆使用、仓位集中度和流动性管理的现实警示，也为对冲基金管理人及主经纪商在极端市场条件下的风险管理实践提供了经验教训。

title: Three Ways to Close a Model: On the Logical Justification for Solution Concepts in Economics

detail.title: Three Ways to Close a Model: On the Logical Justification for Solution Concepts in Economics
detail.abstract: The philosophy of economics has developed rich accounts of what models are-isolations, credible worlds, fables, mediating instruments-while saying little about the device that converts a model's structure into claims: the solution concept. We argue that solution concepts constitute a distinct locus of methodological commitment-separable from, though interacting with, the realism of assumptionsand that economics operates at least three families of them whose justificatory logics differ in kind: Walrasian closure, licensed by limit theorems and engineered institutions while its textbook dynamics fail in general; strategic closure, whose epistemic and refinement audits revealed demanding conditions and ineliminable plurality; and dynamical closure-steady states and balanced growth paths-licensed calibrationally against stylized facts. Received interpretations of solution concepts as predictions, norms, or self-enforcing agreements fail to generalize across the families. We defend a functionalist alternative: solution concepts are material inference rules-Rylean tickets-vindicated through distinct feedback channels, including a performative channel-building a ticket's own conditions of application-that economics has institutionalized as no other science has. Model appraisal is therefore two-dimensional, extending to closure the credibility questions hitherto asked only of structure. A comparative check against evolutionary biology and ecology shows most of this situation to be scientifically ordinary; only reflexivity institutionalized as a vindication channel is economics' own. We close by observing that the standard curriculum presents the three logics as one continuous method, in inverse order of their epistemic audit.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了经济学中的"解概念"（solution concept）是独立于模型假设现实性的方法论承诺点，经济学至少存在三类解概念家族（瓦尔拉斯封闭、策略封闭、动态封闭），其证成逻辑在种类上各不相同。作者反对将解概念解释为预测、规范或自执行协议的传统观点，提出功能主义替代方案：解概念是物质推理规则（Rylean tickets），通过不同的反馈渠道获得证成，其中"表演性渠道"（构建自身应用条件）是经济学独有的制度特征。模型评估因此是二维的，需将可信度问题从模型结构扩展到解概念。通过与进化生物学和生态学的比较，作者认为只有制度化反思性作为证成渠道是经济学独有的。
AI.research_question: 解概念（solution concept）作为将模型结构转化为命题的装置，其方法论地位和证成逻辑是什么？它们是否构成独立于假设现实性问题的、具有不同证成类型的方法论承诺？
AI.motivation: 经济哲学已对模型的本质（隔离、可信世界、寓言、中介工具）发展出丰富论述，但对将模型结构转化为命题的装置——解概念——几乎没有方法论审视。作者认为解概念构成了独立的方法论承诺点，需要系统分析其证成逻辑的多样性和特殊性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济哲学中的模型理论传统；功能主义方法论；赖尔（Ryle）的推理规则理论（Rylean tickets）；表演性（performativity）理论；科学哲学中关于模型评估的二维框架。
AI.method: 概念分析和方法论文本研究，通过比较三类解概念家族（瓦尔拉斯封闭、策略封闭、动态封闭）的证成逻辑，并与进化生物学和生态学进行跨学科比较。采用功能主义视角构建解概念作为"物质推理规则"的理论框架。
AI.findings: （1）三类解概念家族的证成逻辑种类不同：瓦尔拉斯封闭由极限定理和工程化制度授权但教科书动力学普遍失效；策略封闭经过认知和精炼审查揭示出严苛条件和不可消除的多元性；动态封闭通过校准风格化事实来证成。（2）传统解释（预测、规范、自执行协议）无法跨家族推广。（3）解概念是物质推理规则，通过不同反馈渠道证成，其中表演性渠道是经济学制度化独有的。（4）标准课程将三种逻辑呈现为一种连续方法，但其顺序与认识论审查的顺序相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解概念作为独立方法论承诺点的框架，将模型评估扩展到二维（结构维度和封闭维度）；提出解概念的功能主义解释替代预测/规范/自执行协议的传统解释；识别出经济学独有的"表演性证成渠道"（institutionalized performative channel）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家提供了同时审视模型结构和解概念可信度的二维评估框架；揭示了标准课程将不同逻辑的解概念呈现为连续方法的认识论缺陷，建议教学和研究中对三类封闭逻辑进行区分审查。

title: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
affiliations: CMCC - Centro Euro-Mediterraneo sui Cambiamenti Climatici, Università degli Studi di Milano, University of Bologna and

detail.title: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
detail.abstract: We conducted a survey experiment with over 8,000 participants in Germany, Hungary and Italy to examine how information about the economic impact of immigration affects the support for more open immigration policies. Respondents who received projections showing higher future incomes under more open immigration policies reported greater support for these policies. The treatment also partly changed how prior attitudes affected policy preferences. Structural estimates suggest that majority support for immigration above current levels would require annual per-capita income gains of about 1.2% in Italy and 1.7% in Germany, and still larger or unattainable gains in Hungary. These increases are large relative to recent historical growth rates, suggesting that economic benefits alone are unlikely to generate vast support for more open immigration policies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在德国、匈牙利和意大利开展超过8000名参与者的调查实验，研究有关移民经济影响的信息如何影响公众对更开放移民政策的支持。结果显示，收到更高未来收入预测信息的受访者对更开放移民政策的支持度更高，但经济收益本身难以单独产生大规模支持。
AI.research_question: 关于移民经济影响的信息如何影响公众对更开放移民政策的支持？支持多数公众支持当前水平以上移民所需的收入收益规模是多少？
AI.motivation: 移民政策是欧洲各国政治争议的焦点，公众对移民经济后果的认知可能影响其政策偏好，但关于信息干预如何改变移民政策支持度的因果证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公众对移民经济影响的认知与政策偏好之间的关系理论，考察信息提供如何改变既有态度对政策偏好的影响。
AI.method: 在德国、匈牙利和意大利三国开展大规模调查实验（N>8000），随机向部分受访者提供显示更开放移民政策将带来更高未来收入的预测信息，并通过结构估计量化支持更开放移民政策所需的收入收益门槛。
AI.findings: （1）收到更高未来收入预测信息的受访者对更开放移民政策的支持度显著提高；（2）信息处理部分改变了既有态度对政策偏好的影响；（3）结构估计显示，实现多数公众支持需意大利年人均收入增长约1.2%、德国约1.7%，而匈牙利需要更大或无法实现的经济收益；（4）这些门槛相对于近期历史增长率较高，表明仅靠经济收益难以产生对更开放移民政策的大规模支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息如何影响移民政策偏好提供了因果证据，并揭示了经济收益信息在改变既有政治态度对政策偏好影响方面的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于经济论证在塑造公众移民政策偏好方面限度的实证依据，有助于制定更有效且现实的移民政策沟通策略。

title: What are the Bottlenecks to Secure Strongly Bonded Teamwork Spirit in Ethiopia's Federal Level Public Institutions? (An Ordered Probit Model)

detail.title: What are the Bottlenecks to Secure Strongly Bonded Teamwork Spirit in Ethiopia's Federal Level Public Institutions? (An Ordered Probit Model)
detail.abstract: Team enables people to cooperate, enhance individual skills and provide constructive feedback without any conflict between individuals (Jones, et.al 2007). This study conducted to explore the factors that affect the culture of team works in federal level ministry offices in Ethiopia and to suggest the mechanisms to overcome those challenges and utilize the good opportunities. In the study the mixed methods of research design have been employed. The study used both primary and secondary data. The primary data has been collected by using questionnaire, focus group discussion and in-depth interview from the members of change army. Secondary data have been collected from different published and unpublished documents. The sample sizes in the study were 322 respondents. The data has been analyzed through ordered probit model with the help of STATA software.
