AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供明确的监管缺口诊断：指出《共同规则》的机构边界设置使商业中介成为监管盲区，为修订监管规则（如扩展覆盖范围或调整审查触发点）提供理论依据；同时揭示精神健康危机人群作为最脆弱群体被排除在专门保护之外的实际后果，呼吁建立针对决策能力受损成年人的专门保护机制。

title: A Systematic Bibliometric and Topic Modelling Review of Crypto Financial Risk Research
affiliations: , Capital University of Economics and Business, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Institutes of Science and Development, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Institutes of Science and Development and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Institute of Policy and Management

detail.title: A Systematic Bibliometric and Topic Modelling Review of Crypto Financial Risk Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China.

detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of crypto finance has generated a large and fragmented scholarly literature, making systematic synthesis increasingly necessary. We employ modular BERTopic and bibliometric analysis to examine 891 leading academic and policy publications, integrated with 1,980 security events. The analysis identifies 19 research themes, consolidated inductively into an integrated framework encompassing risk sources, measurement, transmission, hedging, and governance. The findings reveal a thematic shift from early preoccupations with consensus mechanisms and asset valuation toward, particularly since 2018, quantitative analyses of systemic spillovers, DeFi vulnerabilities, and macroprudential governance. This trajectory mirrors the progressive integration of crypto finance with traditional financial systems, as the risk landscape has broadened from protocol-level technical failures to encompass systemic, institutional, and macroeconomic dimensions. It is recommended that future research focus on the following key areas: the integration of granular on-chain data into risk measurement frameworks; the modelling of nested DeFi protocol vulnerabilities and their cascading liquidation dynamics; the hedging functions of high-leverage perpetual futures and prediction markets; and the empirical assessment of the implications of crypto finance for both advanced and emerging economies. We offer fresh perspectives for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers seeking to navigate the multifaceted risks of the crypto ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模块化BERTopic和文献计量分析，综合考察了891篇学术与政策文献及1,980个安全事件，识别出19个研究主题并归纳为涵盖风险来源、测量、传导、对冲和治理的综合框架。研究发现研究重心已从早期共识机制和资产估值转向2018年以来的系统性溢出、DeFi脆弱性和宏观审慎治理分析，反映了加密金融与传统金融体系的逐步融合。
AI.research_question: 加密金融领域快速扩张产生了大量且碎片化的学术文献，如何对这些文献进行系统性综合以识别研究主题、演变趋势和未来方向？
AI.motivation: 加密金融文献数量庞大且碎片化，缺乏系统性的综合梳理，使得研究者、从业者和政策制定者难以全面把握该领域的风险全貌和研究现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模块化BERTopic主题建模、文献计量分析，以及归纳式综合框架（涵盖风险来源、测量、传导、对冲和治理五个维度）。
AI.method: 运用模块化BERTopic进行主题建模，结合文献计量分析，对891篇顶级学术和政策出版物进行分析，并整合1,980个安全事件数据。
AI.findings: 识别出19个研究主题，研究重心从早期共识机制和资产估值转向2018年以来的系统性溢出、DeFi脆弱性和宏观审慎治理分析；风险格局从协议层面的技术故障扩展至系统性、制度性和宏观经济维度，反映了加密金融与传统金融系统的渐进融合。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了涵盖风险来源、测量、传导、对冲和治理的综合分析框架，为加密金融风险研究提供了系统化的理论整合视角，揭示了该领域研究主题的演变规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、从业者和政策制定者提供了导航加密生态系统多维风险的参考，并建议未来重点关注链上数据整合、DeFi嵌套协议级联清算建模、高杠杆永续合约和预测市场的对冲功能，以及加密金融对发达和新兴经济体的实证评估。

title: The outside option channel of central bank asset purchase programs: A tale of two crises
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The outside option channel of central bank asset purchase programs: A tale of two crises
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the outside option channel of central bank asset purchase programs. After the global financial crisis, central banks have engaged in purchasing assets traded in over-the-counter (OTC) secondary markets with substantial matching frictions and bargaining features. In this context, an asset purchase announcement improves the seller’s outside option in bargaining, thereby increasing asset prices even without actual purchases. I develop a theoretical model to illustrate the mechanics of this outside option channel, which helps explain why the Federal Reserve purchased more than $1 trillion of agency MBS during the global financial crisis but only $14 billion of corporate bonds during the COVID crisis despite stabilizing both markets. The model also shows that asset purchases and liquidity provision policies target different margins in OTC markets: asset purchases improve sellers' outside options, whereas liquidity provision relaxes buyers' funding constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了中央银行资产购买计划的外部选择渠道。由于央行购买的资产在存在显著匹配摩擦和讨价还价特征的非集中交易（OTC）二级市场中交易，资产购买公告会改善卖方在谈判中的外部选择，即使没有实际购买也会推高资产价格。作者构建了理论模型来阐释这一机制，解释了为什么美联储在全球金融危机期间购买了超1万亿美元机构MBS，但在新冠危机期间仅购买了140亿美元公司债，却能同时稳定两个市场。
AI.research_question: 资产购买公告如何通过改善OTC市场中卖方的外部选择来影响资产价格，以及这一渠道如何解释不同危机中央行购买规模的巨大差异？
AI.motivation: 传统理论难以解释为何美联储在全球金融危机时需购买超1万亿美元MBS，但在新冠危机中仅购买140亿美元公司债即可稳定市场。作者提出外部选择渠道以解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于搜索与匹配摩擦的OTC市场理论，结合讨价还价博弈理论，提出资产购买公告通过影响卖方外部选择影响均衡价格的"外部选择渠道"。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，建模OTC市场中资产购买公告对卖方讨价还价外部选择的影响机制，并通过模型推导说明资产价格变化与购买规模的关系。
AI.findings: ①资产购买公告能改善卖方外部选择从而推高资产价格，即使没有实际购买；②资产购买与流动性提供政策在OTC市场中作用于不同维度——资产购买改善卖方外部选择，流动性提供则放松买方融资约束；③该模型解释了为何不同危机中购买规模差异巨大却均能稳定市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了资产购买政策的新传导渠道——外部选择渠道，补充了传统资产购买理论（如信号渠道、资产组合平衡渠道）的解释力，并厘清了资产购买与流动性提供在OTC市场中的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行在OTC市场中实施资产购买政策提供了理论依据，帮助理解购买公告与实际购买之间的价格效应差异，并为央行在不同危机情境下选择购买规模与政策组合提供参考。

title: Engineering Hallucination Risk Index (EHRI): A Quantitative Framework for Evaluating Trustworthiness of Generative AI in Engineering Decision Support Systems

detail.title: Engineering Hallucination Risk Index (EHRI): A Quantitative Framework for Evaluating Trustworthiness of Generative AI in Engineering Decision Support Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or organizational affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently, and the conclusions presented are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is a conceptual and methodological research work based on literature review, analytical framework development, and illustrative engineering case examples. The study did not involve human participants, animals, patient data, personal information, or confidential industrial data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author without external financial support.

detail.abstract:
Driven by the rapid growth of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs), engineering decision support systems have significantly evolved to offer intelligent assistance across design, maintenance, diagnosis, documentation, scheduling, optimisation, management, and retrieval of engineering knowledge. The rapid evolution of GenAI/LLMs has tremendously improved productivity and expedited technical decision-making for manufacturers, the energy sector, infrastructure, mining, and the chemical industry. Notwithstanding the potential of GenAI/LLMs, a common issue is the frequent generation of hallucinations—seemingly technical responses that contain fabricated facts, erroneous engineering principles, mistaken mathematical calculations, unverified references, confusing explanations, or safety-uncompromising guidelines.

Such AI hallucinations in engineering create critical risks such as equipment damage, production loss, safety incidents, environmental harm, regulatory violations, and severe economic losses. Numerous solutions for hallucination detection, factualness assessment, uncertainty estimation, confidence calibration, retrieval augmentation, and trustworthy AI have been reported; however, these typically pertain to general natural language processing tasks, healthcare, education, and legal systems. Unique requirements and evaluation criteria are needed for AI in engineering decision support, including correct technical logic, technical standard conformance, numeric accuracy, evidentiary traceability, safety compliance, explainability, and consistency with engineering domain knowledge. Unfortunately, no comprehensive quantitative approach has been established to evaluate hallucination risks within an engineering decision support system environment. This research develops a novel Engineering Hallucination Risk Index (EHRI) as a quantitative multidimensional index that evaluates the trustworthiness of AI-generated engineering recommendations.

EHRI is composed of seven engineering-based dimensions: Technical Accuracy (TA), Evidence Traceability (ET), Domain Knowledge Consistency (DKC), Safety Compliance (SC), Numerical Reliability (NR), Engineering Standard Compliance (ESC), and Explainability (EX). Each dimension is measured via a normalised scoring function and scaled by its engineering significance, leading to an overall EHRI from 0 to 100, with a smaller value representing the most trustworthy AI recommendation with the lowest hallucination risk. EHRI enables automatic categorisation of an AI recommendation into one of five Engineering Trust Levels: Very Low Risk (VLR), Low Risk (LR), Moderate Risk (MR), High Risk (HR), and Critical Risk (CR).

Unlike previous hallucination assessment methods which focus on NLP tasks or specific domains, EHRI explicitly builds core engineering concepts, math verification, factual evidence, engineering standards, security, and explainability into a quantitative evaluating index. Thus, it is applicable across a wide array of engineering fields such as steel plants, the power industry, the oil & gas sector, the chemical industry, civil infrastructure, aerospace, transportation, and industrial automation. We illustrate EHRI with a use case for AI-assisted maintenance scheduling in an integrated steel plant. EHRI could identify unreliable recommendations before field deployment, reducing uncertainty. Organisations can also use EHRI as a systematic metric to compare different GenAI models on engineering trustworthiness. The proposed Engineering Hallucination Risk Index serves as a cornerstone of Engineering AI Governance and establishes a basis for future research concerning trustworthy engineering AI certification, explainable engineering intelligence, and autonomous engineering systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种创新的工程幻觉风险指数（EHRI），作为定量多维指标来评估AI生成工程建议的可信度。EHRI由七个基于工程的维度组成，输出0-100的综合评分，并将AI建议自动分类为五个工程信任等级（从极低风险到临界风险）。通过钢铁厂维护调度案例进行验证，EHRI可作为工程AI治理的基石。
AI.research_question: 如何在工程决策支持系统环境中建立一套全面的定量方法，以评估AI生成工程建议的幻觉风险？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI和大语言模型在工程领域的应用快速增长，但频繁产生幻觉（虚构事实、错误工程原理、错误计算、未验证引用等），在工程领域造成设备损坏、生产损失、安全事故等严重风险。现有幻觉检测方法主要针对通用NLP任务、医疗、教育和法律领域，缺乏针对工程决策支持系统独特要求的定量评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于七个工程维度构建的多维定量评估框架：技术准确性（TA）、证据可追溯性（ET）、领域知识一致性（DKC）、安全合规性（SC）、数值可靠性（NR）、工程标准合规性（ESC）和可解释性（EX）。
AI.method: 提出Engineering Hallucination Risk Index（EHRI），每个维度通过归一化评分函数测量并按工程重要性加权，最终生成0-100的综合指数，并将结果分类为五个工程信任等级（VLR、LR、MR、HR、CR）。通过钢铁厂集成AI辅助维护调度用例进行验证。
AI.findings: EHRI能够有效识别不可靠的AI工程建议，在部署前减少不确定性；可作为系统性指标用于比较不同GenAI模型在工程信任度方面的表现，并适用于钢铁、电力、油气、化工、土木、航空航天、交通和工业自动化等广泛工程领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将核心工程概念、数学验证、事实证据、工程标准、安全性和可解释性明确纳入定量评估指标，区别于以往针对NLP任务或特定领域的幻觉评估方法，建立了工程AI治理的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一个系统化的度量工具来评估和比较AI工程建议的可信度，可在实际部署前识别高风险建议，支持可信工程AI认证、可解释工程智能和自主工程系统的未来研究与实践。

title: The Finite-Sample Bias of the Sharpe Ratio Estimator

detail.title: The Finite-Sample Bias of the Sharpe Ratio Estimator
detail.abstract: Although the sample Sharpe ratio is a consistent estimator of its population counterpart, it is biased in finite samples, and the bias matters at the sample sizes common in performance evaluation. We show that the widely cited finite-sample correction of Christie (2005) rests on the incorrect claims. We then derive a general first-order bias expression through the longrun variance matrix of the moment conditions, valid for stationary strongly mixing returns, which yields analytical bias corrections under GARCH(1,1) and AR(1)-GARCH(1,1) returns; to our knowledge these are the first such results beyond independent or serially correlated observations. Monte Carlo experiments confirm the analytical findings and show that the corrections reduce the bias in every model considered.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Christie (2005)广泛引用的样本夏普比率有限样本修正基于错误论断，并通过矩条件的长运行方差矩阵推导出一般性的一阶偏误表达式，适用于平稳强混合收益序列，首次给出了GARCH(1,1)和AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)收益下的解析偏误修正。蒙特卡洛实验证实了分析结果并显示修正方法在所有模型中均降低了偏误。
AI.research_question: 如何为样本夏普比率提供正确的有限样本偏误修正？特别是在存在条件异方差和序列相关的收益序列（如GARCH类模型）下，如何推导准确的解析偏误修正公式？
AI.motivation: 样本夏普比率虽然是总体夏普比率的一致估计量，但在有限样本中存在偏误，且该偏误在绩效评估常见样本量下不可忽视。现有被广泛引用的Christie (2005)修正方法基于错误论断，亟需给出正确的偏误修正方法，尤其是在非独立观测（如GARCH类时间序列）条件下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 样本夏普比率的有限样本偏误分析；矩条件的长运行方差矩阵（long-run variance matrix）方法；平稳强混合（strongly mixing）过程的渐近理论。
AI.method: 理论推导：通过矩条件的长运行方差矩阵推导一般性一阶偏误表达式；在GARCH(1,1)和AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)收益模型下求出解析偏误修正。数值验证：通过蒙特卡洛实验验证解析结果，并比较修正前后的偏误表现。
AI.findings: Christie (2005)的有限样本修正建立在错误论断之上；作者推导的一阶偏误表达式在平稳强混合收益下有效；在GARCH(1,1)和AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)模型下得到了解析偏误修正（首次突破独立或序列相关观测的限制）；蒙特卡洛实验证实了偏误修正的有效性，在所有考虑的模型中均能降低偏误。
AI.theory_contributions: 纠正了Christie (2005)修正方法的错误；首次在GARCH(1,1)和AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)收益条件下推导出夏普比率偏误的解析修正公式，拓展了之前仅限于独立或序列相关观测的理论边界；提供了一般性的一阶偏误分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为绩效评估中夏普比率的有限样本偏误修正提供了正确且更通用的方法，适用于金融回报通常表现出的条件异方差和序列相关特征，有助于投资者和研究人员获得更准确的绩效评估结果。

title: AI Mentorship and the Language of Business: Building Financial Capability among Microenterprises in Developing Economies

detail.title: AI Mentorship and the Language of Business: Building Financial Capability among Microenterprises in Developing Economies

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study received exemption from Rice University’s IRB under the category of minimal risk (IRB-FY2025-292).

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether integrating accounting into business decision-making within an AI mentorship program can build financial capability among microentrepreneurs in developing economies. I implement a randomized controlled trial with microenterprises in Honduras to evaluate the design of a WhatsApp-based AI mentor, powered by a large language model and adapted from the ILO’s Start and Improve Your Business curriculum. The experiment compares an accounting-integrated AI mentor, which embeds financial reasoning across business decisions, to a control AI mentor that teaches accounting as a stand-alone skill. The accounting-integrated mentor increases the salience and perceived relevance of financial reasoning, consistent with the intended treatment design. High-frequency conversational data show that treated entrepreneurs incorporate financial logic more consistently into marketing and strategic decisions and develop more growth-oriented, forward-looking business plans. A third arm benchmarks both AI mentors against traditional in-person training. Both AI versions outperform human-led training in perceived business growth, and adoption of cost analysis and recordkeeping practices, with particularly strong effects among entrepreneurs starting from weaker managerial baselines. Overall, interactions in the accounting-integrated condition exhibit greater use of financial reasoning, suggesting that AI-based mentorship can provide a scalable alternative to traditional training. Given the difficulty of measuring external outcomes over a compressed experimental period, the study’s findings primarily capture changes in entrepreneurs’ interactions within the AI system and in self-reported measures. These results provide early evidence on how integrating accounting into business decisions shapes microentrepreneurs' engagement with and use of financial information, while highlighting the potential of AI-based mentorship as a scalable complement to traditional training.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机对照试验，研究了在AI导师项目中整合会计学与商业决策是否能够提升发展中国家微型企业家的财务能力。研究发现，与将会计作为独立技能教授的控制组AI导师相比，整合会计的AI导师能提高财务推理的显著性和相关性，使企业家更持续地将财务逻辑应用于营销和战略决策中。两种AI版本在感知业务增长、成本分析和记录实践方面均优于传统面对面培训，尤其对管理基线较弱的企业家效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 在AI导师项目中整合会计学与商业决策是否能构建发展中国家微型企业家的财务能力？具体而言，与将会计作为独立技能的AI导师相比，会计整合型AI导师是否能更好地促进企业家将财务推理应用于商业决策中？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家微型企业家普遍缺乏会计和财务管理能力，传统面对面培训成本高、难以规模化。AI和大型语言模型的进步为提供可扩展的企业家培训提供了新可能，但如何设计AI导师以最有效地构建财务能力尚不清楚，尤其是会计整合到商业决策中是否能比作为独立技能教学更有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于会计信息在商业决策中作用的理论视角，将"会计整合"概念化为将财务推理嵌入各类商业决策中的设计原则；同时借鉴管理能力构建理论，检验不同教学方式对微型企业家财务能力形成的影响机制。
AI.method: 在洪都拉斯对微型企业实施随机对照试验（RCT），比较三种实验条件：（1）会计整合型AI导师（基于ILO的"Start and Improve Your Business"课程改编，由大语言模型驱动的WhatsApp对话AI）；（2）会计独立技能型AI导师（控制组）；（3）传统面对面培训（基准组）。利用高频对话数据分析和自我报告测量评估结果。
AI.findings: （1）会计整合型AI导师增加了财务推理的显著性和感知相关性；（2）处理组企业家更一致地将财务逻辑融入营销和战略决策，并制定更具成长导向和前瞻性的商业计划；（3）两种AI版本在感知业务增长、成本分析和记录实践方面均优于传统面对面培训，尤其对管理基线较弱的企业家效果更显著；（4）会计整合条件下的互动表现出更多财务推理的使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为会计教育整合于商业决策中的有效性提供了实证证据，表明将会计嵌入决策情境而非独立教学能更好地促进财务推理的实际应用；同时扩展了AI辅助企业管理培训的理论认知，为理解AI导师在能力构建中的作用机制提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明AI导师可作为传统培训的可扩展替代方案和补充工具，为发展中国家微型企业家的财务能力建设提供了低成本、高覆盖的新路径；指导了AI导师设计中会计整合策略的实践应用，具有显著的公共政策和发展实践价值。

title: AI in Radiology: Capability or Criterion? A Signal Detection Framework for Measuring What an AI Deployment Changes, and for Whom

detail.title: AI in Radiology: Capability or Criterion? A Signal Detection Framework for Measuring What an AI Deployment Changes, and for Whom

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This work was not commissioned, funded, or reviewed by any developer, vendor, or purchaser of artificial intelligence systems for radiology.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical and methodological paper. It involves no human participants, no patient data, and no clinical records. All numerical values are illustrative and derived analytically.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: When an artificial intelligence system is introduced into a radiology workflow and the radiologist's measured sensitivity and specificity subsequently change, two entirely different things may have happened, and the numbers alone cannot distinguish them. The AI may have changed what the radiologist is able to detect, a change in capability. Or it may have changed how much suspicion the radiologist requires before calling a study positive, a change in criterion. The first is a genuine improvement or deterioration in diagnostic power. The second is a movement of a threshold, which raises one of sensitivity and specificity only by lowering the other, and which can look like improvement while delivering none. This paper develops, from first principles and for readers with no background in signal detection theory, the framework needed to tell these two apart, and derives the closedform expression by which a radiologist's underlying discriminating power is recovered from an observed sensitivity and specificity pair. It shows that a criterion shift alone can take a reader from missing fewer than one diseased study in a hundred to missing more than one in four, with no change in capability whatever. Because real deployments move both quantities at once, the paper also sets out what can and cannot be said about how much of an observed change each was responsible for. The framework is then applied to the four modes in which artificial intelligence is deployed in radiology, and the decisive question in each is what the radiologist actually receives. Under sequential triage the AI screens all studies and refers only its positives; the radiologist learns nothing new about any individual study, only the composition of the queue changes, and the effect is therefore a criterion shift and not a capability change. Under the conjunctive and disjunctive rules the radiologist still reads independently and still learns nothing extra per study, but combining two partly independent opinions raises the capability of the system, and the choice between the two rules is an administrative decision that fixes the operating point at opposite ends of the trade-off. Only where the radiologist reads with the AI's output in view does their own judgment stand to improve, and that is also the only arrangement structurally exposed to their ceasing to judge independently at all. The paper closes by answering, separately for each mode of deployment, six questions commonly asked about AI in radiology and rarely answered precisely: whether AI makes radiologists more discriminating, smarter, more careful, more casual or dumbed down, and whether it helps all of them equally. The last has an answer that runs against intuition, since combining a reader with an AI helps weak readers substantially and degrades readers who are materially better than the AI.

AI.tldr: 本文从信号检测理论的第一性原理出发，为放射科医师在人工智能辅助下的灵敏度与特异度变化提供了一套区分框架，用以分辨变化源于诊断能力的真实改变还是判断标准的移动（即阈值偏移）。论文推导出从可观测的灵敏度和特异度对中恢复医师潜在判别能力的闭式表达式，并系统分析了AI在放射学中四种部署模式（顺序分流、合取规则、析取规则、AI输出同屏阅读）下效应本质的差异。
AI.research_question: 当AI引入放射工作流程后，放射科医师观测到的灵敏度和特异度变化，究竟反映的是诊断能力的真实改变，还是仅仅是判断标准（阈值）的移动？在四种AI部署模式下，如何区分并归因这两种截然不同的效应？
AI.motivation: 灵敏度和特异度本身无法区分数值变化背后的两种本质不同的事件：能力变化（capability change）与标准变化（criterion change）。前者是真正的诊断力改善或恶化，后者只是阈值移动，会以牺牲一项指标为代价提升另一项，甚至可能表面看起来像改善却无实际收益。现实中许多AI评估报告的解读因此存在根本性的混淆，需要一套理论框架来厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号检测理论（Signal Detection Theory, SDT），从第一性原理出发构建，面向无SDT背景的读者。核心概念包括判别能力（discriminating power）与判断标准（criterion）/阈值移动的区分。
AI.method: 理论推导与数学分析：从第一性原理建立框架，推导出从观测的灵敏度-特异度对恢复医师底层判别能力的闭式表达式；将框架应用于AI在放射学中的四种部署模式（顺序分流、合取规则、析取规则、AI输出同屏），逐一分析各模式下效应的本质。
AI.findings: （1）仅凭标准移动（阈值偏移）就可使读者从每百例漏检少于1例恶化到漏检超过1/4，而能力毫无变化。（2）四种部署模式效应不同：顺序分流（sequential triage）下AI只转介阳性病例，放射科医师对单个病例没有获得新信息，队列构成改变，效应本质是标准移动而非能力变化；合取与析取规则下医师仍独立阅读且每例无额外信息，但两个部分独立意见的结合提升了系统能力，两种规则的选择只是决定操作点位于权衡的两端；只有在AI输出同屏阅读模式中，医师自身的判断才可能提升，但这也是唯一在结构上暴露于医师可能丧失独立判断风险的安排。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI与人类诊断者交互提供了基于信号检测理论的统一分析框架，区分了能力变化与标准变化两种被数值混淆的效应；推导出从灵敏度-特异度对恢复潜在判别能力的闭式解；为每种AI部署模式提供了可精确回答关于AI在放射学中六大常见问题（是否使医师更具判别力、更聪明、更谨慎、更粗心、更迟钝、是否同等受益）的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI在放射学中的评估与部署提供精确的归因工具，帮助区分AI效果的真实来源；指出四种部署模式各自效应的本质，指导实践者选择合适的部署策略；揭示了反直觉的发现——将读者与AI结合会大幅帮助弱势读者，却会损害显著优于AI的读者，为个性化部署提供依据。

title: The Existential Compensation Hypothesis: Corrected Potential Dynamics, an Explicit CostValue Assumption, and a Cross-Taxon Falsication Test

detail.title: The Existential Compensation Hypothesis: Corrected Potential Dynamics, an Explicit CostValue Assumption, and a Cross-Taxon Falsication Test
detail.abstract: The Existential Compensation Hypothesis (ECH) proposes that a structural asymmetry in minimum obligate reproductive investmentquantied by an anisogamy coecient β ∈ (0, 1) generates a persistent existential decit in male organisms, and that this decit functions as the primary engine of civilizational production. This paper develops ECH with explicit attention to the logical status of each formal step. We label as a contestable assumption, rather than treat as a silent derivation, the identication of minimum obligate reproductive investment (a cost) with Intrinsic Biological Value (a normative-sounding quantity); we then propose a direct empirical test using sex-role-reversed taxa (Syngnathidae, phalaropes), where the model's own logic predicts a reversal of every qualitative conclusion. We derive the psychic-energy dynamics as a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation, removing an unmotivated threshold parameter while extending universality to all β ∈ (0, 1), exactly as later claimed in the sensitivity analysis. We correct a proof gap in the original irresolvability argument: independence of the relevant σ-algebras cannot be assumed without contradicting the paper's own bifurcation result, so we replace it with a direct small-ball estimate showing only that no xed horizon guarantees closure of the performative gapwhile, under the paper's own ergodicity assumption, that gap in fact closes almost surely. We ground the high-variance evolutionarily stable strategy in established risk-sensitive foraging theory rather than an invented threshold formula, removing a free parameter, and we explicitly ag two further cost-scale identications (male energy allocation, and the foraging-theory threshold mapping) that carry the same evidentiary burden as the central costvalue assumption but were not previously labeled as such. We add an explicit discussion distinguishing ECH's qualitative growth prediction from a gender-neutral null model, and locate the framework's falsiable content in two comparative-statics claims. A normalization error in the entropy functional is corrected, and every internal cross-reference in the manuscript is rebuilt on automatic labeling so that theorem, section, and assumption numbers cannot drift out of sync with the text as the document is revised. Throughout, we treat robustness-to-β as a double-edged property: it is precisely what makes the qualitative claims (i)(v) of the sensitivity analysis untestable against the measured value of β, and we say so.

AI.tldr: 本文发展"存在性补偿假说"（ECH），系统审视其每个形式步骤的逻辑地位，将成本-价值等同识别为可争议假设，提出性别角色反转类群的实证检验，修正分歧、不可解性论证和ESS推导中的数学缺陷，并明确框架的可证伪内容。
AI.research_question: 如何严格地形式化并检验"存在性补偿假说"（ECH）——即雄性生物因最小生殖投资的结构性不对称而承受持续的存在性赤字，且该赤字是文明生产的主要引擎——同时修正原论证中的逻辑与数学缺陷？
AI.motivation: 原始ECH论文在形式推导中存在若干未明确标注的假设、证明漏洞和自由参数，且其可证伪性不足。作者旨在通过明确每个形式步骤的逻辑地位、修正数学错误、提出直接经验检验，并清晰划定可证伪内容，来加强该理论的科学严谨性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存在性补偿假说（ECH）；异配生殖系数β；超临界叉形分歧（supercritical pitchfork bifurcation）；风险敏感觅食理论（risk-sensitive foraging theory）；σ-代数独立性与遍历性假设；进化稳定策略（ESS）
AI.method: 形式逻辑分析；使用性别角色反转类群（海龙科、瓣蹼鹬）作为直接经验检验；数学推导修正（分歧理论、小球估计、ESS推导）；熵泛函归一化修正；自动标签系统重建文档交叉引用
AI.findings: （1）成本-价值等同是一个可争议假设而非沉默推导；（2）性别反转类群应导致所有定性结论反转；（3）超临界叉形分歧去除了未动机阈值参数，适用于所有β∈(0,1)；（4）不可解性论证的σ-代数独立假设与原分歧结果矛盾，需替换为小球估计——在作者自身的遍历性假设下，表现性鸿沟几乎必然闭合；（5）高方差ESS可以扎根于风险敏感觅食理论，无需发明阈值公式；（6）另有两处成本尺度等同需要承担相同证据负担；（7）熵泛函存在归一化误差已修正；（8）稳健性对β而言是双刃剑——它使定性主张无法针对β的测量值进行检验。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 明确区分可争议假设与推导结论，提升理论的形式严谨性；(2) 修正叉形分歧推导，扩展普适性至所有β值；(3) 以数学反驳修正不可解性论证；(4) 将ESS建立在既有风险敏感觅食理论上，消除自由参数；(5) 明确标记额外的成本-价值等同假设，揭示其证据负担；(6) 澄清ECH的定性增长预测与性别中立零模型的区别，将可证伪内容定位在两个比较静态主张上。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供性别角色反转类群（海龙科、瓣蹼鹬）作为可直接检验ECH预测的实证途径；(2) 通过对"稳健性-β"双刃剑效应的坦承，帮助研究者理解该理论在何种条件下不可证伪，从而避免过度解释经验数据；(3) 通过自动标签系统提高未来修订版本文档内部一致性。

title: Vehicle Abandonment in the 2025 Palisades Wildfire Evacuation: Identification and Characterization Using Connected Vehicle Data
affiliations: Northwestern University, Utah State University, University of California Los Angeles, California Polytechnic State University, University of North Carolina and

detail.title: Vehicle Abandonment in the 2025 Palisades Wildfire Evacuation: Identification and Characterization Using Connected Vehicle Data
detail.abstract:
Objectives: Fast-moving wildfire evacuations increasingly force evacuees to abandon their vehicles and flee on foot, yet existing post-event analyses only capture vehicles abandoned on roadways, leaving emergency planners and hazard researchers without an empirical understanding of the full scope of abandonment. This study identifies and empirically categorizes distinct typologies of vehicle abandonment during the January 2025 Palisades Fire evacuation using INRIX connected-vehicle trip data.

Methods: We use INRIX trip trajectory data covering the Pacific Palisades neighborhood of Los Angeles to identify 550 abandoned vehicle trips during the initial evacuation window (10:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.) of the January 7, 2025, Palisades Fire. We applied spatiotemporal density-based clustering to identify nine primary clusters, then applied nested hierarchical density-based clustering to detect stable sub-clusters within the two largest groups. We further developed four empirical abandonment typologies based on abandonment location, timing, and pre-abandonment trip characteristics such as travel time, trip distance, and speed traveled.

Findings: Four empirical typologies emerged in our analysis: Major Corridors, Parking Lots, Neighborhood-Based/Strategic Abandonments, and Backflow Trips/Canyons. Roadway-based abandonments, which would be captured by existing abandonment classifications in the literature, accounted for only 24% of all identified abandonments. Kruskal-Wallis tests confirmed significant differences across the typologies.

Novelty: This study is the first to use connected-vehicle trip data to detect and empirically categorize vehicle abandonments during a wildfire evacuation, capturing off-roadway, strategic, and backflow-driven abandonment behaviors that prior post hoc administrative datasets and observational methods could not observe.

Practical Applications: The typologies developed can inform the placement of off-corridor refuge parking areas and the proactive development of contraflow traffic management protocols at bottlenecks. They can also be incorporated as empirically grounded behavioral inputs into future evacuation traffic simulation models.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用INRIX联网车辆轨迹数据，识别并实证分类了2025年1月帕利塞兹山火疏散期间550次弃车事件，提出了四种弃车类型学（主干道、停车场、社区/策略性弃车、回流行程/峡谷），发现仅有24%的弃车发生道路上（即现有文献能捕捉到的部分），填补了野火疏散中弃车行为的认知空白。
AI.research_question: 在快速移动的野火疏散过程中，车辆弃置行为存在哪些不同的类型学特征？现有的行政事后数据集无法观测到的弃车行为（如非道路弃车、策略性弃车、回流驱动弃车）具有怎样的模式和空间分布？
AI.motivation: 快速蔓延的野火疏散迫使撤离者弃车步行逃生的情况日益增多，但现有的灾后分析只能捕捉到道路上的弃车行为，导致应急规划者和灾害研究人员缺乏对弃车全貌的实证理解。这一认知缺口阻碍了疏散应急管理和交通模拟的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间时间密度聚类分析（spatiotemporal density-based clustering）和嵌套层次密度聚类（nested hierarchical density-based clustering）的方法框架，结合弃车位置、时间和弃车前行程特征（行程时间、距离、速度）进行类型学分类。
AI.method: 使用INRIX联网车辆轨迹数据覆盖洛杉矶太平洋帕利塞兹社区，在2025年1月7日上午10:30至下午2:30的初始疏散窗口内识别550次弃车行程。首先应用时空密度聚类识别9个主要聚类，然后对两个最大群体应用嵌套层次密度聚类以检测稳定的子簇，最终基于弃车位置、时间及弃车前行程特征开发四种经验性弃车类型学，并采用Kruskal-Wallis检验验证类型间差异的显著性。
AI.findings: 分析得出四种经验类型学：主干道弃车、停车场弃车、社区/策略性弃车、回流行程/峡谷弃车。关键发现是：现有文献中的弃车分类所能捕捉的道路弃车仅占所有已识别弃车的24%，意味着超过四分之三的弃车行为发生在现有方法未能观测到的场景中。Kruskal-Wallis检验确认了各类型学之间存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究首次使用联网车辆行程数据来检测和实证分类野火疏散中的弃车行为，捕捉到以往灾后行政数据集和观察方法无法观测的非道路、策略性及回流驱动的弃车行为，拓展了灾害疏散中弃车行为研究的理论框架和实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 所开发的类型学可为选址建设非走廊避难停车区提供指导，支持在交通瓶颈处主动制定逆流交通管理协议，并可作为基于实证的行为输入整合到未来的疏散交通模拟模型中，提升应急规划的有效性。

title: Awareness Without Uptake: Administrative Burden and Delivery Architecture in a Within Household Comparison of Four Co-Located Social Protection Schemes in Rural India

detail.title: Awareness Without Uptake: Administrative Burden and Delivery Architecture in a Within Household Comparison of Four Co-Located Social Protection Schemes in Rural India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper. I have no financial interest or competing interests in any of the government schemes evaluated in this study (JEEVIKA, PDS, ICDS, or AB-PM-JAY).
declarations.ethicsApproval: Institutional Review Board Exemption: Ethical approval for this study was explicitly exempted by the Research and Publication Ethics Committee (RPEC) of the Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya. Under the institute's standard operating procedures, primary field studies conducted by postgraduate students to fulfill compulsory course requirements (specifically, the community immersion component) do not require independent ethics clearance, and the institute does not grant retrospective clearance
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author declares that no specific grant was received from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors to support this work

detail.abstract:
Under-utilisation of targeted entitlements in rural India is routinely attributed to information deficits, and the information campaign is the default policy response. That attribution is difficult to test, because utilisation is almost always studied one scheme at a time and compared across populations, which confounds the delivery architecture of a scheme with the characteristics of the people receiving it. This study asks what constrains utilisation once awareness is close to universal. Methods. Cross-sectional household survey in Bodh Gaya block, Gaya district, Bihar, January 2025, in a village saturated by a resident community intermediary.

Fifty-one households reported awareness and utilisation of four co-located schemes: JEEViKA (livelihoods), PDS (food), ICDS (child nutrition) and AB-PM-JAY (hospital insurance). Measuring all four schemes in the same households in a single round holds demand side characteristics such as poverty, literacy and distance constant by construction, so that remaining variation is attributable to how each scheme is administered. We define entitlement conversion as utilisation divided by awareness, a descriptive diagnostic of the compliance costs a household faces after it knows a benefit exists, and report 95% Wilson score intervals with bootstrap intervals for the ratio. Results. 

Awareness was high and comparatively flat, from 64.7% (PDS; 95% CI 51.0-76.4) to 100% (JEEViKA; 93.0-100.0). Conversion varied far more. The three schemes obtained at a point inside the village converted at 0.79 to 0.98. AB-PM-JAY, which requires documented enrolment at an office outside the village, converted at 0.42 (0.26-0.58) despite being better known than PDS; receipt of this scheme is episodic and partly reflects need for inpatient care, which we address in the limitations. Among 26 households not receiving benefits, the barriers reported most often were procedural complexity (69.2%) and administrative distance (57.7%); lack of information ranked third (30.8%) and none attributed exclusion to the intermediary. Ninety-four per cent named the resident JEEViKA worker as their information source for all four schemes, including three she does not administer. Conclusions. 

Where a resident intermediary has achieved near-universal reach, the observed loss occurs after the household knows a scheme and before it obtains the benefit and is associated with where enrolment must be completed and what documents it requires rather than with how well the scheme is known. The design cannot identify why awareness is high, so this speaks to the current margin rather than to campaign effectiveness. Comparing schemes within households converts a question about populations into a question about architectures, which is the object policy can act on.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在同一村庄内测量四种政府福利计划（JEEViKA、PDS、ICDS、AB-PM-JAY）的知晓率和利用率，提出"转化率"（利用率/知晓率）作为诊断合规成本的指标。研究发现当居民信息中介使知晓率接近普及时，福利获取损失主要发生在知晓与获得之间，其制约因素并非信息缺乏，而是行政距离和程序复杂性等合规成本。
AI.research_question: 当信息知晓率接近普及时，是什么因素制约了农村印度定向福利计划的利用率？
AI.motivation: 印度农村定向福利计划利用率不足常被归因于信息缺失，信息宣传活动是默认政策应对。但以往研究一次只研究一个计划并在不同人群间比较，混淆了计划的交付架构与受益人群特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合规成本框架——将福利获取过程分解为"知晓"与"获得"两个环节，利用同户内多计划比较，将需求侧特征（贫困、识字率、距离）通过构造保持恒定，从而隔离出行政架构的独立效应。
AI.method: 在印度比哈尔邦菩提伽耶区块进行横截面家庭调查（2025年1月），选取一个由常驻社区中介覆盖的村庄，调查51户家庭对四种共存计划的知晓率和利用率。采用Wilson分数区间和自助法计算转化率比率。
AI.findings: 知晓率普遍较高且相对平坦（64.7%-100%），但转化率差异显著：在村内获取的三种计划转化率为0.79-0.98，而需要在村外办公室办理登记文件的AB-PM-JAY转化率仅为0.42。未获福利的家庭中，程序复杂性（69.2%）和行政距离（57.7%）是最常报告的障碍，信息缺乏仅排第三（30.8%）。94%的家庭将常驻中介视为所有四种计划的信息来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"知情转化率"这一诊断性概念，将福利利用问题从人群特征问题转化为架构问题；通过同户内多计划比较的方法论创新，为隔离需求侧与供给侧因素提供了研究设计范例。
AI.practical_contributions: 挑战了"信息缺失"作为福利利用率不足的首要归因，指出政策应聚焦于降低行政距离（如村内办理点）和简化程序复杂性，而非单纯增加信息宣传活动。

title: Unions: The Idea vs. the Form at Hand — How America Is Rebuilding, on Both Ends, an Engine the Twentieth Century Already Ran to Completion

detail.title: Unions: The Idea vs. the Form at Hand — How America Is Rebuilding, on Both Ends, an Engine the Twentieth Century Already Ran to Completion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the self-represented litigant in the state-employment matter the paper draws on and was a dues-paying member and steward of the union (COWINS) it examines. The paper is written from that standpoint, which it discloses throughout; it is offered as criticism and interpretive analysis, imputes no bad faith to any person, and acknowledges the union's reported gains as real.
declarations.ethicsApproval: None. This research received no external funding.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable; no human-subjects research.

detail.abstract: Every union rests on an idea older than any of its institutions: that the worker who stands alone will not have to, because the members’ own combined force, organized and directed by them, meets the employer’s power with power. This paper measures the American labor-relations order against that idea. What has been built, lawfully and incrementally and mostly in good faith, is something else: an architecture of administration, in which bodies speaking in the worker’s name hold every lever the worker would need to act in her own. The finding would matter less if the trajectory of such architecture were unknown. It is not, and the diagnosis is older than the country. A rule without a sanction, the founders’ generation warned, is not law but advice, and its accumulation is the signal of an ending. That prediction was then specified from inside the workers’ movement itself: first by Marx and Engels in their own hand, in the 1850 Addresses and the 1874 Conspectus of Bakunin; then by Trotsky in 1904, as a warning against Lenin’s organizational form, and by Michels in 1911, as an iron law derived from the most democratic workers’ party in Europe. It was run to completion in the Soviet constitutions, which proclaimed that “all power belongs to the working people” while constructing the apparatus that administered those people to the edge of the possible. America built a twin of that architecture from the other end: the employer-chartered “representation” born at Ludlow, which Senator Wagner, in the statement he submitted on introducing the bill in 1935, condemned as the “sham or dummy union,” and which was then quietly readmitted, in structure if never in name, through the public-sector door the condemnation does not reach. The paper reads the governing instruments of the present order (a state partnership statute, a partnership agreement, a union constitution, and a purposive sample of national-union constitutions) against the Rockefeller Plan of 1915, the Soviet constitutions of 1918–1977, and the founding texts of both the Marxian and the American traditions, together with a measure-by-measure reading of the Manifesto’s ten-point program against the same two constitutional histories. It documents a single convergent design: governance in place of membership, process in place of recourse, the institution’s discretion in place of the member’s hand. The convergence is dominant rather than universal, and the exceptions are reported: two internationals open the access half of the decisive gate, and neither opens the award half. The measurement extends the author’s prior three-constitution study (The Inextinguishable Right, SSRN 2026). The Marxian subordination test, the Hamiltonian sanction-and-responsibility test, and the constitutional rule-of-law test (Estonia’s “[o]nly published laws can have obligatory force”) prove to be one test in three registers, and the present order fails all three, though not in the same way — the Soviet limiting case, for one, satisfies Hamilton’s sanction test emphatically while inverting subordination absolutely, so the three tests converge on a common failure rather than collapsing into one. The paper’s contribution is one test — the direction of subordination, read from an institution’s governing instruments — applied at two scales with two complementary designs: a single-state, public-sector chain from Ludlow to the 2020 Partnership Act, whose governing instruments withhold from the member’s own invocation every gate that binds (the contract track’s arbitration and award; the statutory charge channel is left open but unnamed on review), and a polity-scale reading of the Manifesto’s ten measures showing that the fate of identical policy content is set not by its doctrine but by the subordination direction of the machinery it passes through. Same test, both scales. The paper closes with a prediction issued with the precision the evidence permits: architectures of this kind, untended, have nowhere in this record been observed to hold ground; the record’s completed cases all eroded toward the limiting case. The evidence stops at the labor relation. But if the tendency Michels derived for every organization holds beyond it, then a republic whose civil-society bodies converge on administration over membership is running the engine whose output is already on record. If the course is not shifted, America will not be conquered into the thing it opposed. It will administrate itself into it, form by form, gate by gate.

AI.tldr: 本文以"工人是否真正保有自身行动的能力"这一工会运动的核心理念为标尺，衡量美国劳动关系的现行制度秩序。研究发现，美国通过合法、渐进的方式建立了一套"行政管理架构"（governance in place of membership），在这些架构中，以工人名义发言的机构实际上掌握了工人自主行动所需的全部杠杆。论文将现行治理文书与洛克菲勒计划（1915）、苏联宪法（1918–1977）及马克思主义与美国建国文献进行对照，揭示了一个趋同的设计：以治理取代成员身份、以程序取代救济、以机构裁量取代成员之手。作者提出"隶属方向检验"（direction of subordination）这一统一测试，在单一州公共部门链条与《共产党宣言》十点纲领两个尺度上加以应用，证明现行制度在马克思的从属检验、汉密尔顿的制裁-责任检验和宪治法治检验三个层面上均告失败。论文最后预测：此类未经修治的行政管理架构在历史上从未守住阵地，均向极限情形侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 美国劳动关系现行制度秩序是否背离了工会运动的核心理念——工人应凭借自身组织起来的联合力量直接行动，而非被以工人名义设立的行政机构所代理？如果背离，其结构特征与历史轨迹如何？
AI.motivation: 美国现行劳动关系秩序以合法、渐进、大体善意的方式建立了一套行政管理架构，其中以工人名义说话的机构掌握了工人自主行动所需的一切杠杆。作者认为，如果此类架构的历史轨迹已知——从马克思、恩格斯到托洛茨基、米歇尔斯，再到苏联宪法——那么这种偏离的后果是可以预见的。作者还指出，美国从另一端（雇主特许的"伪工会"）构建了这个架构的双生体，并通过公共部门之门被悄悄重新接纳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 马克思的从属检验（subordination test）；2. 汉密尔顿的制裁-责任检验（sanction-and-responsibility test）；3. 宪治法治检验（如爱沙尼亚"唯有公布的法律才具有强制力"）；4. 米歇尔斯的"寡头铁律"；5. 马克思、恩格斯1850年代Addresses与1874年巴枯宁《纲要》中的相关论述；6. 托洛茨基1904年对列宁组织形式的警告。
AI.method: 文本/制度比较分析。作者对现行治理文书（州伙伴关系法规、伙伴关系协议、工会章程及全国工会章程的目的性样本）与洛克菲勒计划（1915）、苏联宪法（1918–1977）、马克思与美国建国传统文献进行对读，并对《共产党宣言》十点纲领与两部宪法史进行逐条对照。这是对作者先前三宪法研究（The Inextinguishable Right, SSRN 2026）的扩展。
AI.findings: 1. 现行制度与苏联架构及洛克菲勒计划呈现单一趋同设计：以治理取代成员身份、以程序取代救济、以机构裁量取代成员之手；2. 趋同是主导性的而非普遍的，作者报告了例外——两个国际工会打开了"访问"半边关键之门，但均未打开"裁决"半边；3. 马克思从属检验、汉密尔顿制裁-责任检验和宪治法治检验证明是同一检验的三个不同表述，现行制度在三个层面均失败，但失败方式不同（如苏联极限情形明显满足汉密尔顿的制裁检验，却绝对地颠倒了从属关系）；4. 单一州公共部门链条（从Ludlow到2020年《伙伴关系法》）的治理文书从成员自身的援引中扣留了每个约束之门（合同轨道的仲裁与裁决；法定指控渠道虽开放但在审查中未具名）；5. 各组织向官僚化—行政化方向趋同的趋势（米歇尔斯铁律）在劳动关系之外也可能成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出一个统一检验——"隶属方向检验"（direction of subordination），从机构的治理文书中读取从属关系的方向；2. 证明马克思从属检验、汉密尔顿制裁-责任检验与宪治法治检验是同一检验的三个不同表述（register），三者趋同于共同的失败而非坍缩为一；3. 将同一检验应用于两个尺度（单一州公共部门链条与政体尺度的《宣言》十点纲领），展示相同政策内容的命运不取决于其教义而取决于其所经机构的从属方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为评估劳动关系制度是否真正服务于工人自主行动提供可操作的诊断工具（从治理文书中读取隶属方向）；2. 揭示美国公共部门劳动关系制度中"伪工会"结构以何种方式被重新接纳，并指出其制度漏洞所在（合同轨道的仲裁与裁决之门被扣留）；3. 基于历史记录提出预警性预测：此类行政管理架构未经修治不会守住阵地，若公民社会机构持续向行政化趋同，共和国将以行政化而非征服的方式滑向其反对之物。

title: FaithGate: A Proposed Architecture for Real-Time Hallucination Detection and Correction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

detail.title: FaithGate: A Proposed Architecture for Real-Time Hallucination Detection and Correction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a conceptual framework design study and does not involve human participants, human data, human tissue, or animals. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) was introduced as a remedy for the tendency of large language models to fabricate information, grounding generation in externally retrieved documents rather than relying solely on parametric memory. In practice, however, RAG systems continue to produce ungrounded, contradictory, or subtly fabricated claims, because retrieval and generation remain functionally disconnected: nothing in the standard pipeline verifies that what the model writes is actually entailed by what it retrieved. This paper proposes FaithGate, a structured, multi-layered framework for real-time hallucination detection and correction in RAG systems. The architecture integrates four interdependent components: a Claim Decomposer that segments generated responses into atomic, independently verifiable claims; a Groundedness Estimator that scores each claim against retrieved evidence using entailment-based methods; a Contradiction Detector that flags claims which conflict with source material; and a Correction Loop that regenerates, hedges, or removes claims that fail verification, governed throughout by a Transparency Logger that produces an auditable record of every correction. The framework is grounded in a review of foundational and recent literature spanning retrieval-augmented generation, hallucination detection, natural language inference, and faithfulness evaluation. An architectural diagram and a pseudoalgorithmic specification of the core verificationcorrection loop are provided to bridge conceptual design and practical implementability. The paper concludes by identifying limitations around latency overhead, evaluationmetric disagreement, and dependence on retrieval quality, along with a forward-looking research agenda for empirical validation across enterprise, legal, and healthcare RAG deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FaithGate框架，一种用于RAG系统中实时幻觉检测与纠正的结构化多层架构，通过四个相互关联的组件（Claim Decomposer、Groundedness Estimator、Contradiction Detector、Correction Loop）以及Transparency Logger，弥合检索与生成之间的功能脱节，确保生成内容真正由检索证据所蕴含。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构化、多层次的框架在RAG系统中实现实时幻觉检测与纠正，以解决检索与生成之间功能脱节的问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管RAG被引入以缓解大语言模型的幻觉问题，但实际中RAG系统仍会生成无依据、矛盾或微妙虚构的内容，因为标准流程中缺乏对生成内容是否真正被检索文档蕴含的验证机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成、幻觉检测、自然语言推理（蕴含关系）、忠实度评估等相关文献综述构成理论基础。
AI.method: 提出FaithGate框架，集成四个组件：Claim Decomposer（将响应分解为原子性可验证声明）、Groundedness Estimator（基于蕴含方法对声明与证据进行评分）、Contradiction Detector（标记与源材料冲突的声明）、Correction Loop（重新生成、模糊化或删除未通过验证的声明）；同时提供架构图和伪算法规范。
AI.findings: 论文提出了一套完整的框架设计与伪算法规范，但尚未进行实证验证；识别出延迟开销、评估指标不一致、对检索质量的依赖等三大局限性，并提出跨企业、法律和医疗场景的实证研究议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结构化的验证-纠正闭环概念框架，将自然语言推理方法与RAG幻觉检测相结合，弥合了概念设计与实际实现之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实现的伪算法规范和架构图，为RAG系统的工程实施提供可操作的蓝图；透明日志系统为审计和合规提供支持，尤其适用于企业、法律和医疗等高风险领域。

title: Climate Action Governance: Lessons from California
affiliations: , University of California, Irvine and

detail.title: Climate Action Governance: Lessons from California
detail.abstract:
Through a collision of state laws, policies, and programs, California recommends, mandates, and signals how local governments should achieve climate mitigation, adaptation, and environmental justice outcomes. However, the governance regimes established by the state to address issues such as climate policy, environmental justice, energy systems, groundwater management, and community resilience lack coordination and careful harmonization with local land use decision-making. Many local governments, land use law and policy scholars, and community organizations have made this clear for decades. For example, the California Environmental Protection Agency’s first Strategic Vision in 2000 promised to “assist local land use authorities in developing local land use ordinances.” A California Air Resources Board policy statement in 2001 promised to “work with local land use agencies to develop ways to assess, consider, and reduce cumulative emissions, exposures, and health risks via General Plans, permitting, and other local actions.”

 

A quarter century later, through interviews with local, regional, and state agency and elected officials; community organizations; industry leaders and consultants; and experts in city management and planning, organizational performance, and public participation, we chart the principal barriers to achieving such lofty goals. We researched the relationship between state climate policy and local authorities. Climate Action Governance includes findings developed from semi-structured interviews (n=63) with key informants from the San Joaquin Valley and Southern California, supplemented by content analysis of public documents, legal analysis, and feedback during a policy design workshop held at the UC California Student and Policy Center in Sacramento, California.

 

We identified three cross-cutting themes that pervade local climate action planning: (1) insufficient state regulatory directives; (2) limited state financial, human, data, and planning support, leading to limited knowledge, resources, and infrastructure among local governments to advance state goals for managing climate change and its impacts; and (3) insufficient state guidance on how to engage in climate action planning in order to achieve effective, efficient, and equitable outcomes. In addition, local jurisdictions are beset by institutional dynamics that further frustrate climate action planning. First, plan development is limited due to overlapping, conflicting, and uncoordinated authority. Second, plan development is beset by data generation, dissemination, and analysis limits. Third, local governments face severe challenges of post-approval CAP implementation. Fourth, CAP development and implementation raise significant procedural and substantive justice challenges that limit plan effectiveness. 

 

These dynamics are of great concern, as municipal planning is a crucial frontier in U.S. climate policy. Local land use authority affects over 70% of our nation’s carbon emissions. The importance of local planning – particularly via development of Climate Action Plans – a primary means by which governments formalize strategies to reduce carbon emissions, adapt to hazards, and shore up community resilience in the face of those hazards – will continue to grow in the coming decades, as local action becomes a principal strategy to manage climate change. Through analysis of interviewees and feedback from planners and community leaders, we developed a roadmap to increase the level of ambition and performance of local climate action.

AI.tldr: 本文通过63次半结构化访谈及文件分析，研究了加州州级气候政策与地方土地利用决策之间的关系，识别出地方气候行动规划面临的三类跨领域障碍（州监管指令不足、州财政与人力和数据支持有限、州对气候行动规划的参与指导不足），以及四类制度性挑战（权力重叠冲突、数据限制、实施困难、程序与实质正义问题），并提出了提升地方气候行动雄心和绩效的路线图。
AI.research_question: 加州州级气候政策与地方政府土地利用决策之间的关系如何？地方气候行动规划面临哪些主要障碍？如何提升地方气候行动的雄心与绩效？
AI.motivation: 加州通过多项州法律和政策推动地方政府实现气候减缓、适应和环境正义目标，但州政府建立的各种治理制度缺乏与地方土地利用决策的协调与整合。过去25年来这一矛盾持续存在，需要系统性地识别阻碍地方气候行动的主要障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候行动治理（Climate Action Governance）框架
AI.method: 对圣华金谷和南加州的关键知情者进行63次半结构化访谈，辅以公共文件内容分析、法律分析，以及在加州大学萨克拉门托政策中心举办的政策设计研讨会反馈。
AI.findings: 识别出三大跨领域主题：(1)州监管指令不足；(2)州财政、人力、数据和规划支持有限，导致地方政府知识、资源和基础设施不足；(3)州对气候行动规划的参与指导不足。此外，地方辖区面临四类制度性挑战：权力重叠冲突且缺乏协调、数据生成与传播分析受限、CAP批准后实施面临严重困难、CAP开发与实施存在程序与实质正义挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将州-地方治理关系、机构动态与气候行动规划相结合，识别出阻碍地方气候行动的综合性障碍框架，为气候治理文献提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加州州政府和地方政府提供了提升地方气候行动雄心与绩效的路线图；强调了地方土地利用权力影响全美70%以上碳排放的重要现实，为政策制定者提供了具体的改进方向。

title: From Strategic HR Competencies to HRM Effectiveness in Post-Pandemic Hotels: Evidence from Phuket’s Tourism-Dependent Hospitality Sector
affiliations: Prince of Songkla University, Prince of Songkla University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Strategic HR Competencies to HRM Effectiveness in Post-Pandemic Hotels: Evidence from Phuket’s Tourism-Dependent Hospitality Sector
detail.abstract: Strategic HR competencies are increasingly viewed as central to hotel recovery, yet how they translate into HRM effectiveness under sustained volatility remains underspecified, particularly in tourism-dependent destinations. Drawing on the resource-based view, the dynamic capabilities perspective, and contingency theory, this study examines whether organizational agility mediates the relationship between strategic HR competencies and HRM effectiveness, and whether proactive and reactive strategies moderate the agility–effectiveness link in post-pandemic hotels. A quantitative-dominant explanatory sequential mixed-methods design was used. Survey data from 324 HR and management practitioners nested within 90 four- and five-star hotels in Phuket, Thailand, were analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling, complemented by two focus group discussions. Strategic HR competencies positively influenced both organizational agility and HRM effectiveness, and organizational agility partially mediated this relationship. Both proactive and reactive strategies positively moderated the agility–effectiveness link, but a bootstrap difference test confirmed that proactive moderation was significantly stronger. Importance–performance map analysis identified organizational agility as the highest-priority area for managerial improvement. The focus groups grounded these patterns in Phuket's recovery realities, where workforce rebuilding and uneven occupancy recovery shaped HR practice. The study refines contingency thinking by treating proactive and reactive strategies as theoretically distinct boundary conditions, and offers practitioners a recovery-oriented agenda for tourism-dependent hospitality settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究以泰国普吉岛90家四五星级酒店为样本，采用定量为主的解释性序贯混合方法设计，探讨战略人力资源管理能力通过组织敏捷性影响人力资源管理有效性的机制，并检验前瞻性与反应性策略的调节作用。研究发现组织敏捷性起部分中介作用，前瞻性策略的调节效应显著强于反应性策略，组织敏捷性是管理改进的最优先领域。
AI.research_question: 在持续波动（尤其是疫情后）的背景下，战略人力资源管理能力如何转化为人力资源管理有效性？组织敏捷性是否在其中起中介作用？前瞻性与反应性策略如何调节敏捷性与有效性之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 战略人力资源管理能力被视为酒店复苏的核心，但在持续波动环境下其如何转化为人力资源管理有效性仍缺乏充分阐释，尤其是对于旅游依赖型目的地而言，这一转化机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）、动态能力视角、权变理论
AI.method: 采用定量主导的解释性序贯混合方法设计。对泰国普吉岛90家四五星级酒店中324名人力资源和管理从业者进行问卷调查，运用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析数据，辅以两场焦点小组讨论，并进行重要性-绩效图分析（IPMA）。
AI.findings: 战略人力资源管理能力对组织敏捷性和人力资源管理有效性均有正向影响；组织敏捷性部分中介了这一关系；前瞻性和反应性策略均正向调节敏捷性与有效性之间的关系，但通过bootstrap差异检验证实前瞻性策略的调节作用显著更强；IPMA识别出组织敏捷性是管理改进的最高优先级领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 精炼了权变理论，将前瞻性策略和反应性策略视为理论上不同的边界条件；将资源基础观、动态能力视角与权变理论整合，为战略HR能力转化为HRM有效性提供了更完整的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游依赖型酒店行业提供了以复苏为导向的管理议程，识别出组织敏捷性作为最优先改进领域，指导酒店管理者在疫情后复苏期合理配置资源并选择更有效的策略类型。

title: Epicurean Echoes: Indian Cuisine's Representation of Historical and Social Diversity
affiliations: Regional Institute of Education, Bhubaneswar, Regional Institute of Education, Bhubaneswar and

detail.title: Epicurean Echoes: Indian Cuisine's Representation of Historical and Social Diversity
detail.abstract: The article has been written to do a theoretical exploration of Indian cuisine as a symbolic system that reflects India's complex historical paths and its hierarchical social order. Food in India is not just for eating. It works like a language. Every dish, ingredient, and cooking method carries meaning. This paper places the cuisine as a type of text at the intersection of cultural anthropology, sociology of food, and postcolonial life, informing us that this is not simply something to be eaten, but it carries with it the meaning of social and cultural power relations and historical influences that it has experienced. The additional exposure to theoretical ideas is also explained, e.g., structuralist binaries of Levi-Strauss, semiology of everyday practices, purity-pollution framework, distinction, and habitus of Bourdieu and gastro-politics of Appadurai. The Indian food is defined as a semiotic sphere in which such elements as the ways of preparation, ingredients, associated taboos and divisions are used as the signifier as they represent historical experience and social difference. Structuralist theory says culture works through opposites, Ex, Pure/ Impure, Sacred/ Profane, etc. Appadurai's theory refers to politics through food. The key point of this thesis is the metaphor of the epicurean echo, which suits Indian cuisine to make it an archive of the remnants of Vedic cosmologies, medieval Islamic-Persianate syncretism, colonial interruption via New World crops and imperial gastro-politics, and postcolonial imaginary images of national identity. The article also explores how culinary practices reproduce social stratifications, like hierarchies based on purity codes, religious beliefs rooted in taboo systems, gender roles, and regional variations, while also enabling resistance and renegotiation. This article contributes to the field of food studies by placing Indian cuisine into the larger context. This process illustrates the semiotic worth of food in constructing identity, cultural stability, and power in the postcolonial world. This theoretical practice adds depth to theoretical discussion within anthropology, sociology and cultural studies because it provides cuisine with an active role in the process of meaning-making in history and society.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论层面探讨印度菜作为一个符号系统，如何反映印度复杂的历史路径与等级社会秩序。文章将美食视为一种"文本"，置于文化人类学、食物社会学与后殖民研究的交叉领域，运用列维-斯特劳斯的结构主义二元对立、布尔迪厄的区隔与惯习、洁净-污染框架以及阿帕杜莱的"美食政治"等理论，提出"史诗式回响"隐喻，论证印度菜是吠陀宇宙观、中世纪伊斯兰-波斯文化融合、殖民中断及后殖民民族想象的历史档案，同时探讨烹饪实践如何再生产社会分层并促成抵抗与再协商。
AI.research_question: 印度菜作为符号系统如何反映印度复杂的历史路径及其等级社会秩序？具体而言，烹饪实践如何既再生产社会分层（洁净等级、宗教禁忌、性别角色、地域差异），又使抵抗与再协商成为可能？
AI.motivation: 食物在印度不仅是果腹之物，更是一种类似于语言的意义系统，但已有研究尚未充分将印度菜作为符号文本置于文化人类学、食物社会学与后殖民研究的交叉视角下进行系统理论探索，以揭示其中蕴含的社会文化权力关系与历史影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 列维-斯特劳斯的结构主义二元对立（洁净/不洁、神圣/世俗）、符号学日常生活实践理论、洁净-污染框架、布尔迪厄的区隔与惯习理论、阿帕杜莱的美食政治（gastro-politics）理论。
AI.method: 理论探索与概念分析（非经验研究），通过运用结构主义、符号学、文化人类学与后殖民理论框架，对印度菜进行语义学层面的理论解读。
AI.findings: 印度菜构成一个符号学领域，其烹饪方式、食材、相关禁忌与分类作为能指，表征历史经验与社会差异；提出"史诗式回响"隐喻，将印度菜视为吠陀宇宙观、中世纪伊斯兰-波斯融合、殖民中断（新大陆作物与帝国美食政治）与后殖民民族身份想象的历史档案；烹饪实践同时再生产社会分层也促成抵抗与再协商。
AI.theory_contributions: 将印度菜置于食物研究更宏大的语境中，阐明食物在建构后殖民世界中的身份认同、文化延续性与权力关系方面的符号学价值；赋予食品在历史与社会意义建构中积极作用，深化了人类学、社会学与文化研究的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食物研究领域提供理解印度菜符号意义的理论框架，帮助人们超越"饮食"本身，认识印度美食背后承载的社会文化权力关系、历史印记与身份建构功能。

title: Equality of Opportunity and Efficiency in Secondary Education before and after Covid-19 Pandemic
affiliations: University of Bari "Aldo Moro" and Politecnico di Milano - Department of Management, Economics and Industrial Engineering

detail.title: Equality of Opportunity and Efficiency in Secondary Education before and after Covid-19 Pandemic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: Tommaso Agasisti gratefully acknowledges financial support from the European Commission Horizon Europe project EFFEct (Grant 101129146). The views and opinions expressed are those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the granting authority. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the evolution of inequality of opportunity (IOp) and efficiency in secondary education before and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Using microdata from the OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) for 2018 and 2022, we estimate IOp in mathematics, reading, and science across 24 countries using Machine Learning (ML) methods, namely Conditional Inference Trees and Forests algorithm. In a second step, the paper evaluates how efficiently countries transform educational resources into both average academic performance and equality of opportunity through Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA). Productivity dynamics between 2018 and 2022 are then examined through the Malmquist Index. Main findings show that inequality of opportunity increased in almost all countries following the pandemic, while technical efficiency in maximizing both educational performance and equality of opportunity declined. Overall productivity improved due to technological progress. According to our estimates, efficiency and equity are not mutually exclusive dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用OECD PISA 2018和2022年数据，结合机器学习方法（条件推断树和随机森林）估算24个国家中学生在数学、阅读和科学学科的机会不平等程度，并运用数据包络分析（DEA）评估各国将教育资源转化为学术表现和机会平等的效率，最后通过Malmquist指数分析2018至2022年的生产率动态。主要发现：疫情后几乎所有国家的机会不平等加剧，最大化教育表现与机会平等的技术效率下降，但整体生产率因技术进步而提升；效率与公平并非相互排斥。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情前后，中等教育中的机会不平等（IOp）与效率如何演变？各国在转化教育资源为学业表现与机会平等方面的生产率动态如何？效率与公平是否相互排斥？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情对全球教育系统造成了巨大冲击，但已有研究较少系统性地从机会不平等和效率双重视角，利用跨国微观数据量化疫情对教育公平与效率的影响，且缺乏对"效率-公平"是否可兼得的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机会不平等理论（IOp框架）、生产效率理论（数据包络分析DEA）、生产率分析（Malmquist指数）、机器学习方法（条件推断树与随机森林）
AI.method: 利用PISA 2018和2022年24国微观数据，采用条件推断树（Conditional Inference Trees）和随机森林（Forests）机器学习算法估算各学科的机会不平等；运用数据包络分析（DEA）评估各国教育资源转化效率；通过Malmquist指数分解生产率变化为技术效率变化与技术进步。
AI.findings: （1）疫情后几乎所有国家（24国中绝大多数）的机会不平等均有所上升；（2）在同时最大化学业表现与机会平等方面，各国的技术效率普遍下降；（3）整体生产率有所提升，但主要归因于技术进步（前沿移动）而非技术效率改善；（4）效率与公平并非相互排斥的维度，二者可以同时实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机会不平等核算与生产效率分析相结合，构建了"教育资源—学业表现—机会公平"的统一分析框架；利用机器学习方法改进了传统IOp估计的精度；通过Malmquist指数分解揭示疫情后教育生产率变化的来源，为理解效率与公平关系提供了新的跨国实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国教育政策制定者提供了疫情期间及后疫情时代教育公平与效率的跨国比较基准；识别出技术进步可能掩盖技术效率退步的重要现象，提示政策关注点应从单纯的技术提升转向资源配置效率的改善；否定了"效率与公平冲突"的传统观念，为兼顾公平与效率的教育改革提供了实证支持。

title: Contribution of Major Authors to the Evolution of English and Indian Literatures: A Comparative Analysis
affiliations: Regional Institute of Education, Bhubaneswar and

detail.title: Contribution of Major Authors to the Evolution of English and Indian Literatures: A Comparative Analysis
detail.abstract: This research article provides us with a comparative analysis of pivotal authors in English (mainly British) and Indian literature. It includes the classical as well as regional literatures along with Indian writing in English. This study has been done to explore what role they played in English Literature. We try to understand how they acted as a catalyst for the transformation of linguistic standards, innovation across themes, experiments across different ages, as well as how the literature reflected the social and cultural traditions across historical periods.

AI.tldr: 本文对英语（主要为英国）文学与印度文学中的关键作家进行了比较分析，涵盖了古典文学、地区文学以及印度英语写作，探讨它们在英语文学发展中的作用。
AI.research_question: 英国文学与印度文学中的关键作家在英语文学发展中扮演了什么角色？它们如何推动语言标准的转变、主题创新以及跨时代的文学实验？
AI.motivation: 旨在通过比较分析理解不同文化背景下的作家如何催化语言标准转型、促进主题创新和文体实验，以及文学如何反映不同历史时期的社会文化传统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较文学理论；文学与社会文化互动理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，涵盖古典文学、地区文学及印度英语写作的文本研究
AI.findings: 英国与印度文学中的关键作家在语言标准转型、主题创新以及跨时代文学实验中发挥了催化作用，文学创作深刻反映了不同历史时期的社会文化传统。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了比较文学研究视角，拓展了英国与印度文学互动关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英语文学教学与研究提供了跨文化比较的参考框架，有助于理解文学与社会文化的动态关系。

title: From Kiosk to Conversation: Artificial Intelligence and the Redesign of the Physical Health Access Point

detail.title: From Kiosk to Conversation: Artificial Intelligence and the Redesign of the Physical Health Access Point
detail.abstract: Retail health kiosks failed at scale. This paper argues that the failure has been misdiagnosed as a problem of hardware and placement, and that correctly diagnosing it determines whether artificial intelligence can succeed where the previous generation did not. Beginning from an unimplemented 2014 proposal to deliver health services through partnered automated teller machine networks, the paper identifies three causes of the category's collapse: a value proposition built on convenience at the moment convenience migrated to the smartphone; a business model in which no party held a durable financial interest in maintaining the machines; and a channel-need inversion in which the delivery point was used most by the age cohort consuming the least care and least by the cohort consuming the most, compounded by the incompatibility between the transactional mental mode of a cash withdrawal and the conditions a clinical encounter requires. It then advances artificial intelligence not as a feature added to the kiosk but as a different operating model, in which the station ceases to be a self-service product and becomes an endpoint of a care delivery system-setting out four capabilities and four design commitments that distinguish the two. A natural experiment supports the diagnosis: telehealth stations now operating in rural bank branches use the same hardware, from the same vendor, whose retail deployment failed. Against this, the paper identifies measured over-triage in large language models as a direct and underexamined threat to the cost argument such deployments depend upon. It closes with design responses to each unresolved constraint and a testable research and implementation agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文重新诊断零售健康自助机大规模失败的真正原因，指出其失败并非硬件与选址问题，而是价值主张、商业模式与渠道需求错配三大结构性缺陷所致。文章主张人工智能不应作为自助机的附加功能，而应作为完全不同的运营模式——将站点从自助服务产品转变为照护输送系统的端点，并通过对农村银行网点远程医疗站的自然实验加以验证。
AI.research_question: 零售健康自助机为何大规模失败？人工智能能否以及如何在前一代技术失败的领域获得成功？
AI.motivation: 零售健康自助机在规模化部署中遭遇全面失败，但学界与业界通常将其归因于硬件缺陷与选址不当，这种误诊阻碍了正确解决方案的形成。随着人工智能的发展，正确诊断失败根源成为判断AI能否取代前一代技术的关键前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文章基于三个结构性分析维度：价值主张理论（便利性价值随智能手机迁移而失效）、商业模式理论（缺乏持久财务激励的所有权结构）、渠道—需求匹配理论（服务使用人群与医疗需求人群的错位，以及交易性心智模式与临床互动条件的不兼容）。
AI.method: 本文采用多方法结合：（1）对2014年未实施的ATM健康服务提案进行历史案例回溯；（2）理论分析识别三大失败原因；（3）自然实验——对比零售场景中失败的同一供应商硬件在农村银行分行远程医疗站中的成功运作；（4）对大型语言模型过度分诊现象进行测量与讨论。
AI.findings: 三大失败原因：第一，价值主张建立在便利性上，恰逢便利性迁移至智能手机；第二，商业模式中没有任何一方对机器维护拥有持久财务利益；第三，渠道—需求倒挂——使用最多的是医疗消费最少的年龄群体，使用最少的是消费最多的群体，同时取现的交易性心智模式与临床环境所需的互动条件不相容。此外，研究发现LLM的过度分诊行为直接威胁到此类部署赖以成立的成本论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对零售健康自助机失败提供了结构性病因学诊断，修正了"硬件与选址问题"的流行误判；提出AI作为运营模式而非功能附加的重新概念化框架，区分了四个能力与四项设计承诺；识别出LLM过度分诊作为尚未充分研究的威胁并加以理论化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI健康站点的设计与部署提供可操作的四大能力与四项设计承诺；回应各未解决约束的具体设计方案；提出可检验的研究与实施议程，为政策制定者和从业者提供指导。

title: Spiritual Intelligence as the Foundation of Ethical Decision-Making: Cultivating Human Excellence in Higher Education in Alignment with NEP 2020
affiliations: ,  MDS College of Education and Regional Institute of Education (NCERT)

detail.title: Spiritual Intelligence as the Foundation of Ethical Decision-Making: Cultivating Human Excellence in Higher Education in Alignment with NEP 2020
detail.abstract: The lowest standard of ethical decision-making and values erosion is visibly demonstrable in the Indian higher education landscape today, with instrumentalism, leadership problems and lack of purpose among students and educators. In this context, Spiritual Intelligence (SI) becomes a key higher-order ability and the means by which people can get at increased meaning, moral sensitivity, and wisdom during decision-making. This paper demonstrates that, intrinsic to Indian Knowledge Systems, SI is this core competence which ensures the development of human excellence and the convergence of higher education with the overall integrated approach of the National Education Policy 2020. The paper makes use of contemporary SI models and classical Indian theories such as the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita, which highlight self-knowledge and selfless action, equanimity and moral intuition, respectively, to create a conceptual framework wherein SI becomes the integrating process for mental clarity, emotional balance, moral judgement and transpersonal awareness. It explores implications for teachers, institutional leaders, curriculum design and implementation of policy. Conclusions of the paper dictate that the deliberate development of Spiritual Intelligence can turn learning into a place of moral leadership, self-control and value-infused human development in higher education.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了印度高等教育中道德决策与价值观侵蚀的问题，提出精神智力（Spiritual Intelligence, SI）作为关键高阶能力，能够帮助人们在决策中获得更深的意义、道德敏感性和智慧。论文结合当代SI模型与印度古典理论（《奥义书》和《薄伽梵歌》），构建了一个将SI作为整合过程的Conceptual framework，涵盖心理清晰度、情绪平衡、道德判断和超个人意识，并探讨了对教师、机构领导者、课程设计和政策实施的启示。
AI.research_question: 精神智力如何在印度高等教育中作为核心能力促进道德领导力、自我控制和价值注入的人类发展？
AI.motivation: 印度高等教育目前面临工具主义、领导力问题和师生缺乏目标感的困境，道德决策标准和价值观侵蚀问题非常明显，亟需一种高阶能力来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 当代精神智力模型，以及印度知识体系中的古典理论：以《奥义书》为代表的自我知识与无私行动、以《薄伽梵歌》为代表的平静心与道德直觉。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究，通过整合当代SI模型与印度古典哲学理论构建conceptual framework。
AI.findings: 有意识地培养精神智力可以将高等教育转变为道德领导力、自我控制和价值注入的人类发展场所；SI与印度知识体系内在一致，是与国家教育政策2020综合路径相契合的核心能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了将精神智力作为心理清晰、情绪平衡、道德判断和超个人意识整合过程的概念框架，将当代SI模型与印度古典哲学（奥义书、薄伽梵歌）进行理论融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教师、机构领导者、课程设计和政策实施提供了培养精神智力的具体启示，支持印度国家教育政策2020的落地。

title: Koru Credentialing Velocity Index (Q3 2026): A Quarterly Benchmark of How Fast Healthcare Organizations Actually Move From Hire to Revenue

detail.title: Koru Credentialing Velocity Index (Q3 2026): A Quarterly Benchmark of How Fast Healthcare Organizations Actually Move From Hire to Revenue

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Marcus J. Frazier, is the Founder and Managing Partner of Koru Health, a healthcare operations and transformation consulting firm, and this index is published under the Koru Research Institute, a research initiative of Koru Health. As such, the author has a financial interest in the subject matter insofar as Koru Health provides consulting services related to the operational challenges discussed in this index, including provider credentialing, patient access, and physician recruitment and onboarding. The analysis presented is based on previously published third party data and industry estimates, synthesized and cited transparently; no client, partner, or external party reviewed or influenced the findings prior to publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding, grants, or financial sponsorship of any kind. It was conceived, researched, and produced independently by the author as part of the Koru Research Institute’s ongoing publication series, and was funded solely through the internal resources of Koru Health.

detail.abstract:
This is the first release of the Koru Credentialing Velocity Index, a new quarterly benchmark tracking how quickly healthcare organizations actually move from hire to billable revenue. Existing credentialing statistics are typically cited once and then treated as current indefinitely, even though the underlying conditions, hiring pressure, payer behavior, and staffing markets, shift every quarter. This index applies the same recurring discipline healthcare organizations already use to track revenue and churn. 

The Q3 2026 baseline synthesizes previously published data from CAQH, AAPPR, and AMN Healthcare alongside industry estimated figures established in Koru Research Institute's first two reports, finding that average new patient appointment wait times have reached 31 days, up 19 percent since 2022, against an industry estimated credentialing cycle of 90 to 120 days from hire to billable status and a median physician time to fill of 93 to 135 days depending on specialty. Beginning with the Q4 2026 release, the index will track quarter over quarter movement in each metric, replacing a single frozen citation with a benchmark healthcare executives and their boards can return to every quarter.

AI.tldr: 本文首次发布Koru资质认证速度指数（Koru Credentialing Velocity Index），这是一个新的季度基准指标，用于追踪医疗机构从招聘到可计费收入的实际速度。与以往一次性引用后不再更新的静态统计数据不同，该指数采用持续的季度跟踪方法，帮助医疗高管和董事会每季度监控资质认证效率的动态变化。
AI.research_question: 医疗机构从招聘到可计费收入的资质认证周期实际有多长？该关键指标随季度如何动态变化？
AI.motivation: 现有的资质认证统计数据通常被引用一次后就视为永久有效，但医疗机构的招聘压力、支付方行为和人员市场等基础条件每季度都在变化。需要一个持续更新的基准指标来取代过时的静态数据引用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴医疗机构在追踪收入和客户流失方面已有的季度性管理纪律，将其应用于资质认证效率的持续监测。
AI.method: 综合CAQH、AAPPR和AMN Healthcare的已发表数据，结合Koru研究所前两份报告中建立的行业估算数据，构建Q3 2026基线。
AI.findings: 平均新患者预约等待时间已达31天，较2022年上升19%；行业估算的资质认证周期为从招聘到可计费状态90至120天；按专科划分的医生中位填补时间为93至135天。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从静态的一次性引证转向动态季度基准追踪的概念框架，将认证速度指标纳入医疗机构周期性管理工具体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗高管和董事会提供了一个每季度可回归查看的新基准工具，使资质认证效率的追踪从一次性数据引用升级为持续管理实践，有助于更及时地发现招聘到收入转化过程中的效率变化。

title: Bounded General Equilibrium in a Dual-Tier Automated Economy: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Nash Equilibrium Bridges

detail.title: Bounded General Equilibrium in a Dual-Tier Automated Economy: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Nash Equilibrium Bridges

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the sole researcher and developer of the macroeconomic framework presented in this manuscript. During the preparation of this work, the author utilized a generative AI model as a computational sounding board, structural editor, and literature cross-reference assistant. After using this tool, the author thoroughly reviewed, verified, and edited the resulting manuscript layers, and takes full responsibility for the conceptual purity, mathematical veracity, and ultimate content of the working paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No case studies were performed, no participants have been involved, this qualification does not apply to this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The author is the sole researcher and developer of the macroeconomic framework presented in this manuscript. There is no funding for this research.

keywords: Marxian Tendency of the Rate of Profit to Fall

detail.abstract:
This paper formalizes a testable, reality-bounded general equilibrium framework that solves the structural consumption, labor, and deflationary traps inherent to high-automation economies. By replacing the classical assumption of infinite scarcity with bounded, planet-scale abundance constraints, we formalize an upgraded Dual-Tier Opportunity Capitalism System. The framework is built upon three core structural departures from traditional macroeconomic modeling:

  • The Decoupling of Supply from Biological Labor Constraints: By integrating high-scale robotics and artificial intelligence, the aggregate production function escapes the historical dependencies of supply and demand tied to human population growth metrics and active labor-force availability.

  • The Eradication of Secondary Resource Scarcity: By anchoring industrial throughput entirely to the continuous, un-depletable flow rate of planetary renewable resource inputs, the model relaxes the standard Ricardian limitations of diminishing returns and commodity depletion loops.

  • The Preservation of Opportunity-Driven Meritocracy: We demonstrate a viable optimization pathway to eradicate systemic poverty and achieve universal material wealth, while strictly preserving free-market capitalism, private equity, and merit-based wealth accumulation. This is achieved by implementing non-disruptive, algorithmic incentives for human capital retention alongside targeted structural provisions that prevent the monopolistic exploitation of autonomous networks at the direct expense of the human workforce.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个可检验、现实可约束的一般均衡框架，解决高自动化经济中的结构性消费、劳动力和通缩陷阱。通过用行星级丰裕约束替代古典的无限稀缺假设，正式化了一个升级版"双层机会资本主义系统"，提出三大结构性突破：供给与生物劳动约束脱钩、消除次级资源稀缺、保留机会驱动的精英体制。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个在高自动化经济下既能解决结构性消费/劳动力/通缩陷阱，又能保留自由市场资本主义与精英激励的一般均衡理论框架？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济模型基于无限稀缺假设和生物劳动约束，无法解释高自动化、机器人密集型经济中出现的结构性消费不足、劳动力过剩和通缩陷阱。现有模型未能为高度自动化经济提供可检验的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论；行星级丰裕约束（planet-scale abundance constraints）替代无限稀缺假设；升级版双层机会资本主义系统；去李嘉图化生产函数（消除递减回报与商品消耗循环）；机器人/AI驱动的去生物劳动约束生产函数。
AI.method: 理论建模/形式化（formalization）：提出一般均衡理论框架，构建生产函数与资源约束的新形式化模型，并通过算法激励机制设计论证优化路径的可行性。
AI.findings: 证明了在行星级可再生资源连续流量约束下，供给可完全与生物劳动约束脱钩；消除了次级资源稀缺的递减回报限制；同时证明了存在可行优化路径，在根除系统性贫困与实现普遍物质富裕的同时，保留自由市场竞争、私人产权和基于功绩的财富积累。
AI.theory_contributions: 突破古典经济学"无限稀缺"的基础假设，提出"行星级丰裕约束"新范式；将人工智能与机器人引入一般均衡生产函数，突破生物劳动约束；从理论上扩展李嘉图模型，提出无递减回报的资源约束形式化；构建了兼容精英主义与普遍富裕的"双层机会资本主义"理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高自动化经济体的政策制定提供了理论指导：如何设计非破坏性的算法激励机制以促进人力资本保留；如何防止自主网络对劳动力的垄断剥削；为根除系统性贫困与实现普遍物质富裕提供了可操作的经济制度设计路径。
